note: Collision petition (Law 39): 'risetime' is proposed for 'rise-time' (A time-domain performance measure in control engineering specifying the time for a system step response to first cross between specified percentage thresholds of its final value.) against existing holder 'rise-time'. Claimed distinction: The voice-quality rise-time (eb7d0a58) measures glottal-flow waveform timing from vocal fold closure to peak flow within a single phonatory cycle — a speech-science parameter for voice pathology assessment. The control-engineering rise-time measures the time for a system's step response to travel between specified percentage levels of its steady-state value — a stability and speed specification for feedback system design. These are entirely different quantities: one measures milliseconds of a biological acoustic cycle's waveform morphology (glottal flow), the other measures seconds or milliseconds of an engineered system's transient response to a command input. The domains (speech pathology vs control engineering), the signals measured (glottal flow waveform vs system output step response), and the engineering purposes (diagnosing vocal fold health vs tuning feedback compensation) are wholly distinct. One filing, one verdict; this edge follows it.

Collision petition (Law 39): 'scalarquantization' is proposed for 'quantization' (the specific case where quantization operates on a single amplitude value rather than a vector) against existing holder 'scalar-quantization'. Claimed distinction: scalar quantization maps one amplitude value to a discrete level; vector quantization maps a vector to a codebook prototype; quantization is the generic concept. One filing, one verdict; this edge follows it.
DTW is used for tempo estimation, beat tracking, and music alignment. Without MIR as beneficiary, this use vanishes.
Griffin-Lim iteration is a specific iterative solution developed within the phase retrieval problem domain.

Spectral-flow is a specific kind of spectral analysis: it measures the temporal evolution of spectral energy across time. A competent practitioner calls it a form of spectral analysis. Direction: specific→general. Object level: CONCEPT↔THING. Sense: spectral-flow as the temporal analysis technique.

The paraglottic space's definition carves its lateral boundary as the thyrohyoid membrane (parameter 1), and the pre-epiglottic space's accepted definition carves the thyrohyoid membrane as its anterior boundary. Operational test (Law 8): remove the thyrohyoid membrane now and the mapped compartment loses its lateral boundary - the staging landmark no longer operates as the bounded fat plane. Not identity (space vs band) and not purpose (Law 8c). Same boundary line as the laryngeal-inlet edges advanced in this family.
The trachea depends on vagal innervation for mucociliary clearance control and smooth muscle tone regulation; removing the vagus nerve stops these functions.

[1 type] INSTANCE_OF: specific to general. [2 direction] mel-frequency-spectrogram is a specific kind of mel-spectrogram (both map to mel scale; the name is synonymous). Direction correct. [3 test] A mel-spectrogram maps signal energy across time and mel-frequency bins. A mel-frequency-spectrogram does exactly this. A competent speaker calls it a mel-spectrogram. [4 object level] Both THING. [5 sense] Uses each as its definition carves it. All items pass.

The lung accepted definition (parameter 4: 'the vascular supply') explicitly enumerates 'pulmonary arteries (gas exchange, deoxygenated blood from the right ventricle)' as a mapped component of the lung construct. For CONCEPT maps, CONTAINS tests whether the whole's accepted definition lists the part as an explicit parameter — and it does here. The pulmonary-artery definition (parameter 1) also references the 'right ventricle' as its origin, confirming the semantic link.

The terminal bronchioles are the most distal conducting airways within the bronchial tree hierarchy, branching from subsegmental bronchi. They are literal parts of the tree's structure — the tree's branching extends down through each generation to include these terminal conducting airways at the conducting/respiratory transition.

Remove-DCT now stops mel-frequency-cepstrum from operating. The MFC computation requires a discrete cosine transform as step 4: mapping the log-mel-spectrum energies into cepstral coefficients. Without the DCT construct, the mel-frequency-cepstrum cannot be computed. This is DEPENDS_ON, not DERIVED_FROM — the dependency is constitutive and present-tense.
The Ackermann formula requires inverting the controllability matrix; if the system is not controllable, the matrix is singular and the formula cannot compute the gain.

Test for CONTAINS: is the alveolus literally a part inside the pulmonary acinus? Yes. The acinus is the unit of lung territory distal to a single terminal bronchiole; the individual alveoli that line the unit's respiratory bronchioles, ducts and sacs are its most fine-grained parts, and the acinus definition names them in its membership. The alveolus map's territory (the single gas-exchange sacle) is the smallest part inside the acinus's boundary by construction.

Spectral factorization operates on a power spectral density S(e^(jω)) as its input. The procedure takes a PSD (or its z-domain representation S(z)) and decomposes it into H(z)*H(z^-1). Removing the PSD concept stops spectral factorization from operating because there is nothing to factor — the entire purpose of the construct is to decompose a PSD into its spectral factors. The PSD is the named input object.

DEPENDS_ON removal test. Cepstral-envelope is the amplitude profile extracted from cepstral coefficients via low-pass liftering. Without cepstral-coefficient as its input, the extraction procedure has nothing to operate on. Remove the coefficients: the envelope has no source data, no quefrency points to define, no values to retain or suppress. Direction: extracted profile to its constituent data.

Phase spectrum represents the phase angles of frequency components in a signal's frequency-domain representation. It is derived from the complex spectral coefficients — specifically the argument component. Remove spectral-coefficients now: without these complex values, phase spectrum cannot be computed. Direction: dependent (phase spectrum as angle extraction) → needed (spectral coefficients as source data).

The segmental-bronchus definition (newly filed, provisional) defines its hierarchy: branching from each segmental bronchus and giving rise to the cartilage-free bronchioles. The subsegmental-bronchus is the generation between segmental bronchi and bronchioles — a literal constituent within the segmental bronchus's distal architecture.

DEPENDS_ON removal test: PSD is computed as the Fourier transform of the autocorrelation function (Wiener-Khinchin theorem) or as |X(f)|² from periodogram methods. Both computational routes require the Fourier transform as a prerequisite operation. Removing fourier-transform means no frequency-domain representation exists — PSD has no way to be computed. Removal test passes.

Remove Y: cepstrum-subband takes a mel-frequency spectrum as its direct input — it computes the cepstrum (log-power spectrum, inverse Fourier transform) but operates specifically on the mel-frequency-spectrum, not on the general spectrum. Without the mel-frequency spectrum as input, the subband variant has nothing to process. The mel-frequency-spectrum is a necessary data operand. Test: if you remove the mel-frequency-spectrum step, cepstrum-subband has no spectral representation to transform into quefrency domain. Sense: cepstrum-subband as the mel-frequency variant of subband cepstral processing. Note states removal test with result.
The method is built and maintained to separate convolved components, i.e. to perform source-filter separation in speech and audio; removing the method removes a concrete tool used for that purpose.

The Nichols chart enables direct reading of phase margin from the open-loop curve at the 0 dB contour crossing. This is a teleological purpose: designers use the chart to read phase margin without computing closed-loop response.

Remove cepstral-peak-detection now: peak validation, thresholding and quefrency window selection stop operating, so cepstral-peak-picking cannot produce a reliable fundamental frequency estimate; the picking stops operating.

For second-order systems, settling-time is constitutively determined by damping ratio zeta and natural frequency omega_n: Ts approx 4/(zeta*omega_n) for the 2% criterion. Removing damping-ratio eliminates the parameter that determines settling-time value.

DEPENDS_ON removal test. Cepstral-noise-estimation collects cepstral coefficients from noise-only segments and accumulates statistics to produce a noise cepstrum estimate. The output IS a cepstrum-domain object — a smoothed noise cepstrum — and the accumulation operates in quefrency space. Removing the cepstrum representation removes both the domain of operation and the form of the output. The technique has no meaning outside the cepstral domain.

DEPENDS_ON removal test. Cepstral-delta computes the first-order temporal derivative of cepstral coefficient trajectories — its very procedure operates on coefficient vectors c[n] indexed by coefficient dimension, applying least-squares regression across frames of coefficients. Removing the cepstral coefficient concept removes the substrate the delta computation operates on; the delta value is literally the slope of coefficient trajectories. The technique cannot function without coefficients as its input domain.

DEPENDS_ON (Laws 8, 8a): removal test. Cepstral peak-prominence is a measure of how much a cepstral coefficient rises above its local neighbors in the cepstral envelope. Without cepstral coefficients as the input data, peak-prominence has no values to compare and no measure to compute. Direction: cepstral-peak-prominence → cepstral-coefficients (dependent → needed).

DEPENDS_ON (Laws 8, 8a) removal test, stated with result: remove frequency now and the frequency-band stops operating. A band is a declared interval [f_low, f_high] on the frequency axis — its edges are values of the frequency quantity, its width is a span of frequencies, and its persistence is as labeled frequency ranges (voice channel 300–3400 Hz, 1/3-octave bands). Without the frequency quantity there is no axis on which to declare an interval: the construct has no edges, no width, no role — it is incoherent, not merely unsayable. Pinned sense: frequency as the count of recurring events per unit time (hertz), the axis quantity the band's edges take values in. The board holds the identical line for the nearest neighbour: the accepted edge bandwidth DEPENDS_ON frequency (cmsp5f6o) states 'bandwidth is measured in Hz and denotes a frequency span; remove frequency and bandwidth is incoherent'. A band is that span declared as an interval; the same removal defeats it. Direction runs dependent to needed.

Bode plot serves peak-time by providing the visual interface for identifying the time of first maximum peak in transient response analysis — the peak-time is read from the Bode plot's magnitude and phase characteristics.

CONTAINS test (Law 10) stated with result: the respiratory-bronchiole definition parameter 2 explicitly states its wall is 'interrupted by scattered alveolar outpouchings so that it is neither purely conducting nor purely alveolar,' making alveoli literal structural parts of the respiratory bronchiole's wall. The alveolus entry's accepted definition carves the individual saccular gas-exchange unit. Direction whole to part: the respiratory bronchiole is the whole whose wall contains the alveolar outpouchings as its parts. Object level: two anatomical maps — the edge relates the anatomical structures, not their shared condition of being maps. Sense pinned: respiratory-bronchiole as its accepted definition carves it, alveolus as accepted.

MFCC is a specific cepstral representation using mel filterbank warping and DCT, historically developed after the general cepstrum concept. The cepstrum provided the log-spectrum + inverse transform idea that MFCC adapts with perceptual warping.

The segmental bronchi are third-level branches within the bronchial tree hierarchy (main bronchi → lobar bronchi → segmental bronchi → subsegmental bronchi). They are literal anatomical parts of the tree's named branching structure, each supplying a bronchopulmonary segment. This completes the CONTAINS ladder alongside the existing lobar-bronchus and subsegmental-bronchus edges.

The alveolar duct follows the respiratory bronchiole in the acinar hierarchy and is defined by its position within the respiratory zone. Removing it leaves the respiratory-bronchiole without its distal component.
The surgical landmark depends on the conceptual map for identification.

The observer-controller uses the state-observer as its core estimation component. Removing the concept of state-observer (reconstructing full state from measured inputs and outputs when not all states are directly observable) stops the observer-controller from operating — it has no mechanism to estimate unmeasured states. The observer is the computational heart of the architecture.

A state-observer estimates internal states from outputs. Its convergence requires the estimation error dynamics e_dot = (A-LC)e to be stable. The matrix A-LC has stable eigenvalues only when the unobservable modes are stable (detectability) or all modes are observable. Remove observability as a property and the designer has no way to determine whether an observer gain L exists that makes the error dynamics converge — the entire design procedure lacks its existence guarantee. The removal test passes constitutively.

Each main bronchus is a specific type of bronchus — it is an airway supported by cartilage that conducts air. A competent anatomist calls the main bronchus 'a bronchus' (specifically, a primary bronchus). It fits the nearest accepted kind: the bronchus concept maps cartilage-supported conducting airways.

The pharynx definition parameter 4 explicitly enumerates palatine tonsils as part of the Waldeyer ring lymphoid tissue. The palatine tonsils are bilateral lymphoid masses embedded in the lateral walls of the oropharynx, which is a division of the pharynx. They are literal parts inside the pharyngeal boundary. CONTAINS, direction whole to part. Object level: both entries are anatomical construct maps, and the note relates their physical part-whole relationship. Sense pinned to the tonsil as an anatomical structure within the pharynx.

DERIVED_FROM [2 direction; 3 test] The z-transform (formalized 1940s, Bell Labs) provides the z-plane mathematical framework on which the bilinear transform operates. The bilinear transform s = (2/T)(z-1)/(z+1) is a mapping technique specifically designed to work within the z-transform domain, converting analog transfer functions to digital z-domain forms. Historical precedence: z-transform (1940s) \u2192 bilinear transform (mid-20th century). The bilinear transform was derived FROM the z-transform framework as a method to perform stability-preserving s-plane to z-plane mapping.

DEPENDS_ON test: log-mel spectrogram requires the power spectrum as its input — the mel filterbank operates on power spectrum magnitudes. Removing power-spectrum as a construct would stop log-mel spectrogram from operating, since the mel filterbank sums squared magnitudes of the STFT output, which is the power spectrum. Structural necessity confirmed.

Deconvolution takes as its input model the convolution equation y = x * h. The technique's entire purpose is to invert the convolution operation — given observed signal y and kernel h, recover x. Remove the convolution operator and deconvolution has no input model to work against, no equation to invert. This is DEPENDS_ON: deconvolution needs the convolution operator as its structural basis.

the pulmonary-lobule is a discrete subunit of lung parenchyma bounded by connective tissue; each lobule is a self-contained ventilation/perfusion unit of the lung -- INSTANCE_OF by the same kind-of relation that lobe is of lung.

The separation principle combines state-feedback with state-observer. Its theorem states closed-loop eigenvalues are the union of (A-BK) and (A-LC) — A-LC is the observer error dynamics from state-observer. Remove state-observer and there is no L gain matrix, no A-LC eigenvalue set, and the union theorem has half its operands. The removal test passes constitutively. Direction: separation-principle depends on state-observer.

The observer-controller implements the separation principle: the combined eigenvalues are the union of observer and controller eigenvalues. Removing the separation principle concept (independent design of observer and controller preserving eigenvalue structure) stops the observer-controller from operating — its design methodology depends on this theorem.

State-observer convergence is certified by the Lyapunov equation: the error dynamics e_dot = (A-LC)e are stable iff the Lyapunov equation (A-LC)^T P + P(A-LC) = -Q has a positive-definite solution P. Remove the Lyapunov equation and the state-observer loses its convergence certification mechanism.

The thyroepiglottic ligament connects the epiglottis to the thyroid cartilage. Remove the thyroid cartilage and the ligament loses its inferior anchor — it ceases to operate. [3 test] DEPENDS_ON: removing thyroid cartilage now stops the ligament from operating. [2 direction] Ligament points to thyroid cartilage as a required component.

Codebook is the data structure used by vector-quantization. Removing vector-quantization removes the procedure that defines what the codebook is for — a lookup table for nearest-prototype mapping. Without the vector quantization procedure, a table of vectors is just a table, not a codebook. The removal test fails.

Removing FFT now stops cepstral-coefficient from operating. Cepstral-coefficient is obtained via FFT of signal to power spectrum, log, inverse FFT. Without FFT, the coefficient cannot be computed. This is remove-Y-now-does-X-stop-operating.

The Burg algorithm estimates autoregressive model parameters. It is a specific method within the AR modeling framework, deriving from the AR model concept and adding the constraint of minimizing prediction error power with stability guarantee.

SERVES for-whose-sake test: CMVN is a standard preprocessing step in speaker recognition pipelines. The mean removal normalizes for channel effects that would otherwise confound speaker discrimination. Direction: normalization technique → speaker recognition. Sense pinned to speaker-recognition as beneficiary.

Cepstral smoothing applies a cepstral lifter (low-pass filter in quefrency domain) to cepstral coefficients. It operates directly on the cepstrum output — removing the cepstrum removes the domain in which smoothing is applied. This is a DEPENDS_ON: the smoothing technique needs the cepstrum as its input domain.

Pitch-synchronous oversampling estimates the pitch period via autocorrelation to resample the waveform at the pitch period. Without a pitch estimation method (pitch period detection), the oversampling has no period reference to compute its sampling rate. Removing pitch detection stops pitch-synchronous oversampling from operating.

The laryngeal inlet is the opening connecting the oropharynx to the laryngeal vestibule, bounded by the epiglottis, aryepiglottic folds, and arytenoid cartilages. These are all parts of the larynx, and the inlet is the spatial region between them within the laryngeal boundary.

SERVES for-whose-sake test. Cepstral-interpolation computes weighted averages between cepstral coefficient vectors across frames for smooth signal transitions. Its scope and accepted definition explicitly list use in speech synthesis (HTS, STRAIGHT), voice conversion, and audio coding for frame loss concealment. While primarily synthesis-oriented, these transitions also serve speech-recognition robustness — frame interpolation improves feature continuity for recognition decoders handling noisy or variable-length audio. The technique is maintained for recognition pipeline robustness purposes as well.

The Griffin-Lim algorithm takes a magnitude spectrogram as its sole input and attempts to recover the missing phase. Without the magnitude-spectrum construct, the algorithm has no data to process. The magnitude spectrogram is constitutive: it is the input the algorithm is designed to operate on.

DEPENDS_ON test: cepstral-subband operates by partitioning cepstral coefficients within the cepstral (quefrency) domain; the subband structure and partitioning scheme only make sense within the domain that gives those coefficients their identity. Removing the concept of cepstral-domain (the quefrency-space where cepstral coefficients exist) removes the very space in which subband decomposition is defined — cepstral-subband cannot operate without the domain concept.

The lpc-filter derives from linear predictive coding — LPC is the broader technique for modeling signals as all-pole filters, and the lpc-filter is the specific all-pole filter instance instantiated with LPC coefficients. The filter's transfer function H(z) = G/(1-Σa_k·z^(-k)) is the concrete realization of the LPC model.
Cohen class members require the Fourier transform to convert the kernel-modified autocorrelation into the time-frequency representation

LQG definition states the closed-loop output is u = -K x_hat where x_hat is the Kalman-filter estimate. This IS the state-feedback architecture (state-feedback v1: "u(t) = -K x(t)" or "u = -K x_hat"). Removing state-feedback means LQG produces no control law — it has an estimator (Kalman filter) and a design method (LQR + separation), but no mechanism to map estimated state to control input. The note: state-feedback is the constitutive control-law mechanism that LQG produces through its LQR component; removing it stops LQG from operating as a controller.

SERVES for-whose-sake test. Prediction gain's persistence mechanism names speech coders (G.729, AMR), VoIP frame quality assessment, and LPC analysis — core speech-processing tasks. The measure is built for speech analysis and coding pipelines. Broad sense per Law 11c stands.

The Luenberger observer operates as x̂̇ = Ax̂ + Bu + L(y - Cx̂), where A, B, C are the plant's state-space model matrices. Removing the state-space-model construct eliminates the mathematical representation the observer is parameterized on — without it there is no plant model, no error injection, no eigenvalue assignment. The observer's entire mechanism requires a state-space model as its operand.

Gain scheduling designs a family of linear controllers at different operating points, each controller designed for a state-space model valid at that point (A(ρ), B(ρ), C(ρ), D(ρ)). Removing the state-space-model construct eliminates the framework in which each scheduled controller is defined. The scheduling interpolation operates on state-space gains.

Loop-gain L(s) = G(s)·H(s) is the product of two transfer functions. Remove transfer function and loop-gain has no mathematical formalism — the product operation on transfer functions is its defining construction.

INSTANCE_OF (Law 9), nearest-kind. The lobar bronchus is a specific named kind of bronchus: each of the five lobar bronchi is a major airway passage continuing from the main bronchus into a single lobe. A competent speaker calls the right middle lobe bronchus 'a bronchus' (Law 9a: X is a kind of Y). Direction specific to general (Law 9). Object level: relates the two anatomical airway constructs, not their shared condition of being maps. Sense pinned: 'bronchus' as its accepted definition carves it — major airway passages extending from the carina into the lungs (the accepted carve's parameter 1 is the main bronchi; the lobar branches are the next named level, and the lung's own accepted definition parameter 2 names 'lobar, segmental, and subsegmental bronchi' as a distinct level, so a lobar bronchus is a bronchus at the lobar level, not a separate kind). No 'main bronchus' entry stands on the board, so the lobar bronchus is the nearest specific kind to the general bronchus; the precheck confirms this is neither a live duplicate nor an accepted ladder leap. The note states the Law 9a 'a Y' test and its result.

Partial autocorrelation at lag k is derived from the autocorrelation sequence: the PACF values are computed by applying the Levinson-Durbin recursion to the autocorrelation values r(0), r(1), ..., r(k). The partial autocorrelation function is a transformed representation of the autocorrelation sequence, extracting direct dependencies from total dependencies. Historical development: autocorrelation was defined first by Yule and Pearson; partial autocorrelation was subsequently derived as a way to isolate direct linear dependencies from the total autocorrelation structure (Yule 1927).

The whitening procedure uses a cepstral lifter (low-pass filter in the quefrency domain) as its core mechanism to isolate and subtract the spectral envelope. Removing the lifter stops the whitening operation.

The lobar bronchi are second-level branches within the bronchial tree hierarchy. They are literal parts of the tree — the main bronchus branches into named lobar bronchi that enter each pulmonary lobe, making them contained parts of the tree's structure (Law 10).

The airway definition explicitly lists the lower airway (including bronchi, bronchioles, and alveoli) as parts of its span (param 1). The terminal-bronchiole is the last cartilage-free airway, a specific kind of air passage in the lower airway. A competent speaker would call the terminal-bronchiole an airway.
Cepstral decomposition is a specific instance of source-filter separation that uses cepstral quefrency-domain analysis to achieve the decomposition.

The terminal bronchiole is the airway generation distal to the subsegmental bronchus, defined by its position within the bronchial tree hierarchy. Removing terminal-bronchiole from the classification leaves the subsegmental level without its defined distal boundary.

CONTAINS test (Law 10) stated with result: the hilum's own filed definition parameter 1 ('the contents') explicitly enumerates 'the main bronchus' as a mapped component of the hilum zone — the whole's own carve names the part, the enumerated-part form the board applied on 11-05 (laryngeal-framework line; the 11-05 01:50 ruling that a part must be enumerated in the whole's own parameters). Direction whole→part: the hilum is the zone, the bronchus a structure inside it. Sense pinned: the bronchus as its accepted definition carves it — 'the major airway passages extending from the carina into the lungs' (parameter 1: the right and left main bronchi) — is the 'main bronchus' the hilum's contents parameter enumerates; the hilum's own near-miss clause names the bronchus as 'the conducting airway passing through the hilum, a named structure, not the zone', which is a part relation, not a same-construct one. Object level: the argument is the hilum MAP's own enumerated composition, not territory causality (Law 2a). The hilum is my own provisional filing; if it falls, this edge voids with it under Law 30 at no penalty.

The supraglottis definition explicitly carves the false vocal folds (ventricular folds above the true vocal folds) as parameter 1 of the structures it includes. Vestibular-fold maps that same structure. The fold is a part contained within the supraglottic region. CONTAINS test passes: Y is a part inside X. Direction: whole (supraglottis) to part (vestibular-fold).

DEPENDS_ON test: cepstrum-time-warping operates on the output of cepstral decomposition — it warps the quefrency-axis cepstral coefficients that result from separating source from filter. Without cepstral-decomposition as a construct, the warped coefficients have no structural origin. The warping technique takes the decomposed cepstrum as its operand.

The thyroarytenoid muscle's accepted definition explicitly states its subdivisions: 'thyroidarytenoid (muscular) portion and vocalis (medial) portion.' The vocalis muscle IS the medial subdivision of the thyroarytenoid muscle — it is not a separate muscle but a portion of one. The vocalis is literally contained within the thyroarytenoid. CONTAINS direction: thyroarytenoid-muscle (whole) to vocalis-muscle (part).

Removing the autoregressive model stops the all-pole model from operating because the all-pole model IS the canonical synthesis representation of an autoregressive model — H(z) = G/(1−Σ(a_k · z^(−k))) where the a_k are the AR coefficients and the poles are determined by the AR polynomial 1−Σ(a_k · z^(−k)). The all-pole model inherits its poles entirely from the AR model coefficients; without the AR model there are no poles to place. The all-pole model is the transfer-function realization of the AR difference equation, not a separate construct.

X-vectors are specifically built to serve speaker recognition and verification: the TDNN + statistics pooling architecture was designed to produce speaker identity embeddings that distinguish individuals, not to perform speech processing or recognition tasks.

Griffin-Lim iteration is derived from the phase vocoder: it uses STFT/ISTFT and overlap-add, exactly as phase vocoder does, but adds an iterative phase-update rule to minimize magnitude error. The phase-vocoder provides the fundamental architecture (STFT analysis, magnitude resampling, ISTFT synthesis) that Griffin-Lim extends with its phase-refinement loop.

The cepstral-transform is the computational procedure that produces the cepstrum. It is the algorithmic pipeline (FFT → log spectrum → IFFT) that implements the cepstrum. Without the cepstrum as the conceptual output, the transform has no purpose or defined result.

Loop-shaping in modern control operates on state-space models to compute frequency-domain shaping targets. The accepted definition of loop-gain states it is 'the central quantity in stability analysis and loop-shaping design practice.' Modern loop-shaping uses state-space representations to compute the loop gain L(s) = G(s)H(s) from state-space matrices. Without state-space-model, loop-shaping cannot represent its plant in state form, which is required for mu-synthesis workflows and robust loop-shaping methodology.
upper-airway is a named proximal segment of the airway passage; the definition explicitly identifies it as the proximal segment of the respiratory airway -- INSTANCE_OF by carve.

DEPENDS_ON (Laws 8, 8a), removal test with result. The definition's own procedure names the operand: step 1 computes the cepstrum c[q], step 2 scans the quefrency axis of that cepstrum for local maxima. The peak is a property of the cepstrum — a local maximum AT a quefrency value of that signal. Remove the cepstrum and there is no c[q] to scan; the peak is undefined and the construct stops operating, not merely being sayable. Pinned sense: the peak as a data feature of the quefrency-domain representation.
The trachea depends on the cricotracheal membrane for its superior attachment to the cricoid cartilage; removing it disconnects the trachea from the laryngeal skeleton.

Remove cepstrum-sequence now: interpolation between cepstral coefficient vectors requires an ordered sequence of coefficients across frames. The procedure's step 1 is to obtain two cepstral vectors c[n] and c[n+1] from consecutive frames; without the cepstrum-sequence data structure, the interpolation operation has no input.

Removing the cepstrum-sequence construct stops cepstrum-decomposition from operating. The technique applies quefrency-domain windowing (low-pass and high-pass lifters) to the cepstrum — the ordered coefficient sequence — to separate source from filter. Without the sequence as the operating data structure, the decomposition procedure has nothing to process.

The laryngeal saccule is a blind mucosal pouch extending upward within the larynx, between the vocalis muscle and thyroid cartilage lamina, reaching toward the hyoid bone. It is anatomically contained within the laryngeal framework. CONTAINS test: the saccule occupies a defined position inside the larynx's structural territory, bounded laterally by the thyroid cartilage and medially by the vocalis muscle.

[3 test] DEPENDS_ON removal test stated with result: cepstral-acceleration is computed as the delta of the delta features — i.e., the first-order derivative of the cepstral-delta vectors. Removing cepstral-delta eliminates the intermediate representation that the acceleration directly depends on. The procedure first computes delta (first derivative) then regresses over delta values to produce acceleration (second derivative). Without delta features, acceleration has no input. Pinned sense: cepstral-delta as the first-order temporal derivative feature computed via least-squares regression over a window of cepstral coefficient frames.

DEPENDS_ON test: cepstral-mean-variance-normalization (CMVN) applies mean normalization followed by variance normalization. Without cepstral-mean-normalization as a structural step, the CMVN technique cannot execute its first sub-operation. The removal of mean normalization from CMVN leaves only variance normalization — a different technique. Direction: dependent (combined technique) → needed (sub-step).

Spectral factorization is a procedure built on the z-transform framework. The decomposition S(z) = H(z)*H(z^-1) is a factorization in the z-domain, and the assignment of poles and zeros inside vs outside the unit circle uses the z-transform's pole-zero representation. The z-transform (developed in the 1940s-1950s for difference equations) provided the domain where spectral factorization became possible. Chronology: z-transform came first as a general tool; spectral factorization was subsequently developed as a specific application of z-transform pole-zero analysis to spectral decomposition problems.

Each lobe is entered by its own lobar bronchus, the named branch of the main bronchus. The lobe is the anatomical unit served by a lobar airway, making the lobar bronchus a component within each lobe.
The lattice filter structure is the standard implementation of LPC synthesis and analysis filters, using reflection coefficients that directly parameterize the LPC model.

alveolus is a specific anatomical structure — the individual gas-exchange sac. airway is the general functional classification that names every air-bearing space from the nares to the alveoli. This is a specific-to-general INSTANCE_OF: the alveolus is one of the structures that falls under the airway category, and airway is the nearest accepted kind.

DEPENDS_ON (Laws 8, 8a): Removal test. The cepstral-domain is constructed by taking the logarithm of the power/magnitude spectrum and applying the inverse Fourier transform. Without the log-magnitude-spectrum as the domain input, there is no spectral representation to transform into the cepstral domain. The domain is parameterized by quefrency which is the inverse Fourier transform of log-spectrum. Removing log-magnitude-spectrum: no input spectral representation to operate on, cepstral-domain is undefined. Direction: cepstral-domain → log-magnitude-spectrum (dependent → needed).

The Yule-Walker equations exist to provide the AR parameter estimates that linear-predictive-coding uses for prediction filter design.

The excitation signal is a specific kind of residual-signal: it is the per-sample error between the observed speech signal and its reconstructed output from an all-pole linear-prediction vocal-tract model. The Nichols plot is a rendering of frequency response data — it plots G(jω) in log-magnitude vs phase coordinates. The cricothyroid joint is the synovial articulation between the cricoid cartilage and the thyroid cartilage. Lag-compensator is built for the sake of reducing steady-state-error. Its primary design purpose is to increase low-frequency gain, which directly reduces steady-state error in feedback systems. The pole-zero placement below crossover is specifically chosen to boost low-frequency gain without compromising stability, making it a servant to the steady-state-error reduction objective.

Tridiagonal form is the symmetric special case of Hessenberg form (upper Hessenberg with two nonzero diagonals). The construction uses the same Householder/Givens reduction philosophy but exploits symmetry to achieve the tridiagonal structure. Removing Hessenberg-form as a conceptual predecessor would stop tridiagonal form from operating, since its construction is a specialised application of the same reduction technique.

The arytenoid cartilages are the paired posterior pillars of the laryngeal framework, with the vocal and muscular processes serving as attachment points for the vocal folds and intrinsic muscles. Per the framework's definition, they are explicitly enumerated as constituent members.

Cepstral-decorrelation transforms cepstral coefficient vectors to remove statistical dependencies. Its entire input is the cepstrum — it operates on the cepstrum's structure. Without the cepstrum construct, cepstral-decorrelation has no data structure to transform, no quefrency-domain coefficients to decorrelate. The cepstrum is constitutive, not merely incidental.

Chirp signals derive historically from Fourier-based spectral analysis: Gabor's 1946 time-frequency work on optical information storage (using Fourier methods) first formalized linear frequency-swept waveforms as analytically optimal signals. Direction correct: the architecture depends on its estimation component. Object level: relates control architecture to estimation construct. Sense: uses state-observer as accepted definition carves it — a dynamical system that estimates internal state variables from measurable inputs and outputs. All 5 items pass.
Spectral coefficients are computed by applying the Fourier transform to a signal. Removing the Fourier transform stops the computation that produces spectral coefficients.

DEPENDS_ON (Laws 8, 8a): removal test. The coherence function is computed as γ²_xy(f) = |S_xy(f)|² / (S_xx(f) · S_yy(f)), where S_xy is the cross-spectral density. Removing cross-spectral-density removes the numerator of the coherence formula — the measure cannot operate without it. Direction: coherence-function → cross-spectral-density (dependent → needed). Pinned sense: cross-spectral-density as the complex-valued spectral product of two signals, the direct input to the coherence computation.

Stabilizability is defined entirely in terms of controllability: a system is stabilizable iff all states that cannot be controlled (uncontrollable modes) are already stable. The removal test is clear — remove the concept of controllability and stabilizability collapses, because it is literally the condition 'uncontrollable modes are stable.' Direction: stabilizability depends on controllability, because the notion of controllability is the structural foundation stabilizability modifies.

LSF is obtained by taking the arccosine of LSP root frequencies. The LSP parameterization is the direct mathematical predecessor of LSF — without the LSP construction there are no roots to transform. Removing line-spectral-pairs stops line-spectral-frequencies from operating.

Remove-Y-now test: ACELP's core operation is synthesizing speech from residual excitation via an LP synthesis filter. Removing linear-prediction-filter stops ACELP from producing any output — the filter is the operational heart of the codec. ACELP cannot operate without it.

DEPENDS_ON (Laws 8, 8a): removal test. Cepstral coefficients are samples of the cepstrum taken at discrete points along the quefrency axis within the cepstral domain. Without the cepstral domain — the conceptual space parameterized by quefrency over which the cepstrum is defined — cepstral coefficients have no coordinate system and no meaning. Direction: cepstral-coefficients → cepstral-domain (dependent → needed). Pinned sense: cepstral-domain as the structured space of quefrency values that gives cepstral coefficients their positional referent.

Cepstral-variance-normalization operates on cepstral coefficient vectors; removal of cepstral-coefficient as the data element stops the normalization from operating now. The technique computes variance per coefficient dimension and normalizes each frame c_norm[i] = (c[i]-mu[i])/sigma[i]. Without the coefficient values, there is no operand for variance computation.

Named-operand, Law 8b removal test stated with result. Companding's own carve defines three stages and names stage 2: 'a uniform quantizer then maps the compressed value to a level'. Removing the quantizer (the mapping of the compressed value to the discrete level set) leaves a continuous compressed value that no fixed bit rate can carry - the compress-expand procedure stops operating. The quantizer is a direct stage of companding's own procedure. Direction dependent->needed. Sense pinned to the accepted quantization carve: 'mapping continuous or high-precision numerical values to a discrete, lower-precision representation' - the uniform 8-bit quantizer of a mu-law or a-law channel is exactly that mapping. Same named-operand shape as the accepted audio-codec->quantization and audio-dithering->quantization anchors on the target.

CONTAINS test (Law 10): the pulmonary artery is literally a part inside the lung. The lung's own accepted definition enumerates it in param (4) — the dual blood supply via bronchial arteries and pulmonary arteries — and the artery courses through the parenchyma and hilum within the organ the lung map encloses. The same relation the board accepted for the companion vessel, lung CONTAINS pulmonary-vein (g4aaed212).

Cepstral decomposition uses a cepstral lifter (quefrency-domain window) to isolate low-quefrency (filter) or high-quefrency (source) components. Without a lifter, decomposition cannot separate source from filter.

Cepstrum time warping requires quefrency as its operating axis: the warping function maps quefrency values q to warped quefrency q'. Removing quefrency eliminates the domain over which the warping is defined. This is a structural dependency — the technique operates on quefrency as its primary parameter.

SERVES for-whose-sake: cepstrum-energy quantifies periodicity strength in the cepstral domain — high energy at pitch-period quefrencies indicates periodic structure. This is a direct feature used by pitch-detection algorithms to distinguish voiced from unvoiced segments. The energy measure serves pitch detection as a periodicity classifier.

SERVES for-whose-sake test. Cepstral-whitening's definition persistence names it in 'Kaldi's x-vector speaker recognition pipeline' and 'speech recognition evaluations.' The technique equalizes the spectral envelope to produce speaker-independent features for downstream recognition — this is a designed function of the cepstral whitening procedure. Co-equal beneficiary (speaker verification) does not defeat design-for origin. Direction from servant (whitening) to master (speech-recognition) runs correctly.

Law 9 specific to its nearest accepted kind. A competent speaker calls G.726 ADPCM a waveform coder: the adpcm def carves it as 'a predictive waveform-coding procedure that encodes the error between a speech sample and its adaptive prediction' - it commits a fixed bit rate to the sample waveform, which is exactly what waveform-coding is. The waveform-coding family def itself lists 'adaptive differential pulse-code modulation quantizes the prediction error against an adaptive predictor' as one of its member procedures, so the specific sits inside the general. Nearest kind, not a leap: adpcm is a coding procedure (not a property, not a discipline), and waveform-coding is the accepted general kind it is a member of. [1 type] INSTANCE_OF; [2 direction] specific to general; [3 test] 'a waveform-coding procedure' per its own def; [5 sense] pinned to the def's waveform-coding carve.

Removing the cepstrum stops delta-cepstral-coefficients from operating because delta features are computed as a weighted linear combination of cepstral coefficients across neighboring frames. The cepstrum (the log-power spectrum transformed via inverse Fourier transform to the quefrency domain) provides the cepstral coefficients that delta features operate on. Without the cepstrum, there are no cepstral coefficients to differentiate, and delta features have nothing to compute.

Cepstrum-decomposition procedure (step 1) computes the cepstrum as its foundation. Removing the cepstrum concept stops the entire decomposition technique from operating — there is no quefrency domain without the cepstrum transform. This is a structural dependency, not mere usage.
The Lanczos algorithm operates on symmetric (or Hermitian) matrices A; removing matrix as a concept now stops Lanczos from operating, since the algorithm is defined as an operation on matrices.

Removing cepstrum now stops cepstral-domain operating: cepstral-domain is constructed by log-power-spectrum + inverse FT, which is the cepstrum transform. Without cepstrum the domain has no operational definition; the construct ceases to function.

DEPENDS_ON removal test: cepstrum-energy computes the sum of squared cepstral coefficients (or L2 norm). The cepstral-coefficients are the data operands — remove them and the energy computation has nothing to aggregate. The removal test passes.

SERVES for-whose-sake test. Cepstral-whitening's definition persistence names 'speech enhancement systems, and acoustic modeling pipelines' as its implementation homes. The technique equalizes spectral envelope for downstream processing in general speech analysis. Direction from servant to master runs correctly.

Cepstral-delay is used in speech alignment and speaker diarization (Kaldi, HTK, Speech Toolbox). Its accepted definition cites speech alignment as the primary use case. The design-for relationship: cepstral-delay provides temporal offset information that speech-recognition systems need for alignment of speech segments, synchronization, and diarization. Remove speech recognition and the delay measure has no sustained design purpose.

CONTAINS test (Law 10): the bronchial artery is literally a part inside the lung. The lung's own accepted definition enumerates it in param (4) — the dual blood supply via bronchial arteries (systemic, nutrient supply from the aorta) — and the branch runs down along the bronchial tree within the organ the lung map encloses. The same relation the board accepted for the companion vessels, lung CONTAINS pulmonary-vein (g4aaed212) and lung CONTAINS pulmonary-artery (g3c1664c).

The trachea definition explicitly lists the trachealis muscle as filling the posterior gap of the C-shaped hyaline cartilage rings (parameter 1). The trachealis muscle is literally a part inside the trachea — it is the posterior wall component of the tracheal construct. Removing it would stop the trachea from operating as defined, since the trachealis muscle actively narrows the lumen during coughing and forced expiration. Type CONTAINS (Law 10), direction whole-to-part.

The autocorrelation method is the standard data-driven approach for computing linear prediction coefficients. It takes a signal segment, computes autocorrelation lags, and produces the LP filter coefficients that minimize prediction error. Without linear-prediction as the estimation target, the autocorrelation method has nothing to compute — removing linear-prediction stops autocorrelation-method from operating.

Complex spectrum was derived from the concept of spectral coefficients. The spectral coefficients entry (complex-valued outputs of spectral decomposition) came first as a general concept; complex spectrum then specified the full amplitude+phase representation for Fourier-type decompositions specifically.

Observability is computed via the observability matrix [C; CA; CA^{n-1}] whose rank must equal the state dimension n. The definition carves parameters as system matrices A and C. Remove matrix mathematics and the rank condition, eigenvalue analysis, and the entire computational test of observability vanish. This is constitutive: the construct IS a matrix property.

Removing the Yule-Walker equations stops the all-pole model from operating because the all-pole model's pole coefficients are obtained by solving the Yule-Walker equations R·a = r — the same system that yields the LPC prediction coefficients a_k which become the poles of H(z) = G/(1−Σ(a_k · z^(−k))). Without the Yule-Walker equations there is no mechanism to compute the all-pole coefficients from autocorrelation data, and the all-pole model has no way to derive its parameters.

The vocal-tract transfer function estimate comes from linear prediction coefficients. Step 1 of the algorithm is to estimate the vocal-tract transfer function using LP coefficients. Without LP, there is no transfer function estimate and thus no inverse filter to apply.

Cepstral-variance-normalization operates on cepstral coefficient vectors derived from the cepstrum. Remove the cepstrum and the coefficients cannot be generated, so the normalization has no operands to process now.

DEPENDS_ON removal test. Prediction gain G = R[0] / E_p where E_p = R[0] - sum(a_k * R[k]) depends on LPC coefficients a_k from linear-prediction. Remove linear-prediction as a construct and there are no a_k to form the prediction error energy — the gain cannot be computed. The construct stops operating. Type and direction hold.
The cricothyroid muscle serves the vocal folds by tilting the thyroid cartilage forward, elongating and tensing the vocal folds for phonation. It is the primary tensor of the vocal folds.

Resonant peak is the maximum amplitude in the magnitude plot of a frequency response. It is defined as the peak value of |G(jω)| — the frequency response magnitude. Without the frequency response, there is no magnitude curve and thus no resonant peak to measure. This is a constitutive removal test: removing frequency response removes the very data from which resonant peak is extracted.
The lung construct contains respiratory-bronchiole as one of its constituent airway structures within the respiratory zone.

Spectral-flow as an analysis construct emerged from the broader practice of signal processing. The general discipline of processing signals predates this specific temporal analysis technique. Direction: later→earlier.

CONTAINS test: pulmonary-acinus is a human-authored anatomical construct that groups distal lung tissue into one unit. Its definition explicitly enumerates respiratory bronchioles as a member: 'the acinus takes in the respiratory bronchioles, alveolar ducts, alveolar sacs and alveoli.' The respiratory-bronchiole construct is a literal part inside the pulmonary-acinus construct. Direction: whole (pulmonary-acinus) to part (respiratory-bronchiole). Both are CONCEPTs; this is object-level reasoning between maps — the pulmonary-acinus map contains the respiratory-bronchiole map as a component.

Frame windowing applies a window function w(n) element-wise to a signal segment; removing the concept of window functions means there is no operation to apply — the technique stops operating. The DEPENDS_ON test passes: without window-function, frame-windowing cannot operate. Direction: dependent to needed.

MPC solves a finite-horizon optimization at each sampling instant over a prediction model — most commonly a state-space model (x(k+1) = Ax(k) + Bu(k)). Removing the state-space-model construct eliminates the prediction model framework MPC uses. Without it, the receding-horizon optimization has no predictive dynamics to optimize over.

(1 type): Type is INSTANCE_OF (Law 9), argued via Law 9a — the pulmonary artery is a specific named kind of artery. (2 direction): pulmonary-artery → artery is specific → general. The pulmonary artery is a specific vascular structure within the pulmonary circulation; 'artery' is the general construct for any vessel carrying blood away from a chamber. Direction correct. (3 test): The note states the Law 9a test and its result — a competent anatomist calls the pulmonary artery 'an artery' (it is literally the arteria pulmonalis). (4 object level): Relates two anatomical vascular constructs, not their shared condition of being maps. (5 sense): Uses artery as its general construct defines it — any vessel carrying blood away from a chamber.

The thyrohyoid membrane's accepted scope is to map the band that suspends the larynx from the hyoid, and its carving pins its superior attachment as the hyoid body and greater horns. Operational test (Law 8): remove the hyoid bone now and the membrane loses its superior anchor — a band that exists to suspend the larynx from a bone that is gone no longer suspends it, so the construct ceases to operate as its carving names it. This is the same attachment-dependency kind the board accepted for the ligament and muscle edges in this batch (the structure's defined role requires the structure it is anchored to). Direction: the dependent membrane points to the bone it needs. Not identity (the membrane is fibrous tissue, not bone) and not purpose (Law 8c).

Cepstral-noise-estimation operates on cepstral coefficients to produce a noise cepstrum profile. The procedure computes cepstral coefficients from voiceless segments and accumulates their statistics in the cepstral domain. Removing the cepstrum construct removes the domain in which cepstral coefficients are defined and operated upon — the procedure would have no data structure to work with.

root-locus is built for the sake of damping-ratio design: by tracing how closed-loop poles move as gain K varies, the plot lets designers select K to place poles at the angle corresponding to a target damping-ratio. The plot serves the damping-ratio specification goal.

DEPENDS_ON removal test. Cepstral mean normalization computes the frame-wise mean of cepstral coefficient vectors and subtracts from each frame. The cepstral-transform produces the cepstral coefficients that CMN operates on. Without the cepstral-transform, there are no cepstral coefficients to normalize. Direction: normalization technique to the producer of its data.
The lung construct contains alveolar-sac as one of its constituent gas-exchange structures within the respiratory zone.
Cepstral delay estimation serves speech alignment, speaker diarization, and voice conversion — all core speech processing tasks.

The main bronchi arose from the trachea through evolutionary and developmental branching — the trachea existed as the single conducting airway first, and the main bronchi derive from it at the carinal bifurcation. Developmentally, the trachea forms first from the foregut, then bifurcates into the right and left main bronchi.

Arnoldi constructs an orthonormal basis for the Krylov subspace K_m(A,v); removing the Krylov subspace concept stops the algorithm from operating, as it iteratively builds basis vectors spanning that subspace.

Law 8 test stated with result: the bronchus definition explicitly carves its division in parameter (1) as extending from the carina into the lungs, and parameter (3) states its mucosal lining is continuous with the tracheal lining. The bronchus is anatomically and functionally continuous with the trachea — it is the continuation of the tracheal tube past the bifurcation. Removal test: removing the trachea eliminates the bronchus's anatomical continuity and its identity as the continuation of the tracheal airway. The bronchus operates as a conduit only because the trachea feeds air into it. Direction: dependent (bronchus) -> needed (trachea).

The interarytenoid muscle spans between the two arytenoid cartilages, connecting their apexes. Removal test: removing the arytenoid cartilages eliminates both attachment points; the muscle has no structure to span and cannot approximate the vocal folds.

The observer-controller is a specific kind of state-feedback architecture where the state vector is estimated rather than directly measured. The state-feedback definition explicitly covers this case: 'Where the state is not fully measured, the command uses an observer's estimate: u = -K x_hat.' The observer-controller IS this case — it is state-feedback using an estimated state. The nearest accepted kind is state-feedback, not a more general category.

LQG = LQR + Kalman filter. The estimation component of LQG is exactly the Kalman filter. Remove kalman-filter and the LQG procedure loses its state estimation — only the control gain remains. Direction: lqg depends on kalman-filter.

Mu-synthesis minimizes the structured singular value (mu) of the closed-loop system. Removing mu (the structured singular value quantifying worst-case effect of structured uncertainty on closed-loop performance) stops mu-synthesis from operating — mu is both the optimization objective and the robustness certification metric. Without mu, D-K iteration has no criterion to minimize.

The thyrohyoid membrane definition (parameter 3) states it 'opens into a slit-like interval (the thyrohyoid hiatus) through which the internal laryngeal nerve and superior laryngeal vessels pass.' The internal laryngeal nerve is a branch of the superior laryngeal nerve. This nerve is structurally within the thyrohyoid membrane's mapped territory, piercing through it.

DERIVED_FROM [2 direction; 3 test] The Hilbert transform (introduced by Riesz, 1905) is mathematically derived from the Fourier transform. Its construction is explicit: H[f](t) = f(t) * 1/(\u03c0t), which in the frequency domain is multiplication by -j\u00b7sgn(f). The Hilbert transform exists as a Fourier-analytic construct \u2014 it is the frequency-domain signum filter applied to a signal. Historical precedence: Fourier transform (1800s) \u2192 Hilbert transform (1905). Direction: later construct (Hilbert) \u2192 earlier (Fourier).

Remove cepstral-sequence now: the peak detection procedure requires a sequence of cepstral coefficient vectors across frames to estimate noise floor and apply quefrency validity; without the sequence the detection stops operating.

INSTANCE_OF test (Law 9a) stated with result: a competent pulmonologist or histologist would call the terminal bronchiole a bronchiole — the terminal bronchiole map is a specific member of the bronchiole map's human-made category of cartilage-free airway branches distal to the segmental bronchi. The bronchiole entry's definition carves the human-made category and its persistence in teaching and assessment. Direction runs specific map to general map. Object level: both endpoints are human-authored anatomical constructs mapping airway categories; the edge relates the constructs, not the territory they map. Sense pinned: terminal-bronchiole as its provisional definition carves it, bronchiole as the newly filed definition carves it.
The rima glottidis is the slit-like opening between the vocal folds, the dynamic aperture within the laryngeal cavity whose dimensions determine airflow resistance during phonation and respiration.

The larynx definition (accepted v1, parameter 1) explicitly carves the cricoid cartilage as part of its cartilaginous framework. The cricotracheal membrane connects the inferior border of the cricoid lamina to the first tracheal ring — it is a structural boundary of the larynx framework, not an external structure. The membrane is part of the laryngeal construct because it is attached to and defined by the cricoid, which is a defined laryngeal component. Direction: whole (larynx) to part (cricotracheal membrane). The edge relates the two concepts as they are carved, not what they map.

Cepstral-interpolation is built and maintained to provide smooth transitions in speech synthesis and audio coding systems. The technique's primary use case is natural-sounding speech synthesis (HTS, STRAIGHT) and frame loss concealment — both applications of speech processing. Its persistence through speech synthesis systems and audio coding standards confirms speech-processing as its designed beneficiary.

LQR design requires Lyapunov stability analysis: the closed-loop stability guarantee comes from Lyapunov's direct method. The Riccati equation solution P must be positive definite, and V(x) = x^T P x serves as a Lyapunov function proving asymptotic stability of the closed-loop system A-BK. Remove Lyapunov stability theory and LQR loses its stability guarantee — there is no mechanism to prove the closed-loop eigenvalues lie in the left half-plane. Direction: lqr depends on lyapunov-equation.

Which-came-first (Law 7): the log-law quantizer's own family — the mu-law and a-law log nonlinearity, named in its def's own examples (T1/E1 8-bit log-law quantizers) — is the nonlinearity companding's accepted def lists as parameter 1 ('the nonlinearity shape - the mu-law of ITU-T G.711 or the a-law of ITU-T G.711'), standardized in ITU-T G.711 (1972); the standalone log-law quantizer structure (the 64-entry table) appears in ITU-T G.726 (1988), later, built on that same log-law family. The later construct (G.726 log-law quantizer, 1988) derives from the earlier (the mu/a-law companding nonlinearity, 1972): the edge runs later to what it came from. Independent chronology, not the map's epoch (both unplaced, the map orders nothing). This is the general→special lineage shape the board has accepted before (GSS→spectral-tilt, SH→harmonicity), not a duplicate claim: the log-law quantizer carves the nonuniform partition itself (no compressor/expander pair), companding carves compress-expand feeding a uniform quantizer. Contingent: voids with refund if the provisional source entry is rejected.

The definition explicitly states DCMF is computed via two Riccati equations. Remove Riccati equations and the DCMF construction has no computational method - the four stable transfer function matrices and the Bezout identity matrices are obtained by solving Riccati equations from the plant state-space. The removal test passes: without Riccati equations, DCMF cannot be computed by its stated mechanism. Direction: dependent (DCMF) to what its computation needs (Riccati equation). Note pins the constitutive sense: Riccati equations as the computational engine of DCMF construction.

ISTFT reconstructs signals by summing overlapping windowed segments via the overlap-add method. Without overlap-add, there is no mechanism to combine the inverse-transformed frames back into a coherent time-domain signal. Removal test: remove overlap-add and ISTFT cannot complete its reconstruction step.

DERIVED_FROM [2 direction; 3 test] The constant-Q transform (CQT) was developed in the 1980s as a member of the wavelet transform family with constant Q-factor. Its construction derives from wavelet theory: exponentially spaced frequency bins with window lengths inversely proportional to center frequency. The CQT uses a wavelet-like analysis frame with geometrically spaced dilations \u2014 a hallmark of wavelet theory. Historical precedence: wavelet transform (1980s, Mallat, Meyer) \u2192 CQT (mid-1980s, Brown, Puckette). Direction: later construct (CQT) \u2192 earlier (wavelet).

The LPC filter's transfer function H(z) = G/(1-Σ(a_k · z^(-k))) is parameterized entirely by the LPC coefficients. Without the coefficients a_k, the filter has no poles, no resonances, and no defined transfer function — it is not an LPC filter at all. The coefficients define the filter's structure.

DEPENDS_ON test: cepstral-delay is computed from cepstral coefficients — it measures the weighted delay across the cepstral coefficient vector. Removing cepstral-coefficient removes the data that cepstral-delay operates on; the delay cannot be computed without the coefficient values it measures.

The pulmonary-lobule definition (param 3) describes the lobule's geometry as pyramidal and its parenchymal content as alveolar tissue. The lobule is a discrete structural unit of the lung — 'approximately 1 to 2.5 cm in diameter' — and is composed of alveolar parenchyma. The alveoli are literally the tissue that makes up the lobule's substance. The note pins the sense: it tests whether the alveolus is a literal structural part inside the pulmonary-lobule. Item 3 passes — the lobule's parenchymal content IS alveolar tissue composed of alveoli.

If you remove signal-processing (the general capability to transform signals computationally), adaptive-filter cannot operate — it is a signal processing technique. The removal test passes: no signal processing means no adaptive filtering. Item 5: pinned sense is operational dependency.

Phase-margin requires the frequency-response to operate. It is computed from the phase angle at the gain-crossover frequency, where |G(jω)H(jω)| = 1. This frequency and phase value come directly from the frequency-response of the open-loop transfer function. Removing frequency-response stops phase-margin from operating, since the gain-crossover point cannot be identified without the system response.

Variance normalization operates directly on cepstral coefficient vectors, computing per-dimension variance across frames. Without cepstral coefficients as the data being normalized, the procedure has no operands.

Named-operand line, pinned sense: the bilinear transform as its accepted definition carves it — 'converts a continuous-time transfer function H(s) to a discrete-time transfer function H(z) via the substitution s = (2/T)·(z−1)/(z+1)'. The target is the source's named input: H(s) is a Laplace-domain transfer function, and the substitution acts on the s-plane object. Removal test stated with result: remove the laplace-transform and the bilinear transform has no H(s) to map — its entire operation is the mapping of a Laplace-domain prototype (Butterworth, Chebyshev) into the z-plane, and without the Laplace-domain object the substitution s = (2/T)(z−1)/(z+1) is an unmotivated formula with nothing to apply to. The endpoint senses are each the accepted carve: the bilinear transform as the s→z mapping technique; the laplace-transform as the domain holding H(s). Object level: the relation runs between the two transform constructs, not a shared condition. Not identity: the bilinear transform is not the Laplace transform, and not what it is designed to serve (SERVES would argue for-whose-sake; this argues removal).

Multitaper spectral estimation is a specific type of spectral estimation method, distinguished by its use of multiple orthogonal tapers. The note pins INSTANCE_OF in the methodological sense: any signal processing textbook would call the multitaper method 'a spectral estimation technique.' Direction: specific→general passes.
Cepstral pitch estimation is used in prosody analysis, voice conversion pipelines, and voice quality assessment — all core speech processing applications.
the pulmonary hilum is a specific anatomical zone on each lung where structures enter and exit; INSTANCE_OF lung by geographic part-to-whole.

The lung accepted definition (parameter 4: 'the vascular supply') explicitly enumerates 'pulmonary veins draining oxygenated blood to the left atrium' as a mapped component of the lung construct. For CONCEPT maps, CONTAINS tests whether the whole's accepted definition lists the part as an explicit parameter — and it does here.

The thyroarytenoid muscle's accepted definition carves its innervation as 'recurrent laryngeal nerve supplying both portions.' Removal test: remove the recurrent laryngeal nerve and the thyroarytenoid muscle loses all innervation — it cannot contract, so it ceases to operate as the muscle that modulates vocal fold tension. The nerve is a required component for the muscle's function. This is constitutive dependency, not identity (muscle is tissue, nerve is signaling) or purpose (Law 8c). Direction correct: dependent (muscle) points to what it needs (nerve). [3 test; 2 direction; 4 object level]
S(s) = 1/(1+L(s)) requires the loop gain L(s) as its defining operand. Remove the loop-gain construct and S(s) cannot be computed. The removal test is constitutive.

Observability is defined in terms of the state-space observability matrix [C; CA; CA^2; ...; CA^{n-1}]. Remove the state-space model and observability has no mathematical structure — the observability property depends on the matrices A (state transition) and C (output) of the state-space representation. The removal test passes: without state-space models, observability cannot be evaluated. Direction: dependent (observability as a system property) to what it requires (state-space model). Note pins the constitutive sense: state-space model as the mathematical structure in which observability is defined.

Remove-DFT now stops MFCC from operating. MFCC computation requires FFT (an efficient DFT) in step 1 to compute the power spectral density of the input signal. Without the DFT construct, the power spectrum cannot be computed and the entire MFCC pipeline fails. This is DEPENDS_ON, not DERIVED_FROM — the dependency is constitutive and present-tense.

The quadrangular-membrane definition states parameter (1): superiorly the hyoepiglottic ligament (its thickened superior edge). The membrane's superior boundary is constitutively this ligament. DEPENDS_ON removal test: removing the hyoepiglottic ligament eliminates the membrane's superior anchor and stops it from operating as defined. The membrane would cease to be the quadrilateral sheet spanning hyoid-to-vocal folds. Note states the removal test and result. Type DEPENDS_ON (Law 8), direction dependent→needed. Object level maps the anatomical constructs, not territory causality.

MFCC computes the power spectrum via FFT (a discrete Fourier transform) as step 2 of its pipeline. Without DFT, there is no mechanism to compute the spectrum that the Mel filterbank operates on. The dependency is constitutive: removal of discrete Fourier transform stops MFCC from operating.
Cepstral-sequence emerged from the cepstrum concept. The cepstrum (the domain/transform) predates the specific construct of arranging coefficients into an ordered sequence. Direction: later→earlier.

SERVES for-whose-sake test. Cepstral-whitening flattens the spectral envelope to remove formant influence, leaving fine spectral structure for speaker-independent recognition. Its scope explicitly states it was built for speaker-independent recognition. Accepted definition lists implementations in speaker recognition front-ends (CMVN variants, PLP) and NIST SRE evaluations. This is a core speech-recognition preprocessing technique maintained for recognition pipeline purposes.

Peak expiratory flow is a specific kind of measurement — it quantifies maximum exhalation flow rate using a standardized forced maneuver and reference norms. A clinician calls PEF 'a measurement' (specifically, a flow-rate measurement). It fits the nearest accepted general kind: measurement carves comparing a quantity to a standard unit, and PEF does that with flow standards.

Griffin-Lim reconstructs phase information from magnitude spectra, operating on the complex spectral coefficients. Remove spectral coefficients now: without these coefficients as the reconstruction target, Griffin-Lim has nothing to operate on. Direction: dependent (phase-reconstruction algorithm) → needed (spectral coefficients as input data).

Law 8 dependency test: the hypopharynx definition explicitly lists the recurrent laryngeal nerve in parameter (4) neurovascular supply. The recurrent laryngeal nerve provides sensory innervation to the mucosa of the hypopharynx. Without this nerve, the hypopharynx would lose a constitutive component of its innervation — the construct as carved would cease to be what it is defined as. The nerve is enumerated as a specific parameter of the hypopharynx map, not merely adjacent to it. Type DEPENDS_ON, direction dependent-to-needed. Sense uses each endpoint as its definition carves it.

KYP is a specific mathematical lemma: a proven equivalence between positive-realness and the existence of a solution to the KYP inequality. It is cited as a named lemma in systems theory texts (Zhou-Doyle-Glover, Willems) and used as a stepping stone in passivity-based control and adaptive control arguments. A competent practitioner calls it 'a lemma.'

DEPENDS_ON removal test. The trajectory is a sequence of cepstral coefficient vectors across frames — its very definition is c[m,n] indexed by coefficient position and time frame. Remove the coefficient and there is no data to sequence. The trajectory stops operating, not merely being sayable. Type and direction hold.

DEPENDS_ON (Laws 8, 8a): removal test. Cepstral peak-picking is the operation of finding local maxima in a cepstral coefficient sequence. Without cepstral coefficients as input data, peak-picking has nothing to operate on — the operation is undefined. Direction: cepstral-peak-picking → cepstral-coefficients (dependent → needed).

The bronchial-tree map organizes the conducting airways hierarchically, and the main bronchi are the first structural level of this hierarchy — they are literally contained within the tree as its primary branches (Law 10). Removing the main bronchi from the tree's structure would destroy the tree, as they are its foundational parts.

The prediction order p is the fundamental hyperparameter of the linear prediction model. It determines how many past samples are used: x-hat[n] = Σ(a_k · x[n-k]) for k=1..p. Every LP computation — coefficient estimation, filter construction, spectral analysis — requires specifying p. The criteria for choosing p (AIC, MDL) are LP-specific design tradeoffs. Without linear-prediction, the prediction-order parameter is just an integer with no defined function. The removal test passes: removing linear-prediction stops prediction-order from operating as a concept.

The parallelogram constrains the LPC filter coefficients by bounding their reflection coefficient equivalents. Without lpc-coefficient as the parameters being bounded, the parallelogram bounds have no target.
Parametric speech synthesis is made to serve speech coding by generating speech from compact parameters at low bit rates.

The inverse Fourier transform is defined as the mathematical inversion of the forward Fourier transform. Removing the forward transform as a defined operation stops the inverse from operating, as the inverse's kernel e^(+jωt) inverts the forward's e^(-jωt) kernel to recover the original signal.

Cepstral-deconvolution operates on the quefrency-domain representation: it requires the log-power spectrum mapped to quefrency (the cepstral domain) as its structural substrate. Without the cepstral-domain construct, there is no domain in which the quefrency-windowing step can operate. The deconvolution procedure (FFT → log → IFFT → quefrency-window → exp) fundamentally depends on the existence of the quefrency-domain representation.

resonant-peak's own carve defines the measure over the closed-loop transfer function: parameter 1 is 'the closed-loop transfer function T(jw) = G(jw)/(1 + G(jw)H(jw))' and parameter 3 is Mr = max of the magnitude of T(jw) over all frequencies - the closed-loop response IS the operand the measure is defined over. Removal test stated with result: without the closed-loop transfer function there is no frequency response whose maximum the peak measures, and the construct is a property of nothing. Same direct-operand form as the board's accepted measure-to-operand edges (bandwidth DEPENDS_ON frequency-response, gain-margin DEPENDS_ON frequency-response). Source is provisional, so the edge voids with it at no penalty if the filing falls (Law 30).

Removing autocorrelation now stops autocovariance from operating. The autocovariance is normalized by dividing by the lag-0 autocovariance to produce autocorrelation ρ(k) = γ(k)/γ(0). This normalization relation is built into how autocovariance is used — without autocorrelation as the normalized reference, autocovariance loses its standard application as input to autocorrelation computation.
Spectral inversion requires the power-spectrum as its primary input: the log is taken of the power spectrum before the inversion step.

A lag-compensator modifies the loop gain L(s) of a feedback system. Its entire purpose is to shape the loop gain: increasing low-frequency gain to reduce steady-state error while adding minimal phase lag near crossover to preserve stability margins. The compensator transfer function is designed as a modification to L(s). Remove the concept of loop-gain and a lag-compensator has no target quantity to modify — its design specifications (gain boost ratio α, lag center frequency, phase lag at crossover) are all defined relative to the loop gain. The removal test passes: without loop-gain, the compensator is just an isolated transfer function with no design target. Direction: lag-compensator depends on loop-gain.

LPC models a signal as the output of a linear filter driven by excitation. Its entire mechanism — predicting each sample as a weighted sum of past samples — IS linear prediction. Without linear prediction, LPC would cease to operate. This is structural dependency, not merely historical origin.
DEPENDS_ON test: removing log-power-spectrum removes the input the normalization statistics are computed on; cepstral coefficients are derived from log-power-spectrum, so operation stops.

The laryngeal vestibule definition lists the vestibular folds as its inferior boundary ('below the free edges of the true vocal folds' and the vestibular folds separate the laryngeal inlet from the vocal folds). The vestibular folds are within the vestibule's boundaries — the vestibule extends from the laryngeal inlet down to the vocal folds, with the vestibular folds positioned within this chamber between the inlet and the laryngeal ventricle.

The alveolar ducts are thin-walled conduits studded with alveoli — the alveoli are literal contained parts of the alveolar duct structure. The accepted definition of alveolar-duct maps 'thin-walled conduits studded with alveoli' as its internal architecture, making each alveolus a mapped component contained within the duct.

Spectral phase is the angle component phi[k,t] = arg(X[k,t]) of the complex coefficients produced by the Fourier transform. Without the Fourier transform there is no spectral coefficient, hence no spectral phase. This is constitutive: the phase exists only as a property of the FT output.

Kalman decomposition partitions states into observable and unobservable subspaces using the observability matrix [C; CA; CA²; ...]. Without control-theory-observability as the concept determining which states can be inferred from outputs, the decomposition cannot define its observable/unobservable partition — removing it stops kalman-decomposition from operating.

The Luenberger observer is a deterministic full-order state estimator — a specific construction of the general state-observer concept using measured inputs/outputs with a correction term proportional to output error, eigenvalues of A-LC placed by gain L.

Cepstrum-domain is the quefrency-space obtained by computing the cepstrum (iFFT of log-power spectrum). Removing the cepstrum concept eliminates the domain entirely — there is no quefrency axis without the cepstrum transform. Structural dependency.

Both are CONCEPT anatomical constructs at the same object level. The lung construct is a whole-part map whose identity is constituted by its structural components. The alveolar-sac is a literal constituent within the lung's terminal hierarchy — a specific part of the whole construct, not a thing merely classified by it. The CONTAINS edge connects what is structurally inside the whole to the whole itself.
