DEPENDS_ON (Laws 8, 8a), removal test with result. The cepstrum is the quefrency-domain signal from which cepstral coefficients are sampled — the cepstral-energy is computed on coefficient values of the cepstrum. Remove the cepstrum transform and there is no c[q] to sample; the energy measure stops operating. Direction: measure to its data source.
Cepstral time warping modifies the quefrency axis of a cepstrum. Without the cepstrum construct, there is no quefrency-axis to warp — the construct has no operand to operate on.

DEPENDS_ON test: log-mel spectrogram requires the mel filterbank as a structural component — the mel-scale triangular filterbank maps linear frequency bins to perceptual bands, summing squared magnitudes within each filter. Without the mel filterbank construct, the mel-scale mapping stage cannot operate. Structural necessity.

The impulse-response characterizes an LTI system via the convolution integral y(t) = ∫x(τ)h(t-τ)dτ. The impulse-response's operational value — predicting any output from any input — exists only through the convolution operator. Remove the convolution operator and the impulse-response loses its mechanism for characterizing system behavior. This is a DEPENDS_ON: the impulse-response's predictive function requires the convolution operator to operate.

Law 8 test stated with result: the carina definition explicitly carves a sensory function in parameter (3) — 'densely innervated by vagal afferent fibers making it one of the most sensitive areas of the airway, triggering the cough reflex when stimulated.' The vagus nerve supplies these vagal afferent fibers. Removal test: removing vagal innervation stops the carina from triggering the cough reflex, which is the sensory function defined in parameter (3). The carina operates as a cough reflex trigger only through vagal afferent transmission. Direction: dependent (carina) -> needed (vagus nerve).

The extended Kalman filter is a specific kind of statistical estimator — it infers the posterior distribution of a hidden state from noisy measurements. The note pins the INSTANCE_OF sense: a competent practitioner calls an EKF 'a statistical estimator.' Specific→general, nearest kind accepted.

SERVES (Law 8d), for-whose-sake by design. Cepstral-entropy is computed in speech recognition front-end pipelines (Kaldi) as a feature for voice activity detection and speech/non-speech classification. The measure is built into these pipelines for speech recognition purposes — without that design home, the feature has no sustained practice. Pinned sense: cepstral-entropy as a VAD/classification feature in speech recognition.

Law 7, independent chronology. Pulse-code-modulation is the standing ancestor: the PCM procedure (sample, quantize, code the full sample) is the fixed-rate digital voice codec ITU-T G.711 specifies for 3.1 kHz speech, and ADPCM is the differential refinement of it - the 1988 ITU-T G.726 standard keeps the PCM rate law (samples at the Nyquist rate, fixed bits per sample) while moving the quantizer onto the prediction error of an adaptive predictor. The later construct (ADPCM, G.726 1988) points to what it came from (PCM, G.711 lineage): PCM stood first and fed into ADPCM, and PCM operates without ADPCM (the full-sample codec is complete on its own), so this is lineage, not dependence. Not a simultaneous pair: the two standards are decades apart, and the derivation is stated from the standards' own history, not from the graph's epoch.

Remove-Y-now test: linear-prediction-filter's transfer function H(z) = G/A(z) is parameterized entirely by its prediction coefficients a_k. Without linear-prediction-coefficient, the filter has no parameters and cannot operate — it is structurally empty. The filter needs its coefficients to function.

The alveolar-capillary-membrane definition carves 'the barrier through which oxygen and carbon dioxide diffuse between alveolar air and pulmonary capillary blood' (param 1). The membrane IS the barrier formed by the alveolar wall (type I pneumocyte), fused basal lamina, and capillary endothelium (param 2). The membrane is not an independent structure — it exists only because alveoli exist. The note pins the sense: if the alveolus were removed, the alveolar-capillary-membrane would cease to exist as a construct, because there would be no alveolar surface for the barrier to be a part of. This is a DEPENDS_ON test — remove the alveolus and the membrane stops operating. All 5 items pass.

Lattice-structure uses reflection coefficients as its stage parameters. Removing reflection-coefficient removes the parameters that define each lattice stage, so the structure has no way to specify filter behavior. The removal test fails: without reflection-coefficients, a lattice cannot be parameterized.
Per the laryngeal vestibule definition, the pre-epiglottic space (anterior to the epiglottis) lies within the vestibule's boundaries.

The alveolar-capillary-membrane is a constituent part of the alveolus construct. The alveolus definition specifies the alveolar-capillary membrane as parameter 3: the combined barrier of type I cell cytoplasm, fused basal laminae, and capillary endothelium. This membrane is literally a part inside the alveolus structure; remove it and the alveolus is structurally incomplete. Direction: whole (alveolus) to part (alveolar-capillary-membrane).

The superior laryngeal nerve is a CONCEPT mapping a branch of the vagus that supplies the larynx. Its definition states the internal branch 'pierces the thyrohyoid membrane to become the internal laryngeal nerve, providing sensory innervation to the laryngeal mucosa above the vocal folds,' and the external branch 'descends on the inferior pharyngeal constrictor to supply the cricothyroid muscle.' These branches physically traverse the laryngeal framework — the nerve is a literal anatomical structure within the larynx's anatomical territory. CONTAINS direction: larynx (whole) to superior-laryngeal-nerve (part).
Bode plot serves engineers in determining steady-state-error by displaying the low-frequency asymptotic gain that determines static error constants (K_p, K_v, K_a).

The conus elasticus definition (parameter 4) states it is 'continuous superiorly with the cricothyroid membrane and with the vocal ligaments (which form its free upper borders).' The vocal ligament is literally the free superior margin of the conus elasticus, making it a structural part of the conus elasticus construct.
DEPENDS_ON test: normalization operates on cepstral coefficients; removing them stops the operation.

Lattice-filter's operation requires reflection coefficients: each stage k multiplies by k_k, the reflection coefficient at that stage. Without these coefficients, the coupling between stages cannot be computed and the filter has no transfer function. This is a structural DEPENDS_ON, not a SERVES relation.

PF requires state-space formalism: it propagates particles through the nonlinear state-transition function with process noise and computes measurement likelihoods via the observation function. Without f(x,u) and h(x), particles have no dynamics to evolve and no measurements to weight against. Removal stops operating.

The pulmonary-acinus definition includes alveolar-sac as its terminal constituent — the terminal clusters of alveoli. Direction: whole (pulmonary-acinus) to part (alveolar-sac). Literal parthood: the acinus comprises these sacs as one of its three structural components.

Remove-Y-now test: line-spectral-pair is defined as the spectral values derived from the roots of the LPC prediction polynomial's even and odd parts. Without linear-prediction-coefficient (the a_k coefficients that define that polynomial), there is no polynomial to factor, no roots to compute, and thus no LSP values can exist. The filter has no parameters without its coefficients.

Remove Y: delta-cepstral-coefficients computes the difference between successive cepstral-coefficient frames, producing cepstral-delta (dynamic) features. Without cepstral-delta as the computational mechanism (first-order temporal differencing), delta-cepstral-coefficients has no operation to produce its output. The cepstral-delta IS the differencing operation that delta-cepstral-coefficients applies. Test: remove cepstral-delta and delta-cepstral-coefficients cannot compute temporal deltas from successive cepstral frames. Sense: delta-cepstral-coefficients as the temporal-delta coefficients derived from cepstral-coefficient sequences. Note states removal test with result.

Cepstrum-smoothing applies a smoothing operation in the quefrency domain of the cepstrum. Removing the cepstrum concept eliminates the quefrency domain entirely — there is no quefrency-space to smooth in without the cepstrum transform. This is a structural dependency, not mere usage.

Cepstrum-distance is a measure computed by comparing cepstra directly in the quefrency domain. The cepstrum is the object being compared — removing the cepstrum concept eliminates the thing being measured. Without cepstra to compare, cepstrum-distance cannot operate. This is a structural dependency.

Gain-margin is routinely computed and read from a bode-plot. The bode-plot renders the frequency response as a magnitude curve in dB; the gain margin is read as the difference between the magnitude curve and 0 dB at the -180 degree phase-crossover frequency. Removing the bode-plot stops the standard engineering practice of reading gain-margin from it.

The supraglottis definition explicitly includes the laryngeal ventricles as one of its structures. The saccule extends from the anterior portion of the ventricle and occupies the supraglottic space between the vestibular and vocal folds. CONTAINS test: the saccule is a part within the supraglottic territory.

DEPENDS_ON test (Law 8): remove the bronchiole map now — the terminal-bronchiole map as a maintained level in the airway hierarchy would stop operating as the last purely conducting airway of the tree, because its definition positions it as a specific member of the bronchiole category. The map's operation depends on the general category being maintained. Object level: both are human-authored anatomical constructs mapping airway categories. Sense pinned: terminal-bronchiole as provisional, bronchiole as newly filed.

Both are CONCEPT anatomical constructs at the same object level. The bronchus construct is a whole-part map whose identity is constituted by its structural components. The lobar-bronchus is a literal constituent within the bronchial hierarchy — a specific part of the whole construct, not a thing merely classified by it. The CONTAINS edge connects what is structurally inside the whole to the whole itself.

SERVES for-whose-sake test: the def explicitly names "speech synthesis" as a persistence mechanism and use case. Lifting cepstral coefficients to shape the spectral envelope is fundamental to LPC-based speech synthesis vocoders. Direction: lifter → speech synthesis. Sense pinned to speech-synthesis.
The larynx depends on the recurrent laryngeal nerve for motor innervation to all intrinsic laryngeal muscles except the cricothyroid; removal causes bilateral vocal fold paralysis.

The cricothyroid-joint definition carves the lateral cricothyroid ligament as parameter 3 of its ligamentous support, and the joint capsule as parameter 2. The cricothyroid-membrane is the fibrous sheet whose boundaries include the cricothyroid joint capsules laterally (per the cricothyroid-membrane definition). But this is not a CONTAINS — the membrane is external to the joint. Striking this.

Pole-placement computes a state-feedback gain K to place eigenvalues of A-BK at desired locations. The output is u = -Kx, a state-feedback control law. Remove pole-placement and state-feedback loses another fundamental design method for choosing K. Direction: pole-placement serves state-feedback.
The recurrent laryngeal nerve serves the posterior cricoarytenoid muscle by providing its motor innervation, enabling the muscle to abduct the vocal folds.

Cepstral-pitch extracts the fundamental period from the quefrency domain of a cepstrum. The quefrency of the dominant peak directly corresponds to the pitch period. Without quefrency as the domain where peaks are located and measured, cepstral-pitch has no operational basis. The quefrency axis is not merely correlated with pitch—it is the structural medium through which pitch is computed.

The alveolus is the microscopic air sac within the lung parenchyma where gas exchange occurs. The lung definition explicitly maps alveolar tissue as part of its parenchymal architecture (parameter 3: the parenchymal architecture — the functional lung parenchyma composed of alveolar tissue supported by a connective tissue stroma, organized into lobules). The alveolus is physically contained within the lung as its terminal functional unit.

DEPENDS_ON removal test. Cepstral mean normalization computes frame-wise mean of cepstral coefficient vectors across an utterance. The cepstral-domain is the representation space parameterized by quefrency in which cepstral coefficients are defined and manipulated. Without the cepstral-domain, CMN has no structural space — no quefrency-indexed coordinate system for the coefficient vectors it normalizes. Direction: normalization technique to its structural domain.

Cepstral deconvolution as a general technique for separating convolved components in spectroscopy and seismology predates the speech-specific homomorphic filtering formulation; historical literature places deconvolution as the broader ancestor.

UKF requires state-space formalism: it operates on the nonlinear state-transition function f(x,u) and observation function h(x) — these ARE the state-space model. Without f, h, and the state vector x, UKF has no dynamics to propagate through sigma points and no measurement equation to update estimates. Removal stops operating.

The subsegmental bronchi are fourth-level branches within the bronchial tree hierarchy, the last generation still bearing hyaline cartilage. They are literal parts of the tree's hierarchical structure (Law 10).

The accepted quadrangular membrane definition lists the hyoepiglottic ligament as its thickened superior edge — a thickening of the membrane's own fibrous substance, not a separate structure bounding it. The ligament's own accepted carving confirms the relationship: it 'forms the anterior boundary of the quadrangular membrane', i.e. it is tissue of the membrane itself. CONTAINS test (Law 10): is the ligament literally a part inside the membrane? Yes — the same way the board accepted the corniculate cartilage as a part inside the aryepiglottic fold (apex cartilage within the fold's substance) and the vocal ligament as a part inside the vocal fold. This is not the boundary case struck for epiglottis/vallecula: there a separate structure (its own cartilage, its own map) bounded the region; here the 'boundary' is the parent's own thickened tissue, so the part is inside the map. Direction: whole (membrane) to part (ligament).

The Bode plot's magnitude curve at the resonant peak directly reads peak-overshoot for underdamped systems: the dB value of the magnitude peak equals the peak overshoot in dB. Designers use the Bode plot to estimate transient overshoot from the frequency-domain resonant peak — the height of the magnitude curve above its low-frequency asymptote quantifies how much the step response will overshoot its steady-state value.

The bounded real lemma is a specific kind of lemma: a proven result (an exact equivalence between an H-infinity norm bound and a matrix/Riccati condition) within robust control, cited as a named lemma in the standard texts. The Law 9a test: a competent practitioner calls it 'a lemma' - it is a proven subsidiary result used inside a larger argument (H-infinity synthesis), which is what the accepted lemma definition carves. Specific to general, nearest accepted kind: no intermediate accepted kind stands between a named named-theorem and the general lemma; the board's own sampling-theorem and bayes theorem sit at this same rung. Direction: specific to general.

PID-controller computes its output from the error signal e(t) = setpoint - measured_output. The three terms (proportional to error, integral of past error, derivative of rate-of-change of error) all operate on error. The removal test: removing error eliminates the input signal the PID processes. Without error as a concept, the PID has no operand.

Law 10 part-whole test: the pharynx accepted definition (v1) explicitly enumerates salpingopharyngeus as one of the longitudinal muscles in parameter (2). The salpingopharyngeus-muscle entry carves precisely this muscle. Direction: pharynx (whole) to salpingopharyngeus-muscle (part) is correct. The note states the CONTAINS test and confirms the muscle is literally named as a component of the pharynx carve.

DEPENDS_ON test: perceptual linear prediction operates on the power spectrum — the Bark-scale filterbank applies to power spectrum energies. Without the power spectrum construct, the critical-band filtering stage has no input. Removing power-spectrum stops perceptual-linear-prediction from operating.

The Hilbert transform is implemented as a Fourier-domain operation: H(f) = −j·sgn(f), multiplying positive frequencies by −j and negative by +j. In practice it computes via FFT → phase shift → IFFT. Without Fourier-domain machinery, there is no efficient or standard mechanism to apply the Hilbert transform to a signal.

The EKF was developed as an extension of the Kalman filter to nonlinear systems. Historical reasoning: the original Kalman filter (1960) solved linear Gaussian estimation; Bailey and Bacon (1969) and others extended it by linearizing via Jacobians — this is the EKF. The Kalman filter existed first and fed the EKF as its conceptual and structural predecessor. Direction: later→earlier, chronology established from independent historical reasoning.

decorrelation operates on cepstral coefficient vectors to remove statistical dependencies between them. Without cepstral-coefficients as its input, the decorrelation procedure has nothing to transform.

Multitaper spectral estimation operates by computing the Fourier transform of each tapered signal and forming |X_k(f)|² for each taper k. Without the Fourier transform as the fundamental operation, the multitaper method cannot produce spectral estimates. The Slepian tapering is applied in time domain before the FT, and the averaging is over Fourier-domain magnitudes.

The bronchial tree maps the full hierarchical airway structure from main bronchi through subsegmental bronchi to respiratory bronchioles. It contains the bronchus level as its proximal category, alongside lobar, segmental, and subsegmental subdivisions.

Cepstral-noise-estimation operates directly on cepstral coefficients and produces a noise cepstrum profile. The procedure serves the cepstrum by extending its utility — computing statistical noise estimates in the cepstral domain for use in subsequent cepstral-domain noise subtraction. Without the noise-estimation service, the cepstrum cannot be used for noise-robust processing.

Law 8 dependency test: the hypopharynx definition explicitly lists the internal laryngeal nerve in parameter (4) neurovascular supply as the sensory branch from the superior laryngeal nerve of vagus. Without this nerve, the hypopharynx would lose its superior sensory innervation — the construct as carved would cease to be what it is defined as. The nerve is enumerated as a specific parameter of the hypopharynx map. Type DEPENDS_ON, direction dependent-to-needed. Sense uses each endpoint as its definition carves it.

The vocalis muscle is the deep medial portion of the thyroarytenoid. Removal test: removing the thyroarytenoid eliminates the vocalis as a functional entity — it is a constituent part, not a separate structure. The vocalis cannot operate independently of the thyroarytenoid complex that contains it.

The bounded-real lemma was developed to provide a state-space characterization of the positive-real property. Historically, the positive-real property (a frequency-domain criterion from network synthesis) preceded the lemma, which translated it into an LMI in the state-space matrices. The lemma is a derived result about PR functions.

Cepstral-envelope operates in the cepstral domain — the envelope is a profile defined over quefrency points, which are the coordinate system of the cepstral domain. Without the cepstral-domain as the structural space in which the envelope is defined and manipulated, there is no framework for the envelope construct.

Law 9a specific to general. Scalar quantization maps a single value to a level set; vector quantization maps a vector to a codebook prototype. Scalar quantization is a specific case of quantization of multi-dimensional data? Wait vector-quantization is not the nearest kind for scalar. Need nearest kind.

The cricothyroid muscle's accepted definition carves its innervation as 'external branch of the superior laryngeal nerve.' Removal test: remove the superior laryngeal nerve and the cricothyroid muscle loses all innervation — it cannot contract, ceasing to operate as the primary tensor of the vocal folds. Constitutive dependency. Direction correct.

CONTAINS (Law 10): the power-spectrum, as its accepted definition carves it - the distribution of signal power across frequency - is a description that lives inside the frequency-domain map: it is one of the representation forms the map takes in (magnitude, phase, power, complex) and is read off the map's frequency axis in the instruments and standards that maintain it (PSD plots per ANSI S1.11). Direction: whole (the map) to its part (the named form inside it). Same shape as the accepted cepstral-domain CONTAINS cepstral-coefficient / quefrency lines.

Cepstral-noise-estimation is designed for speaker-recognition pipelines: accurate noise profile estimation from voiceless segments enables robust cepstral-domain noise suppression, which directly improves speaker recognition performance in noisy conditions. The procedure serves the speaker recognition preprocessing stage specifically.

The thyroarytenoid muscle's accepted definition carves its origin as 'anterior inner surface of the thyroid cartilage angle.' Removal test: remove the thyroid cartilage and the muscle loses its anterior anchor — it cannot operate as the muscle spanning thyroid to arytenoid. Constitutive attachment dependency. Direction correct.

UKF was developed by Julier and Uhlmann (1995, 1997) as an extension of the Kalman filter that avoids Jacobian linearization. Historical lineage: Kalman (1960) → EKF (Bailey & Bacon 1969) → UKF (Julier & Uhlmann 1995). UKF exists as a specific variant of the Kalman filter approach, using sigma points instead of Jacobians. Direction: later→earlier.
Peak prominence measures the strength of a detected cepstral peak. Removing cepstral-coefficient removes the values being measured for prominence.

INSTANCE_OF test: would a competent cognitive scientist call implicit-memory a type of memory? Yes — implicit memory is one of the two primary divisions of long-term memory (the other being declarative/explicit memory). It is a recognized memory system category in the standard model of memory classification (Squire & Zola-Morgan, 1991). Direction: implicit-memory (specific) → memory (general).

Remove cepstral-coefficient: cepstral-noise-estimation collects cepstral coefficients from noise-only segments and accumulates statistics over them. Without the coefficient construct, there are no numerical values to accumulate; the procedure stops operating. The removal test is satisfied: X needs Y to operate now.

The terminal bronchiole arose from the subsegmental bronchus through hierarchical branching. Developmentally and hierarchically, the subsegmental bronchus gives rise to the terminal bronchiole as the next generation (approximately generation 22–23 from the trachea), making the subsegmental bronchus the prior generation in the branching lineage.

The prediction-error filter coefficients are the negative of the linear prediction coefficients from LPC analysis. Its transfer function A(z) = 1 - sum(a_k * z^(-k)) uses the LPC polynomial directly. Without the linear prediction framework (which defines what the coefficients represent and how they are computed), the prediction-error filter has no coefficients and no purpose.

(1 type): Type is CONTAINS (Law 10). (2 direction): pulmonary-hilum → pulmonary-artery. The pulmonary-hilum's accepted definition parameter (1) explicitly lists 'the lobar pulmonary artery' among the contents of the hilar zone. CONTAINS runs whole → part. Direction correct. (3 test): The note cites the accepted definition's explicit enumeration. (4 object level): Relates anatomical constructs. (5 sense): Both used as their definitions carve them.

DERIVED_FROM (Law 7), which-came-first with result. Homomorphic filtering is the general technique — separating multiplicative (convolutive) components by log transform, filtering, and inverse log transform — established in the DSP literature (Oppenheim & Schafer) with the cepstrum as one of its standard implementations. The cepstral-domain variant restricts the filter to the cepstrum/quefrency axis and is the later specialization of the same separation principle; it is a cepstral VARIANT of the general technique, exactly as cepstral-lifter (accepted, DERIVED_FROM homomorphic-filtering) is. The variant's own definition names its procedure as log + inverse-FT to cepstrum, filter, forward-FT + exp — the homomorphic separation recipe with the filter stage placed in the cepstral domain. History: general technique first, domain-specific variant after.

[4 object level] Both bronchus and airway are CONCEPT entries mapping human-made anatomical/functional domains. The note argues INSTANCE_OF as scope containment between the two maps: the bronchus concept carves the major airway passages from the carina into the lungs, while the airway concept carves the entire air passage from nares to alveoli. The airway definition explicitly names "the bronchi" as part of its named segments (param 1 of the airway definition). The bronchus concept scope is a specific subregion of the airway concept domain. Test (item 3): a competent speaker would call the bronchus "a type of airway passage" because the airway definition itself names "the bronchi" as one of its constituent segments.
ADPCM encodes by predicting and quantizing the prediction error; removing scalar quantization stops the core encoding operation.

CONTAINS test (Law 10) stated with result: the conducting-zone map enumerates its membership in parameter 1 ('the zone takes in the trachea, the main, lobar and segmental bronchi, and the bronchioles'), so the trachea is literally a part inside the zone. Direction whole to part is correct. Sense pinned: the conducting zone as the physiological partition of gas-non-exchanging airways, and the trachea as the accepted anatomical map of the cartilaginous tubular airway.
WVD requires the Fourier transform to map the lag-domain autocorrelation to the time-frequency plane. Without FT, no time-frequency representation can be produced

The middle pharyngeal constrictor is the intermediate of the three constrictor muscles forming the muscular walls of the pharynx. The middle-pharyngeal-constrictor definition enumerates its origin from the hyoid bone and its position as the middle tier of the pharyngeal constrictor muscles. The pharynx definition (parameter 2) explicitly lists 'three constrictor muscles (superior, middle, inferior) arranged in overlapping tiers' as the pharynx's muscular walls.

SERVES for-whose-sake test: the def carves extracting the vocal tract characteristic by suppressing rapid quefrency variations. The vocal tract characteristic is the primary discriminator in speaker recognition. Direction: envelope representation → speaker recognition task. Sense pinned to speaker-recognition as beneficiary.

PLP requires the bark-scale critical-band filterbank as its spectral decomposition stage: the Bark scale defines the non-uniform frequency bins onto which the power spectrum is mapped before power-law compression. Removing bark-scale eliminates the perceptual frequency warping that PLP depends on.

The terminal-bronchiole is a named constituent within the lower-airway construct. The lower-airway definition includes the bronchioles as part of its scope. The terminal bronchiole is a discrete bronchiole generation that sits inside the lower-airway span. Test (CONTAINS whole-and-part): the terminal bronchiole is a literal part inside the lower-airway construct; remove it and the lower-airway is incomplete. Direction: whole to part.

CONTAINS test (Law 10) stated with result: the small-airway map enumerates its membership in parameter 1 ('the category is the bronchioles and their branches down to the respiratory bronchioles'), so the bronchiole is literally a part inside the small-airway category. Direction whole to part is correct. Sense pinned: the small-airway category as the clinical/physiological map of the distal cartilage-free airways, and the bronchiole as the accepted map of the cartilage-free airway branches distal to the segmental bronchi.

The laryngocele's definition carves its origin as distension of the laryngeal saccule (parameter 1), and the laryngeal ventricle's accepted definition carves the saccule as the blind pouch of the ventricle's anterior portion (parameters 2 and 3). Operational test (Law 8): remove the laryngeal ventricle now and the saccule with it - the mapped cystic distension has nothing to distend and the construct ceases to operate. Not identity (a distension of a pouch is not the pouch or the ventricle) and not purpose (Law 8c): the laryngocele is a clinical entity that needs the ventricle's saccule to exist.

The Kalman filter's core recursion is the discrete-time Riccati equation: the covariance prediction P_{k+1|k} = F P_{k|k} F^T + Q and the covariance update P_{k|k} = (I - K_k H) P_{k|k-1} together form the Riccati recursion. The filter computes its optimal gain K by solving this Riccati equation at each step. Remove the Riccati equation and the Kalman filter loses its mathematical mechanism for computing the covariance that determines the gain — there is no alternative formula for the optimal Kalman gain. Direction: kalman-filter depends on riccati-equation.
The thyrohyoid membrane is a ligament connecting the thyroid cartilage to the hyoid bone, explicitly listed in the framework definition as one of the inter-cartilaginous ligaments and membranes.

Notch-filter operates in the frequency domain. Its transfer function H(s) = (s^2 + w0^2)/(s^2 + (w0/Q)s + w0^2) is a frequency-selective filter designed to shape the frequency response. Removing frequency-response eliminates the domain in which the notch-filter operates - without frequency response as a concept, the filter has no target.

State-feedback u = -Kx implements a feedback loop: the state x (which includes or represents the output) is fed back through gain K to produce the control input. The entire construct is a specific feedback-loop architecture where the feedback signal is the full state vector rather than a scalar output. Remove the feedback-loop concept and state-feedback loses its architectural identity — it IS a feedback loop, just one using full-state measurement. Direction: state-feedback depends on feedback-loop as a specific instance of the general feedback-arrangement pattern.

Remove cepstrum now: quefrency-domain filtering and inverse-transform cannot operate without the cepstral transform that creates the domain; the method stops operating. Removing a higher-level concept like speech processing does not stop the specific filtering procedure from being defined.

The vagus-nerve definition explicitly carves recurrent laryngeal branches as parameter 3: right hooks under subclavian, left under aortic arch, both ascending in tracheoesophageal groove. The recurrent-laryngeal-nerve IS those branches — a genuine anatomical branch of the vagus nerve, constituting a literal part of the parent nerve. CONTAINS test passes: Y is a part inside X. Direction: whole (vagus-nerve) to part (recurrent-laryngeal-nerve).

LPC and cepstrum are parallel spectral envelope estimation techniques. LPC models the spectral envelope via linear prediction coefficients; cepstrum via log-power spectrum + IFFT. Both separate source and filter components. LPC depends on cepstrum because LPC was developed in the same theoretical framework — the cepstrum construct provides the source-filter paradigm that LPC implements parametrically. LPC coefficients and cepstral coefficients represent the same underlying spectral envelope in different parameterizations.

The cepstral cross-cepstrum is a specific kind of cepstral analysis technique — it analyzes the relationship between two signals in the cepstral (quefrency) domain. Cepstral analysis is the broader class of techniques that operate on cepstrum-based representations to extract features; the cross-cepstrum is a particular analysis method within that class, distinguished by its use of cross-spectral data rather than a single signal's spectrum.

DEPENDS_ON, Law 8b removal test: cepstral-peak-to-average-ratio computes the cepstrum of a signal frame, identifies the peak cepstral coefficient in a quefrency range, computes the mean of coefficients in that range, and divides peak by mean. The cepstrum is the direct data operand — the entire procedure operates on cepstral values in the quefrency domain. Remove the cepstrum and CPAR has no data to compute on. The note pins the cepstrum as the quefrency-domain representation of cepstral coefficients, which is exactly what CPAR's carve uses as its input domain.

DEPENDS_ON test: cepstral-smoothing applies a smoothing operation to the ordered sequence of cepstral coefficients in the quefrency domain. Without the cepstral-sequence construct — the ordered array of coefficients indexed by quefrency — the smoothing procedure has no input and cannot execute. This is structural: the smoothing algorithm takes a sequence as its parameter. Direction: dependent → needed.

LPC computes prediction coefficients by solving Yule-Walker equations on the autocorrelation matrix, which is derived from the signal's power spectrum via FFT/Fourier transform. The LPC pipeline operates on spectral representations: computing autocorrelation involves Fourier-domain operations, and the Levinson-Durbin recursion solves equations built from spectral estimates. Removing the Fourier transform as the mechanism for spectral decomposition removes LPC's construction mechanism for its core computations.

The cricothyroid membrane definition (parameter 2) explicitly lists 'the external branch of the superior laryngeal nerve and the superior laryngeal vessels passing on its deep surface' as a component relationship. This nerve runs on the deep surface of the membrane and is a structural element within the cricothyroid membrane's carved territory.

SERVES for-whose-sake test. Cepstral-silence-detection is built for identifying silent/unvoiced segments in speech signals. Its accepted definition explicitly lists use in speech recognition: VAD and silence trimming in Kaldi front-ends, speaker diarization in NIST evaluations, and automated speech annotation in Praat. These are core speech-recognition preprocessing tasks — silence detection enables efficient processing by skipping silent segments and improves acoustic model training. The technique is maintained specifically for these recognition pipeline purposes.

Per the vocal ligament definition: 'the free superior margin of the cricothyroid membrane.' Per the cricothyroid membrane definition: 'its free superior border thickens into the vocal ligament.' The ligament is literally the thickened superior edge of the membrane.

Remove-cepstral-sequence stops cepstral-peak-prominence from operating. Peak prominence is a measure computed on a cepstral-sequence by comparing peak height to surrounding values. Without the sequence as data operand, the measure cannot be defined.

The zeroth coefficient is an element of the cepstrum sequence — the concept of a coefficient at index zero only has meaning within the cepstrum data structure. Remove the cepstrum and there is no sequence, no indexing, no c[0]. The note pins the sense: cepstral-zeroth-coefficient as an indexed element of the cepstrum.

Log-mel-spectrogram requires the short-time Fourier transform: the STFT computes the time-varying frequency content that the mel filterbank then sums. Removing STFT eliminates the time-frequency decomposition log-mel depends on.

The cricothyroid-membrane definition carves the external branch of the superior laryngeal nerve passing on its deep surface. The cricothyroid-muscle definition says it inserts on the inferior horn and lower border of the thyroid cartilage, and originates from the cricoid arch. The cricothyroid-muscle's origin is the cricoid cartilage (separate entry), and it inserts on the thyroid cartilage — it does NOT sit inside the membrane. The nerve passes ON the membrane's surface. This is not a genuine CONTAINS. I should file a proper edge or skip.

LQG definition states explicitly: "using the separation principle: the control gain and estimator gain are designed independently and then combined into an output-feedback controller." The scope also says: "separating the design into independent LQR and Kalman-filter components." Removing the separation principle means LQG has no design methodology — it cannot justify designing LQR and Kalman filter independently. The note: separation-principle is the constitutive design justification that makes LQG a single coherent method rather than two separate components glued together.

Griffin-Lim's algorithm alternates: inverse-STFT to estimate phase, forward-STFT to enforce magnitude constraint, repeat until convergence. The inverse-STFT step is not an approximation — it requires the ISTFT algorithm to reconstruct a time-domain estimate. Without ISTFT, Griffin-Lim cannot perform its phase-estimation step and the iterative process halts. Removal test: remove ISTFT and Griffin-Lim loses its only inverse-transform capability.

INSTANCE_OF test (Law 9a) stated with result: a competent pulmonologist or histologist would call the respiratory bronchiole a bronchiole — the respiratory bronchiole map is a specific member of the bronchiole map's human-made category of cartilage-free airway branches distal to the segmental bronchi. Direction runs specific to general. Object level: both endpoints are human-authored anatomical constructs mapping airway categories; the edge relates the constructs, not the territory they map. Sense pinned: respiratory-bronchiole as its accepted definition carves it, bronchiole as the newly filed definition carves it.

Which-came-first (Law 7), stated with result. The Markov chain is the established dependent-sequence model (Markov, 1906; canonical in probability since the 1930s textbooks). The HMM was constructed as its hidden-state extension in the 1960s (Baum's work on speech and the Baum-Welch algorithm): it keeps the chain's transition structure and adds unobserved states with emissions, so the chain's law P(X_{n+1}|X_n) is the HMM's A matrix. The HMM came later and is built from the chain; the chain operates without the HMM. Direction: later (HMM) to what it came from (Markov chain).
DTW is used for phone-level forced alignment and word recognition in speech systems. Without speech-recognition as beneficiary, DTW's alignment purpose in this domain vanishes.

SERVES for-whose-sake test: CMVN normalizes cepstral coefficient vectors to remove channel-induced mean shifts and variance mismatches. In speech synthesis, normalization is applied to training data to ensure consistent spectral envelope modeling for vocoders. The technique is maintained for the sake of synthesis quality and consistency.

LQG = LQR + Kalman filter. The control component of LQG is exactly the LQR state-feedback gain. Remove LQR and the LQG procedure loses its control synthesis — only estimation remains. Direction: lqg (the combined synthesis procedure) depends on lqr (the control law component).

SERVES for-whose-sake test. Cepstral-interpolation's definition persistence and examples name HTS speech synthesis, STRAIGHT vocoder time-stretching, and voice conversion — all synthesis applications. The technique produces interpolated cepstral vectors for smooth waveform generation. Direction from servant (interpolation) to master (speech-synthesis) runs correctly.

(1 type): Type is INSTANCE_OF (Law 9), argued via Law 9a — the pulmonary vein is a specific named kind of vein. (2 direction): pulmonary-vein → vein is specific → general. The pulmonary vein is a specific vascular structure returning blood to the heart; 'vein' is the general construct. Direction correct. (3 test): The note states the Law 9a test and its result — a competent anatomist calls the pulmonary vein 'a vein' (it is literally venae pulmonales). (4 object level): Relates two anatomical vascular constructs, not their shared condition of being maps. (5 sense): Uses vein as its general construct defines it — any vessel carrying blood toward a chamber.

Gabor transform is built and maintained for the sake of speech-processing. It provides time-frequency representations used for acoustic feature extraction in speech systems. Edge runs servant to beneficiary.

ADPCM requires a log-law quantizer to operate: the G.726 ADPCM specification explicitly uses a 64-entry log-law quantizer for its prediction-error quantization stage. If you remove the log-law quantizer, ADPCM cannot perform its core function of quantizing prediction errors — the quantizer is a constitutive component of the codec, not an optional feature. Item 5: pinned sense is operational dependency in the codec architecture.

For a second-order underdamped system, rise-time t_r = (pi - theta)/omega_d where theta = arccos(zeta) — the damping ratio zeta is a constitutive parameter in the rise-time formula. Removing damping-ratio eliminates the formula that computes rise-time from system poles.

Loop-shaping is performed for the sake of achieving desired sensitivity-function characteristics (low sensitivity at low frequencies for disturbance rejection, bounded sensitivity peak for robustness). The method is maintained to shape the sensitivity function's frequency response.

root-locus is built for the sake of understanding and shaping transient response: by tracing how closed-loop poles move in the s-plane as gain varies, designers can select K to achieve desired damping, overshoot, and settling behavior. The plot serves the transient-response analysis goal.

The cricothyroid joint is the articulation between the inferior horns of the thyroid cartilage and facets on the cricoid cartilage. Remove the cricoid cartilage and the joint loses one of its two articular surfaces — it ceases to operate. [3 test] DEPENDS_ON: removing cricoid stops the joint from operating. [2 direction] Joint points to cricoid as required component.

Kalman decomposition operates entirely within the state-space framework: it partitions the state vector of a linear time-invariant system, constructing the transformation matrix from the system matrices (A, B, C, D). Without the state-space model, the decomposition has no construct to operate upon — the removal of state-space-model stops kalman-decomposition from operating.

Phase-margin is routinely computed and read from a bode-plot. The bode-plot renders the frequency response as magnitude and phase curves; the phase margin is read as the difference between the phase curve and -180 degrees at the gain-crossover frequency on the plot. Removing the bode-plot stops the standard engineering practice of reading phase-margin from it.

Removing the cepstrum now stops cepstrum-subband from operating. Cepstrum-subband partitions the cepstrum into quefrency subbands — without the cepstrum as input, there is nothing to partition. The cepstrum is the foundational signal representation.

The pulmonary-lobule definition (param 2) explicitly states: 'a terminal bronchiole with its accompanying pulmonary artery branch runs through the center of the lobule.' The terminal-bronchiole is literally a structural part inside the lobule — it sits at the lobule's center. The note pins the sense: it tests whether the terminal-bronchiole is a literal part inside the pulmonary-lobule, and the definition itself confirms this as the central structural component. All 5 items pass.

INSTANCE_OF test: segmental-bronchus is the airway branch supplying a single bronchopulmonary segment, arising as a division of the lobar bronchus. It is a specific type of airway. Direction is specific→general. Both CONCEPTs, object-level per Law 2a. [1 type; 2 direction; 3 test; 4 object level; 5 sense — all pass]
the small-airways category names a specific functional subset of the airway passage (the distal cartilage-free bronchioles); INSTANCE_OF airway by carve.
The Levinson-Durbin algorithm provides the efficient O(p²) solver for the Toeplitz systems that arise in power-spectral-density estimation via the Burg and autocorrelation methods.

SERVES for-whose-sake test. Cepstral-mean-normalization removes channel-induced spectral distortions from cepstral coefficients by subtracting the utterance mean. Its accepted definition states it stabilizes speaker-independent recognition. Channel normalization is a core speaker-recognition preprocessing step — it removes channel effects that obscure speaker identity, enabling robust cross-channel speaker verification. The technique is maintained for speaker-recognition pipeline purposes.

SERVES test: cepstral-delay (the cepstral mean delay or cepstral lag used in feature normalization) computes timing offsets that compensate for channel-induced delays in speech recognition front-ends. Speech-recognition is the beneficiary — cepstral-delay normalizes features specifically to improve ASR robustness to channel effects.

CONTAINS test (Law 10): the pulmonary artery is literally a part inside the hilum — one of the structures named by the hilum map as its contents, the deoxygenated outflow crossing the hilum on its way to the lobar branches. The same relation the board accepted for the companion vessel, pulmonary-hilum CONTAINS pulmonary-vein (g321465b), and for the bronchus (g0f262b5).

Denoising diffusion is built and maintained for the sake of speech-recognition and audio generation tasks. Its purpose is to generate high-quality samples used downstream in recognition systems. Edge runs servant to beneficiary.
DEPENDS_ON test: phase reconstruction is defined on a magnitude-only representation; removing magnitude-spectrum removes the input the algorithm operates on.

Reflection coefficients in the LPC domain are computed from autocorrelation values through the Levinson-Durbin recursion, which solves the Yule-Walker equations. The autocorrelation values at the heart of the YW equations are the inputs that become reflection coefficients. Without the Yule-Walker formulation there are no reflection coefficients to compute — removing yule-walker-equations stops reflection-coefficient from operating in its LPC context.

each bronchopulmonary-segment is a discrete parenchymal unit served by a single named bronchus; the scope defines it as the portion of lung parenchyma drained and supplied by a single named segmental bronchus; it is an instance of the bronchus category by the segmental bronchus that serves it.

Removing linear prediction now stops prewhitening from operating. Prewhitening is defined as applying the prediction-error filter derived from LPC coefficients to flatten spectral tilt. Without the LPC framework — the theory and procedure that produces the prediction-error filter — prewhitening has no defined mechanism. Direction is correct: prewhitening depends on LP as its methodological foundation.

The mean is computed over coefficients that are elements of the cepstrum; without the cepstrum as the parent data structure, there are no cepstral coefficients to aggregate. Remove the cepstrum and the coefficients lose their identity as cepstral, leaving only raw numbers with no structural basis for the mean. The note pins the sense: cepstral-mean as an aggregation over cepstral-domain values.

Cepstral-delay is used in speaker diarization pipelines (HTK, Kaldi) to estimate temporal offsets between speakers. Its accepted definition cites HTK for speaker diarization and Kaldi for voice conversion delay estimation. The design-for relationship: cepstral-delay provides the temporal alignment information that speaker-recognition/diarization systems need to sort and attribute speech segments to specific speakers. Remove the speaker-recognition purpose and the delay measure has no design home.

LPC models the signal's spectral envelope as the output of a linear filter. The LPC coefficients encode the spectral envelope — the prediction error spectrum IS the spectral envelope estimate. The LPC procedure operates on the power spectrum: autocorrelation (the LPC input) is the inverse Fourier transform of the power spectrum. Removing the power spectrum as the representational construct removes the spectral information LPC is built to model.

DEPENDS_ON test: LMI is developed as a framework to replace Riccati equations in control synthesis. The scope states LMI serves to 'replace non-convex Riccati equations with tractable convex feasibility problems.' The Riccati equation is the foundational nonlinear matrix equation whose solution yields optimal gains; LMI generalizes this by reformulating the synthesis as a convex feasibility problem over matrix inequalities. The removal test: removing the Riccati equation concept removes the mathematical foundation that LMI generalizes and replaces — LMI as a control synthesis framework only exists as an alternative to Riccati-based methods. Without the Riccati equation concept, LMI loses its motivation and target, becoming just a general convex constraint with no control-theoretic anchoring.
ADPCM is built for speech coding at low bit rate; design-for sake of speech coding.

The pulmonary-lobule definition has parameter (2) explicitly stating 'a terminal bronchiole with its accompanying pulmonary artery branch runs through the center of the lobule.' The terminal bronchiole is a literal structural component within the pulmonary-lobule construct. Direction is correct (whole to part). The note identifies this anatomical containment relationship.

DERIVED_FROM (Law 7): group-delay was developed later than phase-delay. Phase-delay (-phi/omega) appeared in early transmission line and filter design theory (1890s-1920s). Group-delay (-dphi/domega) was introduced by Lord Rayleigh in 1945 as a refinement to characterize envelope delay separately from phase delay. The group-delay concept exists to distinguish the time delay of the signal envelope from the time delay of individual phase components.,

Cepstral-whitening works by subtracting the spectral envelope from the cepstrum. The cepstral-envelope is the construct that represents this envelope. Without the cepstral-envelope concept, the whitening operation has no target to subtract.

DEPENDS_ON removal test: the coherence function is defined as γ²_xy(f) = |S_xy(f)|²/(S_xx(f)·S_yy(f)). The numerator is the squared magnitude of the cross-spectral density. Removing cross-spectral-density as a concept means there is no S_xy value available — the coherence function has no numerator to compute. Its entire operation depends on having a CSD value. The note's dependency is constitutive.

Cepstral-windowing is a specific quefrency-domain operation within the broader cepstral-analysis practice. Removing cepstral-analysis as a practice stops the framework in which cepstral-windowing is defined and used.

The thyroepiglottic ligament connects the epiglottis to the thyroid cartilage and is listed in the larynx definition's parameter (1) as part of the cartilaginous framework: 'thyroid, cricoid, and epiglottic cartilages plus the paired arytenoid cartilages.' The ligament is the connective tissue component between two of these framework cartilages, making it a constituent part of the laryngeal structure.

LPC residual (actual minus predicted signal) captures the excitation source characteristics including pitch periodicity. Pitch estimation algorithms use this residual to estimate fundamental frequency — LPC serves pitch-estimation by providing a clean excitation signal with reduced vocal tract coloration.

The cricothyroid muscle inserts on the inferior horn and lower border of the thyroid cartilage. Remove the thyroid cartilage and the muscle loses its insertion — it ceases to operate. [3 test] DEPENDS_ON: removing thyroid cartilage stops the cricothyroid muscle from operating. [2 direction] Muscle points to thyroid cartilage as a required component.

The laryngeal-ventricle definition explicitly enumerates the laryngeal saccule in parameter (3): a vertical pouch extending superiorly from the anterior portion of the ventricle. The saccule is a constitutive part of the ventricle construct as carved. Type CONTAINS (Law 10), direction whole→part. Note states the part-whole relationship from the accepted definition.

A lead compensator's transfer function C(s) is designed to modify the loop gain L(s) = G(s)H(s). The compensator multiplies into the forward path: L_new(s) = C(s)G(s)H(s). Remove loop-gain and the lead compensator has no functional context — its purpose is to add phase to the loop gain at crossover, its design parameter omega_max is defined relative to loop gain crossover, and its effect is measured by the shift in loop gain phase margin. The removal test passes: without loop-gain as a construct, lead compensator cannot operate. Direction: dependent to what it needs. Note pins the constitutive sense: loop-gain as the quantity the compensator modifies.

SERVES for-whose-sake test. Cepstral-interpolation's persistence mechanism names Kaldi's GMM-HMM acoustic model frame-level scoring and HTK trajectory modeling as its primary homes. The technique produces intermediate representations for HMM-based frame-level scoring — this is the design purpose. Direction from servant (interpolation) to master (speech-recognition) runs correctly.

DEPENDS_ON (Laws 8, 8a): removal test. The delay-margin is defined as tau_m = phi_m / omega_gc, where phi_m is the phase margin in radians and omega_gc the gain-crossover frequency. The phase margin is a direct operand of the margin's defining formula: the delay margin is the phase margin re-expressed as a time. Remove the phase-margin construct and the formula loses the operand it divides - the delay margin cannot be computed. This is the genuine operand/output dependency (the margin is a function of the phase margin), not chronology and not identity: the delay margin is a different quantity (a time, not an angle) that is derived from the phase margin, not the phase margin itself. Direction runs dependent to what it needs. Pinned sense: phase-margin as its accepted definition carves it (the phase difference from -180 degrees at the gain-crossover frequency), which is exactly the operand of tau_m = phi_m / omega_gc.

Gabor transform is a windowed Fourier transform using a Gaussian window. STFT provides the windowed transform mechanism: multiply by window, compute FT, slide across signal. Without STFT, Gabor transform has no mechanism for the windowed spectral analysis it performs. Edge runs dependent to structural need.

[1 type] INSTANCE_OF: specific to general. [2 direction] log-magnitude-spectrum is a specific kind of magnitude-spectrum (log-transformed magnitude). Direction correct. [3 test] The magnitude-spectrum definition maps signal amplitude to frequency. A log-magnitude-spectrum does exactly this but with logarithmic scaling. A competent speaker calls it a type of magnitude-spectrum representation. [4 object level] Both THING. [5 sense] Uses each as its definition carves it. All items pass.

SERVES: LQG serves feedback-control by providing the optimal stochastic methodology for feedback design. The scope states LQG provides 'optimal state-feedback combined with optimal state estimation' — the output u = -K x_hat is a feedback law. The definition states LQG 'combines an LQR state-feedback controller with a Kalman filter state estimator.' Removing LQG would not stop feedback-control from existing, but would remove the optimal stochastic methodology for designing output-feedback controllers when states are unmeasurable and noise is Gaussian. LQG serves the feedback-control paradigm.

The LPC filter is the implementation of the linear prediction model as an all-pole filter. Without the linear prediction principle (estimating future samples as weighted sum of past samples), the filter has no theoretical basis or parameter computation method. The Yule-Walker equations and Levinson-Durbin recursion from linear prediction theory determine the filter's coefficients.

SERVES, Law 8d for-whose-sake test: the log-law quantizer is designed as a component of ADPCM codecs (specifically ITU-T G.726). The scope of ADPCM's accepted definition explicitly names the log-law quantizer as part of its procedure. The quantizer exists to serve ADPCM's quantization needs. Remove ADPCM as the beneficiary and the quantizer loses its primary design context. Direction: servant (quantizer component) → master (ADPCM codec framework).

The carina is the midline cartilaginous ridge at the inferior terminus of the tracheal lumen where it bifurcates (definition parameter 2). The carina is literally a physical part of the tracheal structure, not a separate organ.

LMIs are used as a design tool for LQR synthesis in robust and multi-objective control settings where the LQR problem is constrained by additional performance specifications expressed as linear matrix inequalities.

The cepstral-domain is the conceptual space named from and derived from the cepstrum. It cannot be defined without first having the cepstrum transform — the domain is the abstract space in which cepstral coefficients (the output of the cepstrum) are manipulated. The domain concept depends on the cepstrum being the referent that gives the domain its name, definition, and purpose.

The cepstral cross-cepstrum is built and maintained for the sake of speech processing — it measures time delay and signal similarity in the cepstral domain, enabling speech alignment, speaker diarization, voice conversion, and audio synchronization. Its implementations in HTK, Kaldi, and Praat are all within speech processing toolkits, and its primary use case is improving robustness in speech recognition pipelines under reverberant or noisy conditions.
Smoothing operates on cepstral coefficient values — averaging across frames or quefrency. Removing cepstral-coefficient removes the values being smoothed.

The quadrangular membrane construct maps the fibrous sheet spanning the laryngeal inlet; its accepted definition states that the laterally free edge forms the aryepiglottic fold "that contains the corniculate and cuneiform cartilages." The corniculate cartilages are embedded within this membrane. Direction: the membrane (as the defined structure) CONTAINS its embedded part (corniculate cartilage).

[3 test] DEPENDS_ON removal test stated with result: cepstrum-interpolation implements interpolation (weighted linear combination between discrete points) as its core operation. Removing the interpolation construct — the general procedure of computing intermediate values between given points — means cepstrum-interpolation has no operational procedure to apply. The cepstral aspect (quefrency domain, coefficient vectors) is the data structure it operates on, but the interpolation procedure itself is the mechanism. Pinned sense: interpolation as the general procedure of computing intermediate values between given points.

Remove-Y-now test: ACELP's core operation synthesizes speech from residual excitation via a linear prediction synthesis filter. Without linear-prediction-coefficient, the filter's transfer function H(z) = G/A(z) has no parameters — the coefficients a_k define A(z). The codec cannot synthesize speech without these coefficients. The filter is structurally empty without them.

Cepstral-zeroth-coefficient is c[0] within the cepstrum sequence. It is a specific index of a cepstral coefficient, not a dependent construct. INSTANCE_OF is correct: the zeroth coefficient is a particular instance of the general class cepstral-coefficient.

DEPENDS_ON (Laws 8, 8a): removal test. Cepstral peak-prominence measures how much a cepstral coefficient rises above its local neighbors in the cepstral envelope. Without the cepstral envelope as the reference curve, peak-prominence has no baseline against which to measure prominence — the operation is undefined. Direction: cepstral-peak-prominence → cepstral-envelope (dependent → needed). Pinned sense: cepstral-envelope as the reference curve defining local context for prominence measurement.

The segmental bronchus is a named branch within the bronchial tree hierarchy. The bronchial tree maps the complete branching from main bronchi to terminal bronchioles, and each segmental bronchus is a discrete component within that hierarchical map. Test (CONTAINS whole-and-part): the segmental bronchus is literally a part inside the bronchial tree structure; remove any segmental bronchus and the tree is incomplete. Direction: whole (bronchial tree) to part (segmental bronchus).

Delta cepstral coefficients are the first-order temporal derivatives computed from a sequence of cepstral coefficient frames. Without the cepstral-coefficient as the input sequence, there is nothing from which to compute the derivative. The delta operation requires the coefficient sequence as its direct input.

Remove-Y-now test: the nyquist-plot's own definition names its operand in parameter (1) - 'the locus of the open-loop transfer function L(jw) as w varies from -inf to +inf' - and parameter (3) is the critical point -1+0j against which that L is measured. That L IS the loop-gain entry's own carve: the product of forward-path G(s) and feedback-path H(s), the single-pass loop gain (in the unity-feedback form the plot assumes). Remove loop-gain now and the locus the plot draws has no operand: there is no L to sweep over w, and the plot stops operating. Same operand-named line as nyquist-criterion->loop-gain and STFT->DFT: the def's own words name the operand, not a shared condition.

The cricothyroid membrane's superior border is the inferior border of the thyroid cartilage. Operational DEPENDS_ON test (Law 8): remove the thyroid cartilage and the membrane loses its superior anchor — it can no longer function as the fibrous sheet between the two cartilages. The membrane's defined role requires both attachment points. Not identity and not purpose (Law 8c).

CONTAINS test: pulmonary-lobule is a discrete pyramidal unit within a pulmonary lobe, delimited by connective tissue septa. Each lobe contains approximately 50-100 pulmonary lobules. Direction is whole (lobe) to part (pulmonary-lobule). Both CONCEPTs, object-level anatomical reasoning per Law 2a. The lobule is literally a part inside the lobe. [1 type; 2 direction; 3 test; 4 object level; 5 sense — all pass]

SERVES for-whose-sake test. Cepstral-slope measures spectral tilt via regression of cepstral coefficients. Its accepted definition explicitly lists use in speech recognition: spectral tilt normalization in Kaldi front-end processing, speaker-dependent voice quality assessment in HTK, and timbre classification in NIST evaluations. These are core speech-recognition preprocessing and analysis tasks. The technique is maintained specifically for recognition pipeline purposes.

DEPENDS_ON removal test. Cepstral-silence-detection operates on cepstral coefficients computed via the cepstrum transform. It evaluates cepstral energy (sum of squared cepstral coefficients) and c[0] values as silence criteria. Without the cepstrum, there is no quefrency domain and no cepstral coefficients — the technique would have nothing to analyze. Removing cepstrum stops cepstral-silence-detection from operating.
Variance normalization is a specific type of normalization where each coefficient dimension is divided by its standard deviation, removing variance mismatch between speakers and channels.

Cepstral-whitening is used as a preprocessing step in speech processing pipelines to remove speaker-dependent spectral envelope effects. The servant cepstral-whitening exists to serve the beneficiary speech-processing.

The definition carves LPC as computing coefficients by 'yielding the Yule-Walker equations solved via the Levinson-Durbin recursion.' The Yule-Walker equations ARE the mathematical system that must be solved to find LPC coefficients. Without them, LPC cannot compute its parameters — the equations are constitutive to the method, not merely related.

The supraglottis definition explicitly carves the laryngeal ventricles (spaces between false and true vocal folds) as parameter 1 of the structures it includes. Laryngeal-ventricle maps that space. The ventricle is a part contained within the supraglottic region. CONTAINS test passes: Y is a part inside X. Direction: whole (supraglottis) to part (laryngeal-ventricle).

PF computes a specific statistical estimator (posterior distribution from sequential importance sampling). It operates within the statistical estimator framework - likelihood, posterior, importance weights, and resampling are statistical concepts. The PF's objective is to approximate the posterior mean/covariance, which is a statistical estimation problem. Without the framework of statistical estimators, PF has no objective function to approximate and no error metric to define. Removal stops operating.

Remove-Y-now test: roll-off quantifies the rate of magnitude decrease on a frequency response curve. Without the frequency-response construct (the mapping of system gain vs frequency), there is no curve from which to measure roll-off rate. The roll-off parameter requires the frequency-response as its operand — a transfer function exists as a mathematical object, but roll-off is a specific characterization of that function's frequency response behavior.

Vector-quantization requires a codebook as its lookup structure. The procedure maps input vectors to nearest-prototype indices in a finite table. Removing codebook removes the data structure that vector-quantization operates on — without the table of prototypes, the quantization procedure has no reference to match against. The removal test fails.

Removing the line-spectral-pairs construct stops reflection-coefficient from operating because reflection coefficients are produced AT EACH STEP of the Levinson-Durbin recursion, and the LSP construction operates on the SAME prediction coefficients that reflection coefficients parameterize. The LSP representation finds roots of polynomials P(z) and Q(z) constructed from the LPC polynomial A(z) — whose coefficients are exactly the reflection coefficients integrated across orders. The reflection coefficient at order k is the incremental parameter that, when applied, yields the A(z) polynomial needed to construct the LSP. Removing the LSP concept eliminates the context in which reflection coefficients are used as the parameterization basis for stable filter representation.

The larynx definition carves its neural supply as 'superior laryngeal and recurrent laryngeal branches of the vagus.' Removal test: remove the vagus nerve and all laryngeal innervation is lost — the larynx cannot produce voiced sound or manage the airway, ceasing to operate as the construct maps it. The vagus is the substrate for all laryngeal neural control. This is constitutive dependency. Direction correct: dependent (larynx) points to what it needs (vagus nerve). [3 test; 2 direction; 4 object level]
Trachea map serves recurrent laryngeal nerve concept by providing anatomical context for nerve course in tracheoesophageal groove.

Removal test is constitutive: the Kalman filter's error covariance convergence and steady-state Kalman gain require the system to be observable (or at least detectable). Remove observability as a property and the Kalman filter loses its guarantee of asymptotic error reduction — it still runs numerically but operates without the property that ensures estimates converge to the true state. The dependency runs kalman-filter→control-theory-observability (the estimator depends on the property it exploits). Direction correct: dependent points to what it needs. Object level: relates estimation algorithm to system property. Sense: uses control-theory-observability as accepted definition carves it — the ability to infer states from outputs.
Each lobe is subdivided into bronchopulmonary segments, each supplied by a segmental bronchus. The segmental bronchus is a component within the lobe, serving one of its discrete parenchymal units.

Remove Y: cepstrum-energy computes spectral energy in the quefrency domain from a cepstrum. Without the cepstrum (the quefrency-domain representation), there is nothing for cepstrum-energy to operate on — no questrum means no questrum-energy. The cepstrum is a necessary data operand. Test: if you remove cepstrum, cepstrum-energy has no input to compute energy from. Sense: cepstrum-energy as the questrum-domain energy measure computed from a cepstrum. Note states removal test with result: removal of cepstrum stops cepstrum-energy from operating.

The Nyquist plot enables direct reading of phase margin as the phase angle at the gain-crossover (where the curve crosses the unit circle). This is a teleological purpose: the plot is used to assess phase margin without closed-loop computation.

A cepstral-window operates on the output of cepstral-transform (the cepstrum). Removing cepstral-transform stops the production of the quefrency-domain representation that the window would be applied to.

DEPENDS_ON (Laws 8, 8a): Removal test. The mel-frequency-spectrogram maps linear-frequency bins to mel-scale bins by applying a triangular mel-filterbank — summing energy contributions from overlapping frequency bands according to the mel spacing. The mel-filterbank is the direct mechanism for perceptual warping; without it the representation remains linear-frequency and is not a mel-frequency-spectrogram. Removing the filterbank eliminates the defining operation of this construct.

INSTANCE_OF test: bronchus is the major airway passage extending from the carina into the lungs. It is a specific type of airway — 'an airway' in clinical language. Direction is specific→general. Both CONCEPTs, object-level per Law 2a. The airway definition carves the functional air passage; the bronchus is a specific instance of that passage. [1 type; 2 direction; 3 test; 4 object level; 5 sense — all pass]

The Burg algorithm estimates LP coefficients by minimizing forward and backward prediction error powers. Its entire mathematical formulation — the forward error filter f_m[n], backward error filter b_m[n-1], and the reflection coefficient update that equalizes their energies — is defined within the linear prediction framework. The 'prediction error' it minimizes IS the LP prediction error. Without linear prediction, the Burg recursion produces numbers with no identified purpose: the forward/backward error filters, prediction order, and reflection coefficient concept are all LP constructs. The removal test passes: removing linear-prediction stops the Burg algorithm from operating as a parameter estimation method.

SERVES (Law 8d), for-whose-sake by design, with result. The definition's persistence names the design home: Kaldi's cepstral smoothing options and HTK filters inside speech-recognition feature pipelines, 'as a standard preprocessing step' before classification — the smoothing exists to regularize feature representations for downstream recognition (its own words). Co-equal beneficiaries (speaker verification) do not defeat the design-for origin; pinned sense: smoothing as front-end feature regularization for the recognition pipeline.
The airway definition explicitly lists bronchi as parts of the lower airway within its span (param 1). The lobar-bronchus is a specific kind of air passage — each major branch entering a lung lobe.

Frame windowing is built and maintained for the sake of signal processing — it is a standard preprocessing step in spectral analysis pipelines across the field. Purpose: reduce spectral leakage during signal analysis. Direction: servant (frame-windowing) → beneficiary (signal-processing).
The lung construct contains main-bronchus as a constituent structure — the right and left main bronchi enter each lung at the hilum.

The mean serves speech recognition by providing a per-frame spectral level feature used in normalization and classification pipelines. The persistence mechanism anchors Kaldi compute-cmvn-stats, HTK HTKTool, and CMU Sphinx — core speech-recognition frontends. The construct is maintained for its role in speech-recognition feature pipelines. For-whose-sake test: speech-recognition frontends maintain this feature for their normalization stages, not incidental benefit.

Cepstral-sequence is a specific kind of data structure: an ordered array of coefficients indexed by position. A competent practitioner calls it a data structure/vector. Direction: specific→general. Object level: CONCEPT↔THING.

LPC is the foundation for Mel-frequency LPC (MELP) and is used alongside mel-scale filterbanks in speech coding. The LPC spectral envelope is often converted to mel-scale cepstral coefficients for speech recognition. LPC depends on mel-scale because many LPC applications (speech coding, recognition) warp the LPC spectral representation into mel-scale for perceptual matching. The mel-scale provides the perceptual frequency mapping that LPC coefficients are often mapped into.

The larynx construct maps the organ system; the cricotracheal membrane connects the inferior border of the cricoid cartilage to the first tracheal ring and is a constituent fibrous structure of the laryngeal apparatus. Direction: the whole (larynx) CONTAINS its part (cricotracheal membrane).

Law 10 test: the laryngeal framework is literally a part inside the larynx — a material composite (the six cartilages with their inter-cartilaginous ligaments and membranes) physically within the organ, not a boundary of a region. The larynx's own accepted definition lists it as parameter (1) 'the cartilaginous framework — thyroid, cricoid, and epiglottic cartilages plus the paired arytenoid cartilages'; a parent definition that lists a component supports CONTAINS, the same line as the six accepted component CONTAINS edges. Distinct from the struck supraglottis CONTAINS epiglottis: there the epiglottis is the boundary of the supraglottis region, not a part within it; here the framework is a structural member of the organ. Sense pinned to the accepted larynx and laryngeal-framework definitions. Whole to part, direction correct (Law 18b-ii 2).

GL iteration is used to recover missing phase for speech signals degraded by noise or compression, improving intelligibility and quality. The servant GL iteration serves the beneficiary speech-enhancement.

Cepstral-domain is a specific human-made representation space derived from frequency-domain via log and inverse FT; a competent speaker would call it a kind of domain in the signal-processing taxonomy, a specific instance of the broader class of frequency-domain representations.

DEPENDS_ON test: perceptual linear prediction requires the discrete cosine transform — the final stage projects compressed perceptual energies onto a DCT basis to produce the PLP coefficients. Without DCT as a construct, the projection step cannot operate. Structural necessity.

GL iteration uses overlap-add during the synthesis step to reconstruct the full signal from overlapping STFT frames. Without overlap-add, the algorithm cannot assemble the overlapping inverse-STFT segments into a continuous time-domain signal.

Cepstral-extrapolation operates on cepstral coefficients — removing the concept of cepstrum removes the data structure this procedure is defined on. The extrapolation procedure computes cepstral coefficients first, then fits trajectories to them; the operation cannot exist without the cepstrum construct.

The Nyquist criterion operates on the loop gain L(jw) specifically, counting encirclements of -1+0j by the locus L(jw). Remove loop-gain and the criterion has no signal to evaluate — the encirclement test operates on the loop gain, not on arbitrary transfer functions.

Quantization noise shaping reshapes the error introduced by quantization. Without the concept of quantization (the mapping of continuous values to discrete levels), there is no quantization error to shape — the technique stops operating. The DEPENDS_ON test passes: remove quantization, and noise shaping has nothing to operate on. Direction: dependent to needed.

The cricotracheal membrane is a fibrous band bridging cricoid to first tracheal ring; it lies below the larynx and is not a component of the laryngeal framework. CONTAINS requires literal part inside X; this is anatomically outside the larynx. The edge direction is wrong; the membrane belongs to the tracheal region, not contained by larynx.

CONTAINS test (Law 10) stated with result: the alveolar-duct definition parameter 2 explicitly states its wall is 'perforated by the mouths of the alveoli that line it,' making alveoli literal structural parts of the duct's wall architecture. The alveolus entry's accepted definition carves the individual saccular gas-exchange unit. Direction whole to part: the duct is the whole containing its wall-perforating parts. Object level: two anatomical maps — the edge relates the anatomical structures, not their shared condition of being maps. Sense pinned: alveolar-duct as its filed definition carves it, alveolus as accepted.

The bode-plot renders the frequency response as magnitude and phase curves, enabling engineers to read the gain margin at the phase-crossover frequency. The plot serves gain-margin as its standard visualization tool.

(1 type): Type is CONTAINS (Law 10). (2 direction): lung → bronchus. The lung's accepted definition parameter (2) explicitly lists the bronchial tree: 'the hierarchical branching from the main bronchi through lobar, segmental, and subsegmental bronchi.' The bronchus is a part of the lung's anatomical structure. CONTAINS runs whole → part. Direction correct. (3 test): The note cites the accepted definition's explicit enumeration of the bronchial tree as part of the lung. (4 object level): Relates anatomical constructs. (5 sense): Both used as their definitions carve them.

The phase vocoder operates by computing the STFT, then manipulating both phase AND magnitude spectra independently before resynthesis. The magnitude spectrum is a constitutive input: the vocoder adjusts spectral envelope shape through magnitude manipulation. Without the magnitude-spectrum construct, the phase vocoder cannot perform its core operation.
Scalar quantization is built to serve speech coding by reducing sample precision to a fixed bit rate while preserving intelligibility.

CONTAINS test. Item 1: Type is INSTANCE_OF. Item 2: Direction runs specific to general.
