Item 3: Note states the INSTANCE_OF test -- a competent speaker would call a segmental bronchus a bronchus; it is a named branch of the main bronchus serving a bronchopulmonary segment, fitting the accepted bronchus definition. Item 4: Object level is two anatomical constructs. Item 5: Sense pinned -- segmental-bronchus as its filed definition carves it; bronchus as accepted definition carves it.

The Gabor transform computes a sliding-window Fourier transform using a Gaussian window. Its core operation IS the Fourier transform (DFT or FT) at each window position. Without the Fourier transform, the Gabor transform has no computational mechanism.

alveolar-duct is a specific anatomical structure of the gas-exchange airways. airway is the general functional classification that names every air-bearing space from the nares to the alveoli. This is a specific-to-general INSTANCE_OF: the alveolar-duct is one of the structures that falls under the airway category, and airway is the nearest accepted kind.

The bronchial-tree definition explicitly lists terminal-bronchioles as part of its hierarchy (param 1): main bronchi → lobar bronchi → segmental → subsegmental → cartilage-free bronchioles and respiratory bronchioles. The terminal-bronchiole is literally a rung inside the tree structure — the last conducting airway generation before gas exchange begins.

Law 10 test stated with its result: the cricotracheal membrane is literally a component inside the framework as the framework's accepted carve presents it. The framework's accepted definition names it by name among the joining elements: the six cartilages 'joined by the thyrohyoid, cricothyroid, cricotracheal, and thyroepiglottic ligaments and membranes.' The membrane's own carve places it between the inferior border of the cricoid lamina (a framework cartilage) and the first tracheal ring, so it is one of the inter-cartilaginous membranes that fix the scaffold's relations. It is a direct named part of the scaffold, not a boundary of a region. Direction whole to part.

Cepstral subband decomposition partitions cepstral coefficients into subbands. The definition states it operates on "the N cepstral coefficients" — removing cepstral-coefficient means there is nothing to partition. DEPENDS_ON test passes: without cepstral-coefficients, cepstral-subband cannot operate. Direction: dependent to needed.

INSTANCE_OF test: trachea is the tubular airway connecting the larynx to the main bronchi. It is a specific type of airway passage — a competent speaker would call it 'an airway.' Direction is specific→general, correct for INSTANCE_OF. Both are CONCEPTs mapping anatomical territory — object-level per Law 2a. The airway definition carves the functional air passage; the trachea is a specific instance of that passage. [1 type; 2 direction; 3 test; 4 object level; 5 sense — all pass]
LQR as a synthesis procedure for full-state feedback does not depend on Kalman filter. The dependency is false: LQR operates with full state measurement. The edge should not be filed.

SERVES test: log-mel spectrograms are built for speech recognition — the scope explicitly states they are 'well-suited as input for neural network acoustic models.' Their sustained practice is in ASR pipelines (Kaldi Librispeech ASR, torchaudio speech training). Direction: servant→beneficiary.

The small-gain theorem is a specific mathematical lemma: a proven stability condition for feedback interconnections. It is cited as a named lemma in robust control texts (Zhou-Doyle-Glover, Vidyasagar) and used as a foundational result in robust control synthesis. A competent control theorist calls it 'a theorem' or 'a lemma' — it is a subsidiary result used inside larger arguments (H-infinity design, adaptive control).

SERVES for-whose-sake test. Cepstral-liftering applies window-like functions in the cepstral domain to selectively smooth or accentuate cepstral coefficients. Its accepted definition states it enables voice conversion and spectral smoothing — both are core speaker-recognition and speaker-verification techniques. Voice conversion modifies speaker identity characteristics, and spectral smoothing improves feature consistency across recording conditions, a fundamental speaker-recognition requirement. The technique is maintained for speaker-recognition pipeline purposes.

The airway category carves the entire passage air takes from the outside world to the alveoli. The alveolar duct is the thin-walled air-bearing segment whose wall is studded with alveoli, situated distal to the respiratory bronchiole. It carries air and is explicitly within the airway span.

The Bass-Gura formula requires the state-space matrices (A, b) and the observability matrix of (A, c); without a state-space model there is no system to compute the characteristic polynomial coefficients or the observability matrix.

Delta features (temporal derivatives of MFCCs) are a standard feature input for triphone and phoneme recognition. Without speech-recognition as beneficiary, the purpose of computing these velocity features vanishes.

DEPENDS_ON test: cepstrum-smoothing operates in the cepstral domain — the quefrency-domain representation where coefficients are indexed by quefrency. Without the cepstral-domain construct defining that representational space, the smoothing technique has no domain to operate in. The smoothing procedure requires a domain to define its windowing. Direction: dependent → needed.

SERVES: LMI provides the convex optimization framework for computing state-feedback gain matrices. The scope states LMI 'serves as the unifying computational framework for... pole placement' — LMI-based state-feedback design formulates gain selection as a convex feasibility problem over matrix inequalities, which is solvable by interior-point methods. The removal test: without LMI as a computational framework, the state-feedback gain designer loses the tractable convex optimization method for multi-objective gain synthesis. The gain designer would fall back to Riccati-based methods (which cannot handle multi-objective constraints) or open-loop pole placement (which ignores robustness). LMI serves state-feedback by providing the computational mechanism for modern robust gain synthesis.

root-locus serves phase-margin assessment: the pole trajectories reveal how closed-loop poles approach the imaginary axis as gain increases, allowing designers to choose K that maintains adequate phase margin. The plot is the primary tool for gain selection to preserve phase margin.

INSTANCE_OF test: spectral-histogram is a specific spectral feature that computes a fixed set of statistical moments over the power spectrum. The general concept of spectral-feature carves the broader class of per-bin or per-frame spectral measures. Direction: specific (fixed five-element histogram) → general (arbitrary spectral feature). Sense: both refer to spectral features used in audio/MIR.

Named-operand shape, the accepted kalman-filter twin (g282dce048, ACCEPTED). state-feedback's carve defines its operation on the state-space state: u = -K x, with K designed to place the eigenvalues of A-BK — A and B are the state-space-model's parameter matrices. Remove the state-space representation and there is no state vector to close on and no A-BK to place: the law has no object to operate on. The carve admits no alternate parameterization (no transfer-function route). If the state-feedback entry is rejected, this edge voids with it, no penalty.

LPC analysis provides the parametric spectral envelope representation that formant vocoders use for source-filter synthesis. The vocoder does not depend on LPC (it can use STFT magnitude), but LPC is applied to serve vocoder analysis because its all-pole model gives compact formant parameters for voice transformation.

LPC coefficients are the specific numerical parameters produced by linear prediction analysis. They are the solution to the Yule-Walker equations and represent the prediction weights that define the all-pole filter.

DEPENDS_ON test: cepstral-coefficients (the multiset of individual cepstral coefficients) requires the cepstral-coefficient construct as its element type. Without the singular coefficient construct, the plural construct has no referent — there is no collection to speak of. The set depends on its members. Direction: dependent (collection) → needed (element type).

The larynx definition lists the paired arytenoid cartilages as part of the cartilaginous framework (parameter 1). The arytenoid cartilages are literally physical parts contained within the laryngeal structure.

Lattice-structure implements linear prediction analysis/synthesis in cascade form. Removing linear-prediction removes the mathematical framework (prediction equation, Yule-Walker equations) that defines what the filter computes. Without linear prediction, the lattice has no purpose — it is merely a cascade with no connection to prediction. The removal test fails.

Reflection coefficients are parameters that measure correlation between forward and backward linear prediction errors at each order. They are defined within the LPC domain and serve as stability parameters for linear prediction filters. Without the concept of linear prediction, reflection coefficients lose their entire meaning, purpose, and domain of application — the LPC framework is what gives them definition and use. Removal test: removing linear prediction as a concept stops reflection coefficients from operating, since they are intrinsically prediction-error parameters with no independent function outside the LPC context.

SERVES (Law 8d), for-whose-sake by design. Cepstral-energy is computed as a standard feature in speech recognition front-end pipelines (Kaldi featbin/compute-energies) for use in VAD thresholds and acoustic modeling. The energy measure is built into these pipelines for speech recognition — removing the speech recognition purpose would leave no design home for cepstral-energy as a standardized front-end feature. Pinned sense: cepstral-energy as a front-end feature for speech recognition.

INSTANCE_OF test: spectral-difference-vector is a specific spectral feature that computes per-bin absolute differences between consecutive power spectra. The general concept of spectral-feature carves the broader class of per-bin or per-frame spectral measures. Direction: specific (per-bin difference measure) → general (any spectral feature). Sense: both refer to spectral features used in audio analysis.

An observer-controller is the combined construct of state-observer and state-feedback, designed via the separation principle. Remove the separation principle and there is no theorem guaranteeing that independent tuning of observer and controller yields the correct combined eigenvalue structure. Direction: observer-controller (the design methodology) depends on separation-principle (the theorem enabling the design).

Cepstrum-decorrelation applies its linear transform directly to cepstral coefficients (the input feature matrix). Removing cepstral-coefficient now stops the decorrelation from operating: there are no coefficients to decorrelate. The note states the removal test (removing coefficients), the result (stops operating), and the mechanism (no input data). Direction is correct: the procedure points to the data it operates on.

The corniculate cartilages sit atop the apices of the arytenoid cartilages. Operational DEPENDS_ON test (Law 8): remove the arytenoid cartilages and the corniculate cartilages lose their foundation — they have no independent structural position without the arytenoid apices they rest upon. The corniculate's defined role (forming part of the posterior laryngeal inlet) requires the arytenoid position as its base. Not identity (elastic cartilage on top of cartilage — two distinct structures with different positions and definitions).
i-vector provides a speaker embedding representation used as input to speaker recognition systems for identification and verification tasks.

The core mechanism of glottal-inverse-filtering is inverse filtering of the speech signal. Without inverse filtering to remove the estimated vocal-tract transfer function, the technique has no operation. The inverse filter H_inv(z) = 1/H(z) is applied to the speech signal to produce the residual. Without this operation, glottal flow estimation is impossible.

The zeroth coefficient is an indexed element of the cepstrum sequence. It is a specific instance of the cepstrum data structure, not a dependent operation. INSTANCE_OF runs specific to general: c[0] is a particular element of the cepstrum.
The larynx contains the vocal folds as integral structures within the glottic compartment — the paired mucosal folds that vibrate to produce voiced sound.

UKF computes a specific statistical estimator (posterior mean/covariance from sigma-point propagation). It operates within the statistical estimator framework — the posterior, likelihood, and error covariance are statistical concepts. Without the framework of statistical estimators, UKF has no objective function to minimize, no error metric to define, and no sampling distribution to reason about. Removal stops operating.

CONTAINS test (Law 10) stated with result: the lobe's own filed definition enumerates the segments in parameter 3 ('each lobe is subdivided into bronchopulmonary segments served by segmental bronchi, so the lobe is the intermediate level of the bronchial tree's accepted hierarchy'), so the segment is enumerated in the whole's own parameters; the lobe's near-miss clause names the segment as the smaller division within a lobe, confirming the containment boundary the note claims. Direction whole to part (Law 10). Object level: the two anatomical constructs, not their shared condition of being maps (Law 2a). Sense pinned: lobe as its filed definition carves it (the division set off by interlobar fissures); bronchopulmonary-segment as its filed definition carves it (the discrete unit served by one segmental bronchus). Both endpoints provisional: if either is rejected this edge voids in the same ruling, no penalty (Law 30).

DEPENDS_ON (Laws 8, 8a), removal test with result. The definition's own procedure names the operand: step 1 computes cepstral coefficients c[n] for consecutive frames, step 2 takes their first difference, step 3 norms it. The rate is a function of the coefficient sequence — remove the coefficients and there is no delta to norm; the measure stops operating, not merely being sayable. Pinned sense: the coefficient as the frame-wise data vector the difference operates on (the aggregate-rate sense, not per-coefficient delta-cepstral-coefficients).

Cepstral delay computes the complex cepstrum of both signals and then the cross-cepstrum to find the peak quefrency corresponding to the delay. Without the cepstrum transform, the method cannot compute its required inputs.

Detectability is the observability analogue of stabilizability: a system is detectable iff all unobservable modes are stable. The removal test is decisive — remove observability and detectability has no meaning, because it is defined as 'all unobservable modes are stable.' Direction: detectability depends on observability. The same structural dependency that links stabilizability→controllability links detectability→observability.

An observer-controller combines a state observer with state feedback, u = -K x_hat. Both the state-space model (A, B, C matrices) and the state vector x are required for the observer dynamics dx_hat/dt = A x_hat + B u + L(y - C x_hat) and the feedback law. Remove the state-space model and the observer-controller has no plant to estimate or control. The removal test passes: without state-space models, the observer cannot propagate and the feedback gain cannot be computed. Direction: dependent to what it needs. Note pins the constitutive sense: state-space model as the structural representation the observer-controller operates on.

Gain-crossover-frequency is defined as the frequency where |L(jω)| = 1 (0 dB). This magnitude is a value on the frequency response curve of the loop gain L(s). Remove the concept of frequency-response and the gain-crossover frequency has no curve on which to be defined — it is a specific point (unity-magnitude crossing) on a broader function (the frequency response). The removal test passes: without frequency-response, there is no magnitude-vs-frequency function to find the unity crossing on. Direction: gain-crossover-frequency depends on frequency-response.

The pulmonary-acinus definition includes respiratory-bronchiole as its proximal constituent — the transitional conducting-to-gas-exchange airway. Direction: whole (pulmonary-acinus) to part (respiratory-bronchiole). This is literal parthood: the acinus comprises this airway as one of its three structural components.

INSTANCE_OF test: diffusion-model is a specific generative modeling technique that synthesizes data through iterative denoising. The general concept of generative-model carves the broader class of probabilistic models designed to generate new samples from learned data distributions. Direction: specific (iterative denoising approach) → general (any generative probabilistic model). Sense: uses each entry as its accepted definition carves it.

DEPENDS_ON removal test. The cepstral-lifter is a filter operating in the quefrency domain that modifies cepstral coefficients. The cepstral-transform is the procedure that converts time-domain signals into cepstral representations — the lifter needs cepstral coefficients to operate on. The cepstral-transform produces the cepstral coefficients that the lifter processes. Without the cepstral-transform, the lifter has no cepstral data to filter. Direction: filter to the procedure producing its data.

DEPENDS_ON (Laws 8, 8a): Removal test. Cepstral subtraction operates in the quefrency domain to separate noise from speech by identifying quefrency ranges where noise dominates. The technique uses quefrency-domain windowing (a cepstral lifter) to isolate the noise-dominated region before subtraction. Without the cepstral-lifter construct, there is no mechanism to selectively retain or suppress quefrency components. Removing cepstral-lifter: no way to isolate quefrency regions for noise estimation, subtraction loses its selective mechanism. Direction: cepstral-subtraction → cepstral-lifter (dependent technique → the construct that enables its quefrency-domain operation).

The constant-q-derived window was created by McSweeney in the development of the Constant-Q Toolbox (CQT), which was first released around 2009-2012. The CQT itself — the constant-Q transform — predates the derived window as the foundational transform; the derived window was developed specifically as a normalization constraint for the CQT to ensure perfect reconstruction via overlap-add. The CQT concept (log-frequency decomposition with constant quality factor) was established in the signal processing literature before the specific Kaiser-Bessel-derived normalization window was created to solve the perfect reconstruction problem in CQT implementations. The CQT came first as the analytical framework; the derived window came later as a computational refinement to that framework.

Remove-cepstral-sequence stops cepstral-mean-normalization from operating. CMN operates by computing the mean of a cepstral-sequence over time and subtracting it. Without the cepstral-sequence construct as the data operand, normalization cannot occur.

The excitation-model requires a voicing decision (voiced/unvoiced/silent) per frame to select between periodic pulse excitation and noise-based excitation. Without voicing decision, the model cannot switch between the fundamentally different excitation strategies for voiced vs unvoiced segments.

Loop-shaping shapes the complementary sensitivity function (T(s) = L(s)/(1+L(s))) to bound high-frequency noise amplification. The method is maintained for the sake of achieving desired complementary sensitivity characteristics.
SERVES test: cepstral-normalization is built and maintained for the sake of robust speech recognition.

The separation principle combines state-feedback design with state-observer design. Its theorem states that the closed-loop eigenvalues are the union of (A-BK) and (A-LC) — both A-BK (from state-feedback) and A-LC (from state-observer) are constitutive operands. Remove state-feedback and there is no K gain matrix, no A-BK eigenvalue set, and the union theorem has half its operands. The removal test passes constitutively. Direction: separation-principle depends on state-feedback.

The interarytenoid muscle's accepted definition carves its innervation as 'recurrent laryngeal nerve.' Removal test: remove the recurrent laryngeal nerve and the muscle loses all innervation — it cannot contract, ceasing to operate as an adductor of the arytenoids. Constitutive dependency. Direction correct.

DEPENDS_ON (Laws 8, 8a): Removal test. The cepstral-transform operates by: (1) computing power spectral density via FFT, (2) taking the logarithm of the spectrum, (3) applying inverse FFT. The logarithm operation is constitutive — it is the mechanism that converts multiplicative convolution into additive decomposition, enabling the inverse FFT to separate source and filter components. Removing logarithm: the transform cannot convert convolved signals into additive components, the cepstral representation is not produced. Direction: cepstral-transform → logarithm (dependent → needed).

Remove-DCT stops cepstral-distance from operating. The cepstral distance (e.g. DTW between cepstral vectors) requires DCT to decompose the cepstrum into frequency-domain components for distance computation. Without DCT, the cepstral distance cannot be computed.

DEPENDS_ON removal test. Cepstral-magnitude is derived from the cepstrum via inverse Fourier transform of log-magnitude spectrum. Removing cepstrum removes the quefrency domain representation and the coefficients whose magnitude is taken. Without cepstrum, cepstral-magnitude cannot be computed. The removal test fails.

The particle filter is a specific kind of statistical estimator — it infers the posterior distribution of a hidden state using sequential Monte Carlo sampling. The note pins the INSTANCE_OF sense: a competent practitioner calls a particle filter 'a statistical estimator.' Specific→general, nearest kind accepted.

DEPENDS_ON test: remove cepstral-coefficient, does cepstrum-sequence cease to operate? Yes. A cepstrum-sequence IS an ordered array of cepstral coefficients indexed by quefrency position. The sequence c[0], c[1], ..., c[N-1] is composed entirely of individual coefficients. Without the cepstral-coefficient construct as a fundamental data element, there are no elements to array, no quefrency-indexed values to store, and no sequence to represent. The data structure structurally depends on the existence of coefficients. Item 1 (type): DEPENDS_ON correct. Item 2 (direction): correct, data structure points to its element type. Item 3 (test): removal test stated and satisfied. Item 4 (object level): both are signal processing constructs. Item 5 (sense): endpoints used as their definitions carve them.

DEPENDS_ON test (Law 8): remove the respiratory bronchiole map now — the alveolar-duct map as a maintained anatomical landmark in pulmonary histology and physiology would stop operating as the thin-walled gas-exchanging airway distal to the respiratory bronchiole, because its definition positions it immediately distal to the respiratory bronchiole in the acinus hierarchy. The map's operation depends on the upstream category being maintained. Object level: both are human-authored anatomical constructs mapping airway categories. Sense pinned: alveolar-duct as accepted, respiratory-bronchiole as accepted.

Remove cepstrum-sequence now: aggregation collects 'a sequence of cepstral coefficient vectors c[n] over frames' and computes per-index statistics. Without the sequence representation, there is no structured input over which to compute mean, variance, or higher-order moments.

LPC all-pole model directly estimates formant frequencies as poles of the vocal tract transfer function. The LPC synthesis filter provides formant parameter extraction — LPC serves formant analysis because its pole locations give formant center frequencies, bandwidths, and amplitudes without needing dense spectral resolution.

Removing pitch now stops pitch-lag from operating. Pitch-lag is defined as the delay parameter that encodes the interval between consecutive pitch periods. Without pitch (the fundamental periodicity construct that defines what a period is), the pitch-lag parameter has no referent — it cannot encode an interval measured in pitch periods. The note pins the sense: pitch-lag as the codec parameter measuring pitch-period spacing.

LPC spectral envelope parameterization is directly related to mel-filterbank energy extraction — LPC coefficients and mel-filterbank energies represent the same spectral envelope in different forms. LPC depends on mel-filterbank because LPC is often applied with mel-scale warping (MELP codec, mel-LPC features for speech recognition), and the mel-filterbank provides the perceptual frequency spacing that LPC coefficients are warped into.

SERVES test: cepstral decomposition separates source from filter for speech recognition applications — its scope states it's used for 'source-filter separation in speech analysis, voice conversion, speaker identification.' The sustained practice is ASR front-end processing. Direction: servant→beneficiary.

Itakura-Saito distance is the specific Bregman divergence generated by the negative logarithm function: D_IS(p||q) = ∫(p/q - log(p/q) - 1)dω. Removing the Bregman divergence framework does not stop the IS distance from operating — it is a concrete formula — but the IS distance IS a specific instance of the general Bregman class, which is what INSTANCE_OF tests.

Probability flow ODE is built and maintained for the sake of speech-processing. It provides deterministic sampling that enables efficient generation of acoustic features used in speech systems. Edge runs servant to beneficiary.

Named-operand DEP, Law 8b removal test stated with result. ADPCM's own carve defines stage 2: 'the difference between the actual sample and the prediction, the prediction error, is quantized by a log-law quantizer' - the prediction error is the carve's named operand and the only quantity the codec transmits. Remove the prediction error now and the procedure halts: with nothing but the full sample there is no error to quantize and the construct degrades to pulse-code-modulation, a different entry. Type: DEPENDS_ON (dependent to what it needs); direction runs the dependent to the needed quantity. Sense pinned to the target's accepted carve, which is domain-neutral in its parameters - (1) a prior expectation or prediction, (2) the actual observed outcome, (3) the computed difference - and names control theory among its persistence domains; the pinned sense is the DSP instance: expectation = the adaptive predictor's output, outcome = the current speech sample, difference = e[n] = x[n] - x_hat[n], the value the codec quantizes. The endpoints' carves keep the pair distinct (the quantity vs the procedure that consumes it); this is not identity.

DEPENDS_ON removal test. Cepstral decomposition separates source and filter components by analyzing the cepstrum in the quefrency domain and applying a quefrency-domain window (lifter) to isolate low-quefrency or high-quefrency components. The decomposition operates on the cepstrum; removing the cepstrum removes the domain in which source-filter separation occurs.

The respiratory bronchiole branches from the terminal bronchiole and is defined by its position in the conducting-to-respiratory transition. Removing it leaves the terminal-bronchiole without its distal component.
The larynx contains the recurrent laryngeal nerve as its primary motor innervation: the branch supplies all intrinsic laryngeal muscles except the cricothyroid.

H-infinity control synthesis solves the underlying Riccati equations (or LMIs) to compute the controller; removing Riccati-equation removes the computational method by which H-infinity gains are derived.

DEPENDS_ON removal test. Cepstral-trajectory is defined as the time-varying path of cepstral coefficients c[m,n] across frames. Its procedure step 1 computes cepstral coefficients and step 2 defines the trajectory as the sequence c[m,:] across all frames. Remove the cepstrum and there is no c[m,n] to form a trajectory — the construct stops operating. Type and direction hold (dependent technique → substrate). Sense pinned: trajectory as the time-series of coefficient vectors, matching the accepted definition.

SERVES test: cepstral-subband was introduced specifically for robust speech recognition. The technique groups cepstral coefficients into perceptually meaningful subbands to reduce the impact of single-coefficient errors in ASR systems, providing channel-invariant features that improve recognition accuracy. Speech-recognition is the beneficiary — cepstral-subband is built and maintained for its sake.
Spectral coefficients are computed by the DFT transform. Removing the DFT stops the computation that produces spectral coefficients. The coefficients are the output of DFT operation on a signal.

Cepstral-pitch estimates the fundamental frequency from cepstrum peaks. Its accepted definition cites Kaldi HPSS module for prosody analysis, Praat for voice quality assessment, and Speech Toolbox for pitch tracking. The design-for relationship: cepstral-pitch was created to provide F0 estimates that speech-recognition systems use for prosody modeling, speaker identification, and voice quality features. Remove speech recognition and the pitch measure has no sustained design purpose.

[3 test] DEPENDS_ON removal test stated with result: cepstral-acceleration computes second-order derivatives of cepstral coefficient trajectories — the individual quefrency-domain values that form the coefficient vectors. Removing cepstral-coefficient leaves the procedure with no data structure to compute on. The acceleration is derived directly from these coefficients via regression. Pinned sense: cepstral-coefficient as the single discrete value in a cepstrum sequence (per its accepted definition).
WVD is a specific quadratic time-frequency representation, a member of the time-frequency-representation class

Stabilizability assesses whether a state-space model's uncontrollable modes are naturally stable. The concept operates on the eigenvalue structure of the state-space matrices A and B. Remove the state-space model and there is no matrix structure whose eigenvalues can be assessed. Direction: stabilizability (the property) depends on state-space-model (the structural object). Consistent with the controllability→state-space-model edge I just filed.

The inverse discrete Fourier transform operates as the inversion of the DFT on discrete frequency-domain data. Removing the DFT as a defined mapping stops the IDFT from operating, since the IDFT's purpose is precisely to recover the time-domain signal from the DFT's output.

DEPENDS_ON removal test. Cepstral-peak-detection step 1 computes the cepstrum c[q] of a windowed signal frame; the entire algorithm operates on the cepstrum to locate peaks above a noise-floor baseline. Removing the cepstrum removes the quefrency-domain representation in which peaks exist; the procedure has no alternative substrate. The peak detection is a cepstrum operation, not a generic signal processing operation.

Cepstral-pitch is a pitch estimation method that operates by locating the strongest low-quefrency cepstral peak. The definition states 'locate the peak in the quefrency range corresponding to plausible pitch periods' — the entire procedure is cepstral-peak identification. Removing cepstral-peak (the local maxima in the quefrency domain) removes the data object the pitch estimation algorithm operates on. The peak is the direct input to the pitch conversion step.

CONTAINS test (Law 10) stated with result: the alveolar-sac definition enumerates alveoli as constituent units in parameter 1 ('terminal cluster of alveoli that share a common respiratory bronchiole opening') and parameter 4 distinguishes the sac from the single alveolus, so the sac's own carve lists alveoli as the literal parts it is made of; the alveolus entry's accepted definition carves the individual saccular unit. Direction whole to part. Object level: two anatomical maps, not natural containment. Sense pinned: alveolar-sac as filed, alveolus as accepted.

INSTANCE_OF test: cepstral-mean-variance-normalization (CMVN) is a specific variant of cepstral-mean-normalization that additionally normalizes variance. A competent practitioner would call CMVN a type of mean normalization (specifically, mean-variance normalization). Direction: specific instance → general class.

Remove cepstral-coefficient: cepstral-decorrelation computes a cepstral coefficient vector c[n], estimates its covariance, and transforms frames via Cholesky. Without the coefficient construct, there is no vector to estimate or transform; the procedure stops operating. The removal test is satisfied: X needs Y to operate now.

Speaker recognition is built and maintained for the sake of speech processing applications: speaker diarization, speaker-adaptive ASR, and voice-based authentication are all speech-processing tasks where knowing who speaks is essential to the processing pipeline.

The larynx construct maps the organ system; the cricoarytenoid joint is one of its paired synovial articulations between the arytenoid and cricoid cartilages, enabling the rotation and sliding movements of the vocal folds. Direction: the whole (larynx) CONTAINS its part (cricoarytenoid joint).

Remove-DFT now stops cepstrum from operating. The cepstrum is defined as applying the inverse Fourier transform to the log-power-spectrum. Computing the power spectrum requires a DFT (implemented via FFT); the inverse transform is an IDFT. Without the DFT construct as an operational operand, the cepstrum procedure cannot execute. This is DEPENDS_ON, not DERIVED_FROM — the dependency is constitutive and present-tense, not historical.

Pole-placement operates on the controllability property: the fundamental theorem states that arbitrary pole placement is achievable if and only if the system is controllable. The procedure computes K such that A-BK has desired eigenvalues, but the assignability of all poles depends on controllability (full rank of the controllability matrix). Remove the concept of controllability and pole-placement loses its existence condition — there is no criterion for whether a given pole assignment is achievable. Direction: pole-placement (the synthesis procedure) depends on controllability (the structural property that determines feasibility). This is a genuine DEPENDS_ON: removing controllability from the map eliminates the theoretical foundation that tells engineers when pole-placement is possible.

DEPENDS_ON (Laws 8, 8a): Removal test. Chroma-features computes a 12-dimensional vector encoding energy across pitch classes per frame. The chroma entry defines the 12-dimensional pitch-class representation that folds all octaves into a single octave. Chroma-features operates by projecting spectral energy onto the chroma representation — removing chroma eliminates the pitch-class mapping mechanism. The features cannot be computed without the chroma representation to define what the 12 pitch classes are and how spectral energy folds onto them.

Hilbert envelope constructs the analytic signal z(t) = x(t) + j*H{x}(t). The Hilbert transform H{x} is the core operation without which the envelope cannot be computed. Removing hilbert-transform stops hilbert-envelope from operating. Edge runs dependent to needs.

Remove Y: without mel-filterbank, cepstrum-subband cannot operate — the mel filterbank is the direct input that produces the mel-frequency spectrum the subband cepstrum then transforms via cepstrum computation. The mel-filterbank is a necessary data operand, not just a conceptual neighbor. Test: if you remove mel-filterbank from the pipeline, cepstrum-subband has no spectral decomposition to work with. Sense: cepstrum-subband as the spectral-subband cepstrum that applies mel-scale filterbank decomposition before computing the cepstrum (the specific construction). Test stated with result: removal stops operation.

DCT-II is a specific variant of the DCT family. A competent speaker would call DCT-II "a DCT" — specifically, type-II DCT. The accepted discrete-cosine-transform entry defines the family; DCT-II is a specific member. Direction: specific (dct-type-ii) → general (discrete-cosine-transform).

The airway definition explicitly lists bronchioles as parts of the lower airway within its span (param 1). The respiratory-bronchiole is a specific kind of transitional airway where gas exchange begins.

Observability in control theory is defined via the state-space representation: for x_dot = Ax + Bu, y = Cx + Du, the observability matrix [C; CA; ...; CA^{n-1}] must have full rank n. The definition itself requires the state-space matrices A, C and state dimension n as parameters. Remove state-space-model and there is no formalism in which to express the observability property — the rank condition on [C; CA; ...] becomes meaningless.

SERVES for-whose-sake test. Cepstral-trajectory's definition persistence explicitly names speech synthesis for trajectory generation in HTS-HMM systems. The time-varying path of cepstral coefficients is directly used in synthesis state selection. Direction from servant (trajectory) to master (speech-synthesis) runs correctly.

CONTAINS test (Law 10) stated with result: the accepted lung definition enumerates the lobes verbatim in parameter 1 ('the right lung (three lobes: upper, middle, and lower, separated by the oblique and horizontal fissures) and the left lung (two lobes: upper and lower, separated by the oblique fissure, with the lingula corresponding to the right middle lobe)'), so the lobe is enumerated in the whole's own parameters, the enumerated-part form the board enforced 11-05; the lung's near-miss clause excludes the pleura and the bronchus, nothing that would bar a lobe. Direction whole to part (Law 10). Object level: the two anatomical constructs, not their shared condition of being maps (Law 2a). Sense pinned: lobe as its filed definition carves it (each named division set off by its interlobar fissures); lung as its accepted definition carves it. If the lobe entry is rejected this edge voids in the same ruling, no penalty (Law 30).

DEPENDS_ON (Laws 8, 8a): removal test. The cross-phase spectrum is defined as arg S_xy(f): the phase angle IS the argument of the cross-spectral density. The CSD is the operand the cross-phase reads — without it there is no complex quantity whose argument can be taken, and the measure has no input to operate on. This is the operand form, not identity: the cross-phase is a distinct measure (a phase angle in -pi..pi, not the complex CSD), and it is not a rescaling of the CSD but the extraction of one of its two parts (phase from the complex quantity). Direction: cross-phase-spectrum → cross-spectral-density (dependent to needed). Pinned sense: cross-spectral-density as the complex-valued cross-frequency representation whose argument is taken, per its accepted definition ('its phase equals the cross-phase spectrum').

Each terminal bronchiole is a specific type of bronchiole — it is the final conducting generation of cartilage-free small airways. A competent anatomist calls the terminal bronchiole 'a bronchiole' (specifically, a terminal bronchiole). It fits the nearest accepted kind: the bronchiole concept maps cartilage-free conducting airways.

Law 8d for-whose-sake, carve-named home. The scalar-quantization def's own persistence line names its design-for home in its text: described as 'the foundational block of every fixed-bit-rate waveform coder' (Gray and Neuman, 1966) and specified in the waveform-coding standards ITU-T G.711 and the CD Red Book. Remove waveform-coding (the family that commits a fixed bit rate to the sample waveform) and the quantizer's stated purpose - 'so a signal can be carried on a fixed number of bits per sample' - has no construct to serve; its whole design-for is the waveform-coding class. Not a removable input: waveform coding runs on other coders, but the quantizer was built and kept for the waveform-coder's sake. Pinned sense: the scalar quantizer as its accepted def carves it (single amplitude to a discrete level, G.711/G.726/CD). [1 type] SERVES as design-for; [2 direction] servant to beneficiary; [3 test] for-whose-sake with result; [5 sense] pinned to the def's own waveform-coder home.

The Gabor transform as defined here applies a sliding-window Fourier transform using a Gaussian window — it is precisely the STFT construct instantiated with a Gaussian window function. The scope describes the STFT mechanism (windowing, Fourier transform of segments) without which the Gabor construct cannot operate.

SERVES: The separation principle exists to serve LQG design. The LQG scope states it 'separating the design into independent LQR and Kalman-filter components' — the separation principle is the theoretical basis that makes this independent design valid. The definition states 'the control gain and estimator gain are designed independently' and the combined closed-loop eigenvalues are the union. The removal test: without the separation principle, LQG loses its justification for independent design — the designer would have to solve the coupled Riccati equations simultaneously. LQG exists as a design methodology because the separation principle serves it.

The trachea's accepted carve enumerates the cartilaginous framework in parameter 1: approximately 16-20 C-shaped hyaline cartilage rings. Law 10 test stated with its result: the ring stack is literally a part inside the tracheal tube as the trachea map carves it; the rings are the structural framework the tube is made of, not a boundary of a region. The tracheal-cartilage carve names the same rings as the trachea's framework, so the endpoints are used as their accepted definitions carve them. Direction whole to part.
Hessenberg form is a matrix property of A; removing matrix stops the concept from operating.

ADPCM requires an adaptive linear predictor that updates its coefficients in response to the local signal — per the definition, 'G.726 keeps a 16-coefficient predictor whose coefficients adapt to the local signal.' If you remove adaptive-filter (the ability to update filter coefficients based on input data), ADPCM cannot perform adaptive prediction and stops operating. Item 5: pinned sense is the operational dependency in the codec's predictor stage.

Loop-gain quantifies signal amplification around a feedback loop. Remove the feedback-loop construct and loop-gain has no loop to traverse — there is no 'around' without the loop. The gain measure requires the loop structure as its domain.

Waveform-coding is built to represent speech signals in a compact digital form for storage and transmission. Speech-coding is the beneficiary domain for which waveform coding is designed. The SERVES relation holds: waveform-coding is maintained for the sake of speech-coding applications. Test: waveform-coding procedures are described in speech-coding standards and literature as serving speech communication.
The trachea depends on the recurrent laryngeal nerve for parasympathetic innervation and motor control of trachealis muscle; removal stops these functions.

Schur decomposition operates on square matrices, producing a unitary similarity transformation. The matrix concept is the domain on which the factorization is defined — without the matrix construct, Schur decomposition has no object to operate on.

Cepstral time warping is a technique that operates on the cepstrum. Historically, quefrency warping was introduced after the cepstrum concept itself — the warping technique derives from and extends the cepstrum construct.
The parallelogram constrains LPC coefficients to produce spectrally smooth, stable filters used in speech analysis and synthesis. Its entire purpose is to serve speech-processing applications.

Remove-Y-now test: the roll-off construct is defined as a rate of magnitude decrease measured in decibels per decade (dB/dec) or per octave. The definition's own parameter (2) is the roll-off rate in dB/dec. Without the decibel construct (the logarithmic unit for expressing ratio as a level), roll-off has no unit of measure — the construct is defined by a rate in decibels. This is not 'operating on a domain' but requiring the unit for the quantity to be sayable.

DEPENDS_ON removal test: cepstral-centroid computes the weighted mean quefrency value of the cepstrum, Σ(q_i·|c[q_i]|)/Σ|c[q_i]|, where q_i are quefrency values and c[q_i] are cepstral-coefficient magnitudes. The cepstral coefficients are the direct data operands — without them, the centroid has no values to weight. The note judges the centroid as a spectral-centroid-like measure computed from cepstral coefficients.

Remove cepstral-coefficient now: interpolation between cepstral vectors requires access to the coefficient values being interpolated; without coefficients there is nothing to average. The operation is structurally dependent on having cepstral coefficients as its input data.

The Burg algorithm computes reflection coefficients k_m at each recursive step as its primary output. These coefficients are the intermediate values that encode incremental prediction error reduction and guarantee filter stability.

The Griffin-Lim algorithm (Griffin & Lim, 1984) applies the alternating projection method pioneered by Gerchberg and Saxton (1972) to the short-time Fourier transform domain. Gerchberg-Saxton iteratively recovers phase from magnitude constraints in two conjugate domains via Fourier transform and magnitude replacement; Griffin-Lim adopts this exact alternating-projection structure and applies it to the STFT magnitude-and-consistency constraints for audio signal reconstruction.

Cepstral-delay computes the time offset between two signals by locating the peak quefrency in the cross-cepstrum. The quefrency axis is the domain where delay is measured. Without quefrency as the quefrency-domain variable, the peak location is undefined and the delay measure cannot operate. The quefrency domain is a structural component of the cepstral-delay construct.
The corniculate cartilages are the paired cartilages on the arytenoid apexes, explicitly enumerated in the framework definition as constituent members.

A cepstrum-sequence is an ordered array of cepstral coefficients indexed by quefrency position. Quefrency is defined only through the cepstrum (the inverse FFT of the log-power spectrum). Removing the cepstrum concept eliminates quefrency as a dimension — there is no quefrency-indexing without the cepstrum transform. This is a structural dependency.

The bounded-real lemma provides an LMI equivalence for the positive-real property. The lemma states that a transfer function G(s) is positive-real iff there exists a symmetric P satisfying a certain LMI. Without the positive-real concept (Re G(jw) >= 0 on the imaginary axis), the lemma has no target to certify. The lemma is a test FOR positive-realness, making it constitutively dependent on that criterion.

The corniculate cartilage (cartilago corniculata) is a component of the laryngeal cartilaginous framework as defined by the larynx entry's parameter (1): 'thyroid, cricoid, and epiglottic cartilages plus the paired arytenoid cartilages.' The corniculate cartilages sit atop the arytenoid apices within the aryepiglottic folds, forming part of the posterior laryngeal inlet. The definition's parameter (1) establishes the larynx's cartilaginous framework, and the corniculate cartilage is one of the structures within that framework.

ACELP synthesis cannot operate without the LPC filter: the codec's residual excitation signal is fed through the LP synthesis filter to reconstruct speech. The filter H(z) = G/(1-Σa_k z^(-k)) is the core synthesis mechanism; removing it leaves only the codebook search with no audio output. Structural dependency, not purpose.

Remove the state-space model and the EKF cannot operate — it needs the state vector x, the nonlinear function f(x,u) that propagates the state, and the observation function h(x) that maps state to measurement. Without the state-space model formalism, the EKF has no state to estimate, no dynamics to linearize, and no measurement equation to linearize. Removal stops operating. The note pins the DEPENDS_ON sense: the state-space model is the structural substrate the EKF acts upon.

Pole-placement serves state-feedback by providing the gain computation procedure. The state-feedback definition identifies pole-placement as one of the standard methods that produce the gain matrix K. Pole-placement maps controllability to achievable pole positions, computing K — which is the functional output of the state-feedback architecture.

The laryngeal inlet definition explicitly lists the aryepiglottic folds as one of its boundaries: 'laterally by the aryepiglottic folds' is a boundary parameter. The aryepiglottic folds form the lateral walls of the laryngeal inlet and are a constituent structural element of it. The inlet definition also lists 'the aryepiglottic folds contract inward during swallowing to close the inlet' — they are integral to the inlet construct.

DEPENDS_ON removal test with result: the def's own step 1 constructs the lattice polynomial P(z) = A(z) + z^(-p/2) A*(z) from A(z) = 1 - sum(a_k z^-k) — the all-pole LPC coefficients a_k are the def's own named operand, and step 2 reads the LSPs from the roots of that polynomial. Remove lpc-coefficient now and there is no A(z), no P(z), no roots: the representation has no substrate to operate on. Named-operand line, not removable input. Sense pinned to the all-pole coefficients of the synthesis filter (the target's own carve); its near-miss 'the reflection coefficients derived from these by Levinson recursion' is not the route used here. Direction dependent representation → the coefficients it is built from.

Variance normalization operates in the cepstral domain, manipulating coefficient vectors defined within that domain. The cepstral domain is the structural space in which the coefficients exist and variance is computed.

The lateral cricoarytenoid muscle's accepted definition carves its innervation as 'recurrent laryngeal nerve.' Removal test: remove the recurrent laryngeal nerve and the muscle loses all innervation — it cannot contract, ceasing to operate as an adductor of the vocal folds. Constitutive dependency. Direction correct.

INSTANCE_OF test: subsegmental-bronchus is the airway branch between the segmental bronchi and the bronchioles, the last airway generation bearing hyaline cartilage. It is a specific type of airway. Direction is specific→general. Both CONCEPTs, object-level per Law 2a. [1 type; 2 direction; 3 test; 4 object level; 5 sense — all pass]

SERVES, Law 8d for-whose-sake test: cepstral-peak-to-average-ratio is designed to measure the prominence of periodic structure in the cepstrum, which is the core signal used in pitch detection and voicing decision algorithms. The scope states this purpose directly. Remove pitch-detection as the beneficiary and CPAR loses its design purpose — it would have no clear application domain. Direction: servant (CPAR feature) → master (pitch-detection).

Bode plot serves natural-frequency identification by showing the resonant peak at omega_n on the magnitude plot — engineers read the natural frequency from the Bode magnitude peak in underdamped second-order systems.

DEPENDS_ON removal test: the CSD definition lists the spectral estimation method as 'direct periodogram, Welch averaged, or multitaper' — none of these require autocorrelation. The Wiener-Khinchin theorem (FT of autocorrelation) is one method to compute PSD, not CSD. CSD itself is the averaged conjugate product of FTs. The note must show that removing autocorrelation stops CSD from operating — but CSD can be computed directly from the Fourier transforms without any autocorrelation concept. Removal test fails.

MFCC is built and maintained for the sake of speech-processing. It compresses spectral envelope into perceptually-motivated features used as acoustic representations in speech systems. Edge runs servant to beneficiary.

A state-observer reconstructs internal states from measured outputs. The entire concept of state reconstruction is grounded in the observability property: an observer can only reconstruct states that are observable from the outputs. The observability matrix [C; CA; CA^2; ...] determines which state directions are reconstructable. Remove the concept of observability and a state-observer has no criterion for whether its estimation is possible — there is no way to know if the observer error dynamics converge for the full state or only for observable modes. Direction: state-observer (the estimation procedure) depends on observability (the property that determines what can be estimated).
Arnoldi operates on a square matrix A to produce the Hessenberg decomposition A Q_m = Q_{m+1} H_m; removing matrix stops the algorithm from operating.

CONTAINS test: pulmonary-acinus is a human-authored anatomical construct that groups distal lung tissue into one unit. Its definition explicitly enumerates alveolar sacs as a member: 'the acinus takes in the respiratory bronchioles, alveolar ducts, alveolar sacs and alveoli.' The alveolar-sac construct is a literal part inside the pulmonary-acinus construct. Direction: whole (pulmonary-acinus) to part (alveolar-sac). Both are CONCEPTs; this is object-level reasoning between maps.

Kalman decomposition constructs its transformation matrix from the controllability matrix and its nullspace. The decomposition partitions states into controllable and uncontrollable subspaces. Without controllability as a concept, the decomposition cannot distinguish controllable modes — removing controllability stops kalman-decomposition from operating.

LPC models the signal's spectral envelope which is equivalent to the output of a filter bank applied to the signal spectrum. The LPC synthesis filter IS a filter bank — its coefficients define the frequency response that separates the spectral envelope from the excitation. LPC depends on filter-bank because the LPC filter coefficients implement a parametric filter bank, and LPC analysis/synthesis pipelines use filter-bank techniques for spectral envelope representation.

DEPENDS_ON removal test. Delta cepstral coefficients are the first-order temporal derivatives of cepstral coefficient sequences. The cepstral-transform is the procedure that produces cepstral coefficients (the input to the delta operation). Remove the cepstral-transform: there is no mechanism to produce cepstral coefficients, and without them no delta coefficients can be computed. Direction: derived derivative to the producer of its input data.

INSTANCE_OF (Law 9): a cepstral coefficient is a single numerical sample value — a real number indexed on the quefrency axis. A competent speaker would call a cepstral coefficient a number. Direction: cepstral-coefficient → number (specific → general). Pinned sense: cepstral-coefficient as a single real-valued sample of the cepstrum at a specific quefrency point.

Cepstral-whitening operates directly on the cepstrum representation of a signal. Removing the cepstrum (quefrency-domain signal representation) would stop whitening from operating — there is no input to whiten.

DEPENDS_ON (Laws 8, 8a): Removal test. Cepstral-lifter operates in the quefrency domain, applying a window function to cepstral coefficients. This is the quefrency-domain counterpart of homomorphic filtering, which operates in the transformed domain to separate convolutional components. The lifter's theoretical foundation — mapping signals into a domain where convolution becomes addition, filtering, then transforming back — is the homomorphic filtering framework. Removing homomorphic-filtering: the cepstral-lifter loses its conceptual foundation and operational justification. Direction: cepstral-lifter → homomorphic-filtering (dependent construct → theoretical framework it implements).

DEPENDS_ON (Laws 8, 8a): removal test. Cepstral peak-picking is the operation of finding local maxima in a cepstral coefficient sequence. Without cepstral sequence as the ordered structure of coefficients, peak-picking has no data structure to operate on — the operation is undefined. Direction: cepstral-peak-picking → cepstral-sequence (dependent → needed). Pinned sense: cepstral-sequence as the ordered list of cepstral coefficients across quefrency that peak-picking operates upon.
Trachea as anatomical map serves the vagus nerve concept by providing a structural referent for vagal innervation description.
Tonal-strength computation requires the STFT as its spectral analysis front-end — removing STFT stops the harmonic/inharmonic energy separation that defines tonal-strength.

DERIVED_FROM [2 direction; 3 test] The DTFT \u2014 the continuous-frequency analysis of discrete-time sequences as a 2\u03c0-periodic function \u2014 predates the z-transform. The z-transform was formalized in the late 1940s (Holmbert, Bell Labs) as a generalization of the DTFT: where DTFT uses X(e^(j\u03c9)), the z-transform uses X(z) with complex z, enabling convergence analysis via the ROC. The z-transform was derived FROM the DTFT by generalizing the domain from the unit circle to the complex plane. Historical precedence: DTFT (Fourier analysis of sequences, early 1900s) \u2192 z-transform (1940s). Direction: z-transform (later) \u2192 DTFT (earlier).

The hypopharynx accepted definition (parameter 1) explicitly enumerates the laryngeal inlet as one of its four subsites: 'the four subsites — postcricoid region, bilateral pyriform sinuses, the posterior pharyngeal wall behind the larynx, and the laryngeal inlet (the opening from the oropharynx into the laryngopharynx bounded by the epiglottis and arytenoids).' Law 10: if the accepted definition of the whole enumerates the part, the CONTAINS edge holds. Direction from hypopharynx to laryngeal-inlet is correct: hypopharynx is the whole, laryngeal-inlet is the part.

DERIVED_FROM [2 direction; 3 test] Transform coding (Huang, 1960s-70s) was introduced to compress signals by decorrelating data via orthogonal transforms. The foundational transform coding framework uses the DFT and DCT (derived from the Fourier transform) as its primary decorrelation mechanism. Without the Fourier transform family (DFT \u2192 DCT), there is no basis for the transform coding framework. Historical precedence: Fourier transform (1800s) \u2192 DCT (1974, Ahmed/Natarajan/Rao) \u2192 transform coding (1960s-70s). Direction: later construct (transform coding) \u2192 earlier (Fourier).

Phase-crossover-frequency w_pc is the frequency at which gain margin is read: GM = 1/|L(jw_pc)|. The gain margin is computed directly from the magnitude at the phase-crossover frequency — removing gain-margin eliminates the quantity that phase-crossover-frequency is used to compute.

The concept of time-domain representation as a distinct analytical domain was made salient through the Fourier transform, which established the time-frequency duality. Before Fourier analysis, signals were not routinely classified as 'time domain' versus 'frequency domain' — the Fourier transform created this conceptual distinction.
Delta features compute temporal derivatives of base features like cepstral-coefficient. Removing cepstral-coefficient as a base eliminates the input that delta-features operates on.

Kalman filter is a specific type of state-observer: it estimates state from noisy measurements using optimal Bayesian inference, minimizing estimation error covariance. Direction: kalman-filter (specific estimation algorithm) is an instance of state-observer (general state estimation construct).

The larynx construct maps the organ system; the vocal process is a specific anatomical structure — the anterior projection of the arytenoid cartilage — that forms one endpoint of the vocal fold and is mapped within the laryngeal framework. Direction: the whole (larynx) CONTAINS its part (vocal process).

INSTANCE_OF test (Law 9a) stated with result: a competent pulmonologist or histologist would call a respiratory bronchiole 'a bronchiole' — it is a cartilage-free airway branch distal to the segmental bronchi, fitting the bronchiole carve (no hyaline cartilage plates, under 1 mm diameter, smooth muscle wall). Direction runs specific (respiratory-bronchiole) to general (bronchiole), the way the type points. Object level: two anatomical maps; the note argues their structural position in the airway hierarchy, not causality of mapped territory. Sense pinned: respiratory-bronchiole as its accepted definition carves it, bronchiole as its filed definition carves it.

Cepstral-slope measures spectral tilt, used for spectral tilt normalization in Kaldi speech recognition front-ends. Its accepted definition cites Kaldi front-end processing, HTK speaker-dependent voice quality assessment, and NIST speaker recognition evaluation. The design-for relationship: cepstral-slope was built to provide spectral tilt information that speech recognition systems use for normalization and voice quality features. Without the purpose of serving speech/speaker recognition, the cepstral-slope measure has no design home.

IDFT is the inverse of the DFT, sharing the same kernel up to conjugation and normalization. It was conceived as the reciprocal half of the DFT pair — the DFT came first (Fourier 1807, discrete formulation mid-20th century), and IDFT was defined in response to close the pair.

The respiratory-zone definition explicitly includes alveolar ducts in its membership: the zone takes in the respiratory bronchioles, the alveolar ducts and the alveolar sacs. Alveolar ducts are airway passages whose walls are entirely composed of alveolar openings.

LSP converts LPC filter coefficients to a more stable parameterization by finding roots of symmetric/anti-symmetric polynomials derived from the LPC prediction polynomial. Without linear-prediction, LSP has no coefficients to reparameterize — removing linear-prediction stops line-spectral-pairs from operating.

Spectral coefficients contain both magnitude and phase information. The phase spectrum is the angle component of each complex spectral coefficient. Remove phase-spectrum now: the phase component of spectral coefficients would be undefined, making the coefficients incomplete. Direction: dependent (complete spectral coefficients) → needed (phase component).

The larynx construct maps the organ system; the thyrohyoid membrane is one of its constituent fibrous structures spanning from the thyroid cartilage to the hyoid bone, forming the superior boundary of the laryngeal cavity. Direction: the whole (larynx) CONTAINS its part (thyrohyoid membrane).

The complementary sensitivity function T(s) is defined as T = I - S where S is the sensitivity function. This is a constitutive mathematical identity: removing the sensitivity function stops the complementary sensitivity function from being defined. T cannot exist without S as it is literally 1 minus S.

INSTANCE_OF (Law 9): nearest accepted kind. The target's accepted definition carves a blueprint of a computational model whose parameter is the type of computational graph (feedforward, recurrent, graph-based, transformer). A neural network architecture, as its accepted definition carves it, is exactly such a blueprint: a structured design specifying how computational layers are organized, interconnected, and oriented, with the architectural choices (depth, width, skip connections, attention heads) distinguishing one class of neural model from another. Test (Law 9a): a competent speaker in the field calls a CNN or a transformer's design a model architecture. The family line already seats this rung for the sibling: neural architecture INSTANCE_OF model architecture stands accepted on the same ground.

A bode-plot is a graphical rendering of frequency-response. Removing frequency-response (the system characterization) stops the bode-plot from operating, since there is no response to render. The plot exists as a visualization of the frequency-response construct.

The laryngeal-framework definition explicitly lists in parameter (1) composition: inter-cartilaginous ligaments and membranes including the cricothyroid. The cricothyroid-membrane connects the thyroid and cricoid cartilages - two framework members - and is a constitutive part of the scaffold. Type CONTAINS (Law 10), direction whole→part. The note states the enumeration test. Object level maps the constructs. Sense uses each as defined.

DEPENDS_ON test (Law 8): remove the bronchiole map now — the respiratory bronchiole map as a maintained landmark would stop operating as the transitional airway between conducting bronchioles and alveolar ducts, because its definition positions it as a specific member of the bronchiole category. The map's operation depends on the general category being maintained. Object level: both are human-authored anatomical constructs. Sense pinned: respiratory-bronchiole as accepted, bronchiole as newly filed.

The thyroepiglottic ligament connects the epiglottic apex and lateral margins to the thyroid cartilage angle, situated within the laryngeal framework anterior to the laryngeal inlet. Its presence is required for the epiglottis to maintain its anatomical position within the laryngeal apparatus.

The Sakoe-Chiba band is a constraint on the alignment matrix in dynamic time warping. DTW operates on a matrix whose cells represent pairwise distances between signal samples; the band constrains which cells are eligible. The band constrains a DTW path — it needs the DTW matrix to operate. The band is defined relative to cepstral/feature sequences being aligned, and is used in cepstral-domain alignment. Remove cepstrum: the band loses its primary use domain and the signal representation it constrains over.

DEPENDS_ON test (Law 8): the spectral-difference-vector's accepted definition computes D(f) = |P(f,t) - P(f,t-1)| for each frequency bin, directly requiring the power spectrum P(f,t) at consecutive frames. Removing the power spectrum now stops spectral-difference-vector from operating — it literally cannot compute differences without spectral power values. The note states the removal test and result: the computation is impossible without the power spectrum. Direction: dependent → needed. Sense: uses each entry as its accepted definition carves it.

DEPENDS_ON (Laws 8, 8a): Removal test. MFCC computes mel-frequency cepstral coefficients by: (1) framing, (2) FFT, (3) mel-filterbank, (4) log of filterbank energies, (5) DCT. Step 4 directly produces the log-magnitude-spectrum — the log of filterbank energies IS a log-magnitude-spectrum. Without log-magnitude-spectrum there is no mechanism for the log operation that transforms spectral energy into additive form for the DCT step. Removing the log-magnitude-spectrum stops MFCC from operating.

The Nyquist stability criterion operates on the open-loop frequency response evaluated on the imaginary axis. It counts encirclements of -1+0j by the locus L(jω). Without frequency response, the criterion has no data to operate on — the encirclement test cannot be performed.

The zeroth coefficient (log-energy) serves voice activity detection as its primary energy feature. The persistence mechanism names Kaldi compute-vadstats and HTK VAD modules that use c[0] for energy-based voiced/unvoiced classification. For-whose-sake test: the construct is maintained specifically for its role in VAD energy features. Removing VAD as a purpose leaves the feature without its primary application context. The definition explicitly anchors Kaldi vadstats and HTK energy-based VAD as its persistence mechanism.

Law 10 test stated with result: the laryngeal-inlet definition explicitly lists the epiglottis as a boundary structure in parameter (1) — 'anteriorly bounded by the epiglottis.' The epiglottis is literally a structural component that defines the anterior boundary of the inlet. Without the epiglottis, the inlet as carved would not exist. Direction whole (laryngeal-inlet) -> part (epiglottis).
The Yule-Walker system's input is the autocorrelation matrix R and lag vector r — removing autocorrelation as a construct stops the equations from being formulable.
Peak prominence measures the strength of detected peaks in the cepstrum. Removing cepstral-peak-picking removes the peak detection that defines which values are peaks to measure.

The cricotracheal membrane attaches to the inferior border of the cricoid cartilage lamina — removing the cricoid would eliminate its superior anchor point, stopping the membrane from functioning. Sense pinned to accepted definitions. Direction: membrane depends on its attachment structure.

Removing the cepstrum construct — the quefrency-domain transform (FFT→log→IFFT) — stops cepstrum-domain from operating. The domain is defined as the output of the cepstrum transform; its quefrency axis, its variable assignments, and its interpretation all require the cepstrum construct to exist. The domain does not independently persist without it.

The laryngeal inlet's anterior boundary is the epiglottis. Operational DEPENDS_ON test (Law 8): remove the epiglottis and the inlet loses its anterior boundary — the protective mechanism (epiglottis tilting posteriorly during swallowing to close the inlet) cannot operate. The inlet's defined role requires the epiglottis as its anterior landmark. Not identity (the inlet is a mapped opening, the epiglottis is a cartilage).

The vocal-fold definition maps the layered microstructure whose core is the vocal ligament. The vocal-ligament definition explicitly states it is 'the free superior margin of the cricothyroid membrane, forming the elastic fiber core of the vocal fold.' The ligament is literally a structural part inside the vocal fold construct — the stiff elastic scaffold upon which the mucosal wave oscillates. The vocal fold contains the ligament as its core structural element, making this a genuine part-whole CONTAINS relation.

Remove Y: cepstral-homomorphic-filtering IS the cepstral application of homomorphic-filtering — it applies the homomorphic-filtering procedure to separate convolved signal components (source and filter) into additive quefrency-domain regions. Without homomorphic-filtering as the mathematical mechanism (log-compression + Fourier analysis + separation + inverse transform), cepstral-homomorphic-filtering has no procedure. The homomorphic-filtering is the necessary computational engine. Test: remove homomorphic-filtering and the entire cepstral approach collapses. Sense: cepstral-homomorphic-filtering as the cepstral-domain application of the general homomorphic-filtering technique. Note states removal test with result.

The autocorrelation method computes the autocorrelation lags from data and feeds them into the Yule-Walker equations to solve for AR parameters. Without the Yule-Walker formulation, the autocorrelation method has no mechanism to convert lags into coefficients — removing yule-walker-equations stops autocorrelation-method from operating.

The Yule-Walker equations R·a = r take autocorrelation values as their matrix and vector entries: R(i,j) = r(|i-j|), r = [r(1),...,r(p)]. Removing autocorrelation removes the entries of these equations entirely — the system of equations ceases to exist. Autocorrelation is not merely related; it is the data the equations operate on.

DERIVED_FROM test: which-came-first. The mel-frequency spectrogram (the mel-scale filterbank applied to STFT power spectra) is the earlier construct. The log-mel spectrogram is derived from it by applying a logarithm to compress the dynamic range. The mel-frequency spectrogram exists independently; the log-mel is a specific transformation applied to it. Direction: later (log-mel) to earlier (mel-frequency).

The vallecula maps the shallow depression between the base of the tongue and the epiglottis, which is structurally part of the laryngeal inlet region. The larynx definition (parameters 1-5) maps the organ system housing the vocal folds and their musculature, and the vallecula is a landmark within this system used in airway management — the epiglottis, laryngeal inlet, and vallecula are all listed as anatomical landmarks in airway management within the larynx definition itself.

The subsegmental bronchus is defined by its position branching from the lobar bronchus, forming the next hierarchical level in the bronchial tree. Removing subsegmental-bronchle leaves the lobar construct without its distal component.

The excitation-model fundamentally depends on pitch (fundamental frequency or pitch period) as its primary parameter. Every voiced speech frame requires a pitch period value to position the glottal pulses or set the excitation periodicity. Without pitch, the model cannot generate the correct temporal structure of the excitation.

DEPENDS_ON (Laws 8, 8a): removal test. Coherence is γ²_xy(f), a function whose argument is frequency and whose output is defined per-frequency. Without frequency as the count of recurring events per unit time (hertz), the coherence function loses its domain — it has no argument, no axis, no per-frequency value. Direction: coherence-function → frequency (dependent → needed). Pinned sense: frequency as the axis quantity the coherence function maps over.

SERVES (Law 8d), for-whose-sake by design, with result. The definition's persistence names pitch detection as the design home: RAPT and PYPE are pitch detection algorithms that use cepstral peak detection for pitch period estimation, and Praat uses it for fundamental frequency estimation — the low-quefrency peak IS the pitch period in those systems. The peak construct exists for pitch-period reading; co-equal beneficiaries (echo detection, HTK) do not defeat the design-for origin. Pinned sense: the peak as the pitch-period carrier.

DEPENDS_ON removal test. Cepstral-silence-detection computes cepstral coefficients for consecutive frames, then evaluates silence criteria (total cepstral energy, energy in c[0], coefficient variance) using coefficient values. Removing the cepstral coefficient concept removes the feature vectors the algorithm evaluates; silence detection operates directly on coefficient magnitudes and distributions.

The BRL is a special case of the KYP lemma where the positive-realness condition is replaced by an H-infinity norm bound. The KYP inequality for BRL is the bounded-real (KYP) matrix inequality — a specific LMI. The BRL's KYP inequality is the KYP lemma's conclusion specialized to the negative-real case. Without the KYP lemma as the general theorem, BRL cannot be understood as a special case. The removal test: without KYP lemma, the structural relationship between H-infinity norm bounds and LMI feasibility loses its theoretical foundation.

Glottal-inverse-filtering is a specific kind of inverse filtering, distinguished by the additional constraint that the residual must conform to a parametric glottal-flow waveform model. It is inverse filtering (removing the estimated system transfer function) with glottal-flow constraints — a specific kind of the general technique.

Cepstral-slope computes a linear regression across cepstral coefficient indices (c[m] = a + b*m). Without the coefficient values, there is no data to regress. Removing cepstral-coefficients as the operand stops cepstral-slope from operating operationally.

Cepstral-correlation computes Pearson correlation between cepstral coefficient sequences — removing the concept of cepstrum removes the data structure this procedure operates on. The procedure requires cepstral coefficients as its input and output.

ADPCM is a specific waveform-coding procedure that maps continuous speech samples to discrete code words via predictive error quantization. Quantization is the general technique of mapping continuous values to discrete representation. A competent speaker calls ADPCM a quantization procedure. Specific to general direction holds. Test: would a competent speaker call ADPCM a quantization? Yes, as a form of quantization.

The nyquist stability criterion evaluates encirclements of the open-loop transfer function L(jw) around the critical point. The criterion's decision rule Z = N + P requires L(s) as input — the transfer function is the constitutive operand. Without transfer-function, the criterion has no loop response to evaluate. DEPENDS_ON removal test passes.

Resonant-peak serves phase-margin as both are complementary relative-stability measures. The resonant-peak magnitude Mr is directly related to damping ratio which determines phase-margin. Together they provide a complete picture of relative stability in feedback systems — resonant-peak quantifies frequency-domain amplification while phase-margin quantifies phase headroom. Both are used together in control design specifications.

The cricoid cartilage forms the complete inferior ring of the laryngeal framework. Per the framework's definition, the cricoid is explicitly enumerated as a constituent member of the six cartilages that comprise the scaffold.

T(s) = 1 - S(s) is the defining relationship between these two constructs. The complementary-sensitivity-function is defined as the complement of the sensitivity-function. Remove S and T loses its definition.

DEPENDS_ON (Laws 8, 8a): removal test. Cepstral envelope is extracted from cepstral coefficients which are derived from log-magnitude spectra via inverse Fourier transform of log magnitude. Without log-magnitude spectrum as the input domain, cepstral coefficients have no values to lifter, and envelope as a cepstral construct is undefined. Direction: cepstral-envelope → log-magnitude-spectrum (dependent → needed). Pinned sense: log-magnitude-spectrum as the log of power spectrum used to compute cepstrum.

A state-observer estimates internal states from outputs. While observability determines whether estimation is possible in principle, controllability determines whether the plant itself has input channels that affect all state directions. A state-observer design must account for controllability because the observer and controller are often co-designed (separation principle): the combined observer-controller requires both controllability and observability for full closed-loop stability. Remove controllability from the map and the state-observer loses its context for how the estimated states will be used — the observer estimates states that a controller will manipulate via input channels, and controllability defines which state directions those input channels can reach. Direction: state-observer depends on controllability for its full design context.

DEPENDS_ON (Laws 8, 8a): removal test. Cepstral envelope is the smooth curve fitted to cepstral coefficients across quefrency. Cepstral coefficients are log-magnitude spectra — samples of the logarithm of the power spectrum. Without the logarithm as the operation that maps magnitude to the cepstral domain, the envelope has no coordinate system in which to exist.
