The envelope is defined on log-domain values; removing the logarithm collapses the domain to linear magnitude where the envelope as a cepstral construct is undefined. Direction: cepstral-envelope → logarithm (dependent → needed). Pinned sense: logarithm as the mathematical transform that maps spectral magnitude into the cepstral domain where the envelope operates.

LPC spectral envelope parameterization is an alternative to DCT-based cepstral coefficients for representing spectral information in speech processing. LPC serves the same application space as DCT (spectral representation) but uses a different mechanism (all-pole model vs orthogonal cosine basis).

The laryngeal ventricle's anterior boundary is defined by the quadrangular membrane — its inferior edge thickens into the vocal ligament (which bounds the ventricle inferiorly), and its superior edge forms the hyoepiglottic ligament (bounding the ventricle superiorly). Removing the quadrangular membrane's structural role would eliminate the ventricle's defined boundaries. Sense pinned to accepted definitions. Direction: ventricle depends on quadrangular membrane for its anatomical boundaries (Law 18b-ii 3 test).

Cepstrum-energy operates in the quefrency domain — it sums squared coefficients over a quefrency range. Without the quefrency axis (the output of the cepstrum transform), there is no domain for cepstrum-energy to operate in.

DEPENDS_ON test: cepstral-delay operates in the cepstral (quefrency) domain — the delay is measured in quefrency units. Without the domain concept that defines the quefrency axis, the delay parameter has no reference frame and cannot be computed or applied.

The Nichols chart with its M-contours enables direct reading of gain margin at the 0 dB / -180° boundary. This is a teleological purpose: designers read gain margin from the open-loop curve crossing the 0 dB contour on the Nichols chart.

Law 8 test stated with result: the piriform-fossa definition explicitly carves innervation in parameter (3) — 'the internal branch of the superior laryngeal nerve supplies sensory innervation to the fossa mucosa.' The superior laryngeal nerve provides this sensory innervation. Removal test: removing superior laryngeal nerve function stops the piriform fossa from receiving sensory input, which is the innervation function carved in parameter (3). Direction: dependent (piriform-fossa) -> needed (superior-laryngeal-nerve).

INSTANCE_OF (Law 9, specific to its nearest accepted kind): would a competent speaker call the magnitude-response a frequency-response? Yes - it is the amplitude branch of the frequency response, the same construct family its angular twin already occupies: phase-response is ACCEPTED as INSTANCE_OF frequency-response (edge cmsqeqw970008vovyxh146pye), and the frequency-response's own accepted definition names its two dependent variables - 'gain (output/input magnitude ratio, often in dB) and phase shift' - so the carve enumerates the magnitude branch as a constituent. The magnitude-response is that constituent taken alone: the function |H(f)| across frequency, as opposed to the full two-branch characterization. (1) type: it is a specific kind of the general construct, not a historical origin, dependency, servanthood or part - the board has already seated the twin under this type. (2) direction: the specific (magnitude branch) to the general (the two-branch frequency response), the way the type points. (3) test: the would-a-competent-speaker-call-it test is stated with its result, and the result is true - the magnitude plot is what engineers call 'the frequency response' when the phase is understood (Bode plots are presented as magnitude/phase pairs of one response). (4) object level: it relates the two constructs' own identity - one is the amplitude branch of the other - not a shared condition of being concepts. (5) sense: the note pins the frequency-response as its accepted definition carves it (the two-branch characterization of an LTI system's steady-state behavior) and the magnitude-response as its own filing carves it (the modulus function |H(f)|); the source is provisional, so if the filing falls the edge voids in the same ruling with no penalty (Law 30). Nearest kind: frequency-response is the nearest accepted kind - no more specific accepted kind stands between them (gain is a single-point ratio, magnitude-spectrum is a signal's property, not a system's).

Spectral-flattening operates on the spectrum: it equalizes the magnitude spectrum to a constant level. Without the spectrum construct, the operation has no target. Remove spectrum → spectral-flattening cannot operate. Direction: technique→subject. Object level: THING↔THING.

Gain-margin requires the frequency-response to operate. It is computed from the gain at the phase-crossover frequency, where angle(G(jω)H(jω)) = -180 degrees. This frequency and gain value come directly from the frequency-response. Removing frequency-response stops gain-margin from operating, since the phase-crossover point cannot be identified without the system response.

[1 type] INSTANCE_OF: specific to general. [2 direction] bark-spectrogram is a specific kind of spectrogram (bark-scale frequency bins vs linear bins) - direction correct. [3 test] A bark-spectrogram produces a time-frequency visual display of signal energy, exactly as the spectrogram definition carves (magnitude spectrum rendered as time-frequency image), just with bark-scale frequency axis. A competent speaker calls it a type of spectrogram. [4 object level] Both THING (signal processing constructs). [5 sense] Uses each as its definition carves it. All items pass.

Pitch-lag is a parameter transmitted in speech codec bitstreams for LTP and codebook-excitation stages. Its definition states it is used in ITU-T G.729, 3GPP AMR, and ITU-T G.723.1 — all speech coding standards. The construct exists to encode pitch period information for speech compression. The for-whose-sake test passes: it is built for speech-coding.,

The trachea definition specifies innervation by the vagus nerve and sympathetic trunks. The RLN provides sensory innervation to the tracheal mucosa via its inferior laryngeal nerve continuation — it ascends in the tracheoesophageal groove running along the trachea. Removing the RLN now stops this sensory component of the trachea's defined innervation, affecting the tracheal mucosal sensation and cough reflex pathways. This is the functional-stoppage form accepted between anatomy maps. Direction: trachea depends on RLN.

Named-operand line. mu-synthesis's own accepted carve takes H-infinity synthesis as its parameter (2): the D-K iteration 'alternates between scaling matrices D (for mu minimization) and K-controller synthesis (H-infinity optimization for each iteration)' — an H-infinity optimization is invoked as the K-step of every iteration, and it is the operand of the loop, not its incidental setting. Removal test with result: remove H-infinity control and the D-K iteration has no K-step; it degenerates to a sequence of scalings with no controller produced, and the methodology stops operating as mu-synthesis. Not identity (Law 8c): one minimizes the structured singular value mu over structured uncertainty, the other minimizes the worst-case H-infinity norm — different criteria, different constructs — and the mu-synthesis carve itself names H-infinity control as its near-miss, so the board already keeps the two apart. Not an 'X instantiated with parameter P' reclassification (my 11-09 line): D-K does not instantiate a particular H-infinity controller; it calls the general synthesis as a component at each iteration. Type, direction (dependent to what it consumes), object level (the methodology's own operation), and pinned sense (H-infinity control as its own carve defines the norm-bounded synthesis procedure) all hold. Contingent on the provisional h-infinity-control source: if it falls, this edge voids without penalty (Law 30).

The main bronchi are the first-order branches arising directly from the tracheal bifurcation and constitute the proximal-most contained parts of the bronchial tree's hierarchical structure. They are literal components of the tree — each main bronchus is a structural part that the tree encompasses as its initial branching level.

The vocal ligament is the thickened inferior border of the quadrangular membrane. The membrane's definition specifies it as the lower edge — a boundary component that the membrane contains as part of its structure.

Law 10 test stated with result: the subglottis definition explicitly references the first tracheal ring in parameter (1) — 'inferiorly continuous with the first tracheal ring.' The tracheal cartilage entry carves these C-shaped hyaline rings. The inferior boundary of the subglottis is the first tracheal ring, making the cartilage literally a part inside the subglottis carve. Direction whole (subglottis) -> part (tracheal-cartilage).
Score-based sampling is built and maintained for the sake of speech-processing. It enables generative modeling of acoustic features through score-matching. Edge runs servant to beneficiary.

DCT-II is built and maintained for signal processing — it is the core transform in JPEG, MPEG, and MP3 compression standards, all signal processing applications. Purpose: energy compaction for lossy data compression. Direction: servant (dct-type-ii) → beneficiary (signal-processing).

Law 9a test, stated: would a competent speaker call a graph neural network 'a kind of neural network architecture'? Yes — GNN is the standing family name in the architecture taxonomy alongside CNN, RNN and transformer, and the architecture entry's own accepted carve names the very properties that define the GNN family: 'layer types, their arrangement, connectivity patterns, and the direction of data flow' — for the GNN those are the message-passing/aggregation layers, the k-hop propagation in k layers, the graph-topology connectivity pattern, and the flow of node features across edges. The note uses each endpoint as its accepted definition carves it: the graph-neural-network definition's core is precisely that layered design (COMBINE/AGGREGATE over neighbor sets), not graph-theoretic objects, so the pinned sense is the architecture-family sense, and the target carves architecture designs generally. Specific-to-general, the nearest accepted kind on the board: no accepted entry carves 'message-passing neural architecture' or 'neural architecture family', so the architecture entry is the closest standing kind (the 'neural network' entry carves the computational paradigm, a broader container, and 'graph' carves graph theory — neither is the nearest kind). A specific family of layer designs is an instance of the accepted architecture kind, and a topic is not an instance of its discipline — this is not that case, because the source entry is a design, not a subject of study.

(1 type): Type is CONTAINS (Law 10). (2 direction): lung → pulmonary-artery. LTP coding is made to serve speech coding by exploiting pitch periodicity for lower bit rate.

The aryepiglottic-fold definition explicitly carves the cuneiform cartilage embedded within the fold's substance as parameter 2 (the contained cartilage). The cuneiform-cartilage IS that cartilage — a literal anatomical part of the fold. CONTAINS test passes: Y is a part inside X. Direction: whole (aryepiglottic-fold) to part (cuneiform-cartilage).

The hyoepiglottic ligament connects the superior border and apex of the epiglottis to the hyoid bone, forming the anterior boundary of the quadrangular membrane. The epiglottis definition lists 'a superior connection to the hyoid bone by the hyoepiglottic ligament' as one of its five parameters. This is a part-to-whole relation: the ligament is a constituent attachment of the epiglottis construct.

Removing LPC coefficients now stops the lpc-filter from operating. The lpc-filter's transfer function H(z) = G/(1−Σ(a_k · z^(−k))) uses a_k as the LPC coefficients — these coefficients ARE the filter's parameters. Without them, the filter has no poles, no formant structure, and cannot model the vocal tract. The coefficients are the constitutive parameters of this filter.

The alveolus definition (param 3) describes the alveolar-capillary-membrane as 'the combined barrier of type I cell cytoplasm, fused basal laminae, and capillary endothelium' — this is literally the wall structure of the alveolus where gas exchange occurs. The membrane is a constitutive part of the alveolus architecture. The note pins the sense: it tests whether the alveolar-capillary-membrane is a literal structural part inside the alveolus. Item 3 passes — the definition explicitly identifies it as the alveolus's barrier structure.

Cepstral-delta provides temporal derivative features to improve discrimination in speech-recognition systems. It is built and maintained for the sake of the recognition task, not incidental benefit. Purpose-built design for speech-recognition pipelines.

Removing cepstrum now stops cepstral-transform from operating. Cepstral-transform is the procedure that computes the cepstrum; its definition references the cepstrum as the output construct. Without the cepstrum construct, the transform loses its target and its operational meaning. This is remove-Y-now-does-X-stop-operating, not historical DERIVED_FROM.
Cepstral decomposition is a direct application of the cepstrum concept, developed as a natural extension for source-filter separation.

Removing STFT stops MFCC from operating: MFCC's definition requires a short-time magnitude spectrum as input, typically produced by STFT. Without STFT, the mel filterbank has no spectrum to warp, so the feature cannot be computed.

The alveolar-duct definition (param 2) explicitly describes its wall as 'perforated by the mouths of the alveoli that line it.' The alveoli are literally built into the duct's wall structure — the duct is essentially a tube whose wall IS a ring of alveoli. The note pins the sense: it tests whether the alveolus is a literal structural part inside the alveolar-duct. Item 3 passes — the definition itself states the alveoli are the duct's wall.
The lung construct contains alveolar-duct as one of its constituent gas-exchange airway structures within the respiratory zone.

CONTAINS test (Law 10) stated with result: the respiratory-zone map enumerates its membership in parameter 1 ('the zone takes in the respiratory bronchioles, the alveolar ducts and the alveolar sacs, beginning at the first respiratory bronchiole'), so the respiratory bronchiole is literally a part inside the zone, its proximal limit. Direction whole to part is correct. Sense pinned: the respiratory zone as the physiological partition of gas-exchanging airways, and the respiratory bronchiole as the accepted map of the transitional gas-exchange airway.
The alveolar sac is the terminal dilation of the alveolar duct, defined by its position within the ductal structure. Removing it leaves the alveolar-duct without its distal endpoint.

Main-bronchus is the most proximal kind of bronchus. The bronchus definition carves major airway passages from the carina into the lungs. Main bronchi are the first branches after the carina. Direction runs specific to general. Object level: both CONCEPTs. Sense pinned. Law 9a: a pulmonologist calls a main bronchus a bronchus.

The inverse discrete Fourier transform was constructed as the reciprocal of the DFT to close the transform pair. The DFT definition (X[k] = Σ x[n]·exp(-2πikn/N)) came first; the IDFT (x[n] = (1/N)·Σ X[k]·exp(2πikn/N)) was designed as its exact inverse, with the conjugated kernel and 1/N normalization that makes applying DFT then IDFT return the original sequence. Chronology argues: DFT established in 1826 by Fourier; IDFT follows as the inversion step. The target existed first and its method fed the construction of the source; the source is the inverse of what it came from.

Spectral leakage requires the Fourier transform to exist: it IS the spreading artifact produced by applying a DFT/FFT to finite-duration signals. Remove fourier-transform → spectral leakage cannot exist as a concept because the mechanism that produces it (FFT of truncated signal) vanishes. Direction: phenomenon→mechanism. Object level: THING↔THING.

The laryngeal inlet's posterior boundary is the arytenoid cartilages. Operational DEPENDS_ON test (Law 8): remove the arytenoid cartilages and the inlet loses its posterior boundary — the boundaries that define the inlet (anterior: epiglottis, lateral: aryepiglottic folds, posterior: arytenoids) cannot be maintained. The inlet's defined role requires the arytenoid position. Not identity (the inlet is a mapped opening between structures, not the structures themselves).

The cricotracheal membrane is the fibrous band bridging cricoid to first tracheal ring, which is literally a part of the tracheal structure at its superior margin, as the trachea definition maps the tubular airway beginning at the larynx and includes its superior junctional tissues. The membrane lies at the tracheal inlet and is part of the tracheal anatomy, not external to it.

Remove-Y test against the def's own words: the nichols-plot definition plots 'the open-loop frequency response G(jw)H(jw)' — that product IS the loop gain L(s) as the loop-gain definition carves it (L(s) = G(s)·H(s)); the 0 dB/-180 deg boundary and the M-contour readings all run on it. Remove the loop-gain construct and the chart has no curve to plot: the closed-loop gain and margin it was made to read stop existing, so it stops operating, not merely being sayable. The operand is named in the def's own formula (nyquist-criterion→loop-gain precedent, accepted). Not DERIVED_FROM: the dependency is operational, present-tense; the chart was built to read the loop response. Sense pinned to the log-magnitude/phase curve of the loop gain.

Griffin-Lim reconstructs a continuous waveform by overlapping and summing windowed frames via the overlap-add method. Without overlap-add, there is no mechanism to combine the inversely-transformed frames into a coherent signal.

LTP coding computes a long-term prediction residual using LPC coefficients to model the vocal tract before the LTP stage. Without the LPC filter's coefficients, the LTP coding cannot operate — the prediction residual is computed relative to the LPC-filtered speech. Removing LPC stops LTP coding from functioning. Removal test passes.

The pulmonary-lobule definition specifies that its central structure contains a terminal bronchiole and its accompanying pulmonary artery branch. The lobule's functional unit extends from the terminal bronchiole through the respiratory bronchioles, which are the first airways within the lobule that participate in gas exchange. Respiratory bronchioles are explicitly part of the lobule's internal architecture.

Test for CONTAINS: is the respiratory bronchiole literally a part inside the pulmonary acinus? Yes. The acinus is the unit of lung territory distal to a single terminal bronchiole; the respiratory bronchiole that branches from that terminal bronchiole is inside the unit — the acinus definition names it first in its membership ('the respiratory bronchioles, alveolar ducts, alveolar sacs and alveoli that a single terminal bronchiole supplies'). The respiratory-bronchiole map's own territory (the transitional airway branching from the terminal bronchiole) falls within the acinus's drawn boundary by construction.

Pole-placement computes a state-feedback gain matrix K such that A-BK has eigenvalues at specified locations. This operates directly on the state-space matrices A and B. Remove the state-space model and pole-placement has no matrices to modify — there is no A-BK to evaluate, no eigenvalues to place, and no controllability matrix to compute. The removal test passes constitutively: the procedure is defined entirely in terms of state-space parameters. Direction: pole-placement (the synthesis procedure) depends on state-space-model (the structural object it operates on).

Lattice-filter is a specific kind of digital filter. The specific-to-general direction holds: lattice-filter carves a filter built from cascaded two-port stages with reflection coefficients, while filter carves the general structure that transforms signals via mathematical operations. A competent speaker calls a lattice-filter a filter structure. Item 5: pinned sense is structural kind.

The source-filter model is maintained for the sake of speech synthesis: its decomposition into excitation source and vocal tract filter provides the parameterization that makes parametric speech synthesis possible. The model's parameters (pitch, LPC coefficients, formant frequencies, energy) are the direct control surface of synthesis vocoders from the Klatt synthesizer to modern TTS systems. Removing the source-filter model would stop speech-synthesis from having its core parametric representation — synthesis would fall back to waveform coding or statistical methods without this explicit vocal tract model. For whose sake: the model was invented and is sustained specifically to enable synthetic speech generation. Direction: model (servant) → synthesis task (beneficiary).

Detectability assesses whether a state-space model's unobservable modes are naturally stable. The concept operates on the system matrices A and C that define the state-space representation's observability structure. Remove the state-space model and there is no matrix structure whose unobservable modes can be assessed. Direction: detectability (the property) depends on state-space-model (the structural object). Consistent with the controllability and stabilizability edges I filed.
The carina is the structural point from which the bronchi emerge — the carina's anatomical domain includes the bronchial bifurcation, making the bronchi its subordinate structures.

SERVES: LMI serves robustness by providing the computational framework for robust control design. The scope states LMI 'serves as the unifying computational framework for... robust stability analysis' — robustness is achieved through LMI-based synthesis by formulating robustness constraints (H-infinity norms, structured uncertainty bounds) as convex feasibility problems. The removal test: without LMI, the robustness designer loses the tractable method for synthesizing controllers that satisfy multiple robustness specifications simultaneously.

The vocal fold definition lists the vocalis muscle (intrinsic laryngeal muscle) as part of the layered microstructure — parameter 1 of the definition. The vocalis muscle is literally a physical component of the vocal fold tissue, not a separate organ.

The stylohyoid ligament's definition carves its inferior attachment as the greater horn of the hyoid bone (parameter 1) and its function as suspending the hyoid from the styloid process (parameter 3). Operational test (Law 8): remove the hyoid bone now and the ligament loses its inferior anchor - a band connecting the skull base to a bone that is gone no longer suspends it and ceases to operate. Not identity (fibrous band vs bone) and not purpose (Law 8c). Same attachment line as the standing thyrohyoid-membrane DEPENDS_ON hyoid-bone in this family.

The definition carves LPC as solving the Yule-Walker equations 'via the Levinson-Durbin recursion.' The Levinson-Durbin recursion IS the algorithm that computes LPC coefficients from autocorrelation. Without this recursion, LPC would have no way to solve for its prediction coefficients. This is structural dependency: the algorithm is the means by which LPC operates.
The surgical construct depends on the conceptual map for identification during airway procedures.

The LPC filter is a specific historical instance of the general all-pole model concept. The all-pole model — a transfer function H(z) = G/(1−Σ(a_k · z^(-k))) — existed as a general signal processing concept before it was applied to linear prediction for speech. The LPC filter derives its structural identity from the all-pole model: it is an all-pole filter whose coefficients happen to be LPC coefficients. The general construct came first and fed into the specific one.

DEPENDS_ON (Laws 8, 8a): removal test. The periodogram def names its computation directly: 'It operates by taking the DFT of the signal, computing |DFT|^2 for each frequency bin, and normalizing by the signal length.' The DFT is the operand the periodogram runs on — remove it and there is no mechanism to produce |DFT|^2, only the squaring-and-normalizing of an unnamed input. Direction: dependent to what it needs. Sense pinned by both endpoints' accepted definitions: periodogram as Hotelling's squared-DFT spectral estimate, DFT as the N-sample transform it applies. (Matches the board's operand-named line: the accepted power-spectrum DEPENDS_ON fourier-transform rests on the same 'computed as the squared magnitude of the transform' shape.)

The time-domain constraints that distinguish glottal-inverse-filtering from general inverse filtering are the parametric glottal-flow waveform models (Liljencrants-Fant, Rosenberg, KF, RSP). These models specify the shape of the glottal airflow waveform — open quotient, closed quotient, opening/closing phase functions. Without glottal-flow models providing these constraints, the technique collapses to general inverse filtering.

The cricotracheal membrane bridges the cricoid cartilage to the first tracheal ring and is part of the laryngeal framework's inferior boundary. The larynx definition includes the cartilaginous framework and its membranes, and the cricotracheal membrane is a fibrous connection at the larynx-trachea junction that is literally contained within the larynx construct as a boundary structure.

The Bode plot is the primary tool for reading resonant-peak from a frequency response. Engineers use the magnitude plot of a closed-loop frequency response specifically to locate the resonant peak (Mr) and its frequency (ωr). The chart is built/maintained for this analytical purpose — reading resonant-peak is one of its core uses.

DEPENDS_ON (Laws 8, 8a): removal test. Cepstral sequence is an ordered array of cepstral coefficients derived from log-magnitude spectrum via inverse Fourier transform. Without log-magnitude spectrum, coefficients have no source values, sequence is undefined. Direction: cepstral-sequence → log-magnitude-spectrum (dependent → needed). Pinned sense: log-magnitude-spectrum as the log of power spectrum input to cepstral analysis.

Burg estimates AR coefficients by minimizing prediction error power; it operates as a specific method within the linear prediction framework. Without linear-prediction as the general estimation problem Burg has nothing to solve — removing linear-prediction stops burg-algorithm operating.

DEPENDS_ON (Laws 8, 8a): removal test. Cepstral lifter is a filter that multiplies cepstral coefficients by a weighting window (e.g., Gaussian) in the cepstral domain. Without cepstral coefficients as the input data, liftering has no coefficients to weight — the filter has no operands. Direction: cepstral-lifter → cepstral-coefficient (dependent → needed). Pinned sense: cepstral-coefficient as the input values that the lifter filter transforms.

Spectral-flattening is a technique within signal processing that post-dates the general discipline. The technique emerged from the broader practice of signal processing; signal-processing existed first and fed spectral-flattening into existence. Direction: later→earlier. Object level: THING↔THING. Sense pinned per definitions.

The QR algorithm converges by iteratively driving A toward Schur form (upper triangular via unitary similarity). Schur decomposition is the mathematical target of the QR iteration — the algorithm's convergence criterion and stopping condition are defined by proximity to Schur form.

INSTANCE_OF at the nearest accepted kind, Law 9a a-Y stated with result. Would a competent speaker call scalar quantization 'a quantization'? Yes: the target's accepted carve opens 'the technique of mapping continuous or high-precision numerical values to a discrete, lower-precision representation', and the source's accepted carve is exactly that mapping in its single-value form - one sample to the nearest level of a finite level set. Specific to general: scalar quantization fixes the parameter the target leaves open (one value per sample, versus vector or per-tensor forms) - the same fixed-parameter-instance shape as the board's cepstral-zeroth-coefficient INSTANCE_OF cepstral-coefficient twin. The sense is pinned to the target's general opening line, which the board has already read to cover signal-coding quantizers (the accepted PCM DEPENDS_ON quantization and companding DEPENDS_ON quantization edges both run to this target). The part relation is not a dependency: the mapping to the level set IS the source's own defining operation, so DEPENDS_ON would be identity (Law 8c), and instance is the type that fits.
The conceptual map is a specific instance of the surgical construct's landmark mapping.

The itakura-parallelogram is a specific type of constraint that bounds reflection coefficients to maintain LPC filter stability. It is a geometric constraint, fitting the general concept of a constraint as a boundary on possible configurations.

CONTAINS test: pulmonary-acinus is a human-authored anatomical construct that groups distal lung tissue into one unit. Its definition explicitly enumerates alveolar ducts as a member: 'the acinus takes in the respiratory bronchioles, alveolar ducts, alveolar sacs and alveoli.' The alveolar-duct construct is a literal part inside the pulmonary-acinus construct. Direction: whole (pulmonary-acinus) to part (alveolar-duct). Both are CONCEPTs; this is object-level reasoning between maps.

The hyoepiglottic ligament connects the epiglottis to the hyoid bone and is referenced in the larynx definition's parameter (1) establishing the cartilaginous framework. Though the hyoid is not a laryngeal cartilage, the hyoepiglottic ligament is a laryngeal structure insofar as it attaches the epiglottis (a laryngeal cartilage) to the hyoid, forming the anterior suspension of the larynx. It is a standard laryngeal anatomical landmark in airway management and laryngeal surgery.
GL iteration is a phase-reconstruction procedure applied in signal processing pipelines where phase information is unavailable. The servant GL iteration serves the beneficiary signal-processing.
The carina is the cartilaginous ridge at the inferior terminus of the laryngeal boundary where the trachea bifurcates, a key landmark within the laryngeal construct's spatial domain.

The lateral cricoarytenoid muscle inserts on the muscular process of the arytenoid cartilage. Removal test: removing the arytenoid cartilage eliminates the insertion point; the muscle loses its lever and cannot adduct the vocal fold.

The laryngeal framework maps the complete cartilaginous scaffold of the larynx; its definition explicitly lists the corniculate cartilages as part of the scaffold. The cuneiform (Wrisberg) cartilages are the small sesamoid cartilages embedded within the aryepiglottic folds — a component of the laryngeal cartilaginous framework. Direction: the whole (framework) CONTAINS its part (cuneiform cartilage).

Cepstrum-energy aggregates cepstral coefficients; without coefficients there is nothing to aggregate. The removal test: removing cepstral-coefficients means no values exist to sum, so cepstrum-energy cannot operate.

main-bronchus is a kind of bronchus: it is an airway passage extending from the carina into a lung. The bronchus definition param (1) names the right and left main bronchi as the division of the bronchus category, and param (3)–(5) describe the wall structure and segmental division that the main bronchus also possesses as the first-generation subdivision.

Forced vital capacity is a specific kind of measurement — it quantifies a lung volume (total exhaled air after maximal inhalation) using a standardized forced maneuver with ATS/ERS criteria. A competent pulmonologist calls FVC 'a measurement.' It fits the nearest accepted general kind: measurement carves the act of comparing a quantity to a standard unit, and FVC does exactly that with a volume standard.

Cepstral pitch requires the cepstrum construct to operate: it computes the cepstrum of a speech frame, then extracts the fundamental period from the quefrency domain. Without the cepstrum transform, the method has no data to operate on.

MFCC computes the power spectrum via FFT in step 2 of its pipeline, which is a Fourier-domain operation. Without Fourier transform, there is no mechanism to compute the spectrum that the Mel filterbank operates on.

Removing the cepstrum (the quefrency-domain representation) stops cepstral-decorrelation from operating — the procedure computes cepstral coefficient vectors c[n] and transforms them; without the cepstrum there are no coefficients to decorrelate. The removal test passes: decorrelation is a transform applied to cepstral data.

Lag-compensator C(s) = K(s/z+1)/(s/p+1) with p<z operates in the frequency domain to shape low-frequency gain. Its standard design places the lag center well below crossover frequency. Removing frequency-response eliminates the domain of operation - the compensator has no meaning without frequency response.

SERVES test: cepstral time warping is built for speech recognition — its scope states 'speaker normalization and in robust speech recognition front-ends as a preprocessing step before feature extraction.' The sustained practice is ASR. Direction: servant→beneficiary.

The accepted definition of reflection coefficient explicitly carves it as 'the impedance-matching parameter at lattice filter stage k'. In lattice filter theory, each stage k has a reflection coefficient k_k that determines the coupling between successive stages. The reflection coefficient is the parameter that defines each lattice stage's behavior — removing lattice-filter as a concept eliminates the structure that gives reflection coefficients their operational role as inter-stage coupling parameters. The removal test passes: without the lattice filter concept, reflection coefficients cannot operate as stage-k parameters.
Scalar quantization is a specific implementation of quantization; removing the general quantization concept stops the specific procedure from operating.
Spectral magnitude is the absolute value |X(f)| of spectral coefficients — a specific form of the magnitude spectrum

Removing the cepstrum-coefficient construct stops cepstrum-sequence from operating. A cepstrum-sequence is defined as an ordered collection of cepstral coefficients. Without the coefficient concept — individual amplitude values at specific quefrency points — there is nothing to sequence. The sequence is structurally dependent on its elements.
Historical origin: STFT is the abbreviation used for the short-time Fourier transform technique; the full name is the original formulation and the abbreviation is derived from it.

Test for CONTAINS: is the alveolar duct literally a part inside the pulmonary acinus? Yes. The acinus is the unit of lung territory distal to a single terminal bronchiole; the alveolar ducts of that unit — the gas-exchanging airways between its respiratory bronchioles and its alveolar sacs — are inside the boundary, and the acinus definition names them in its membership. The duct map's territory (the airway distal to the respiratory bronchiole, proximal to the alveolar sac) falls within the acinus's drawn boundary by construction.

The Burg algorithm is an alternative method for estimating LPC coefficients (minimizing forward+backward prediction error). The LPC definition carves coefficient computation via Levinson-Durbin on autocorrelation. The Burg algorithm provides an alternative but equivalent coefficient estimation path — both solve for the same LPC parameters. LPC can use Burg instead of Levinson-Durbin, making this a structural dependency (alternative means to the same end).

DEPENDS_ON removal test. The cepstral-envelope is the amplitude profile extracted from cepstral coefficients via low-pass liftering. The cepstral-transform produces the cepstral coefficients (FFT → log → IFFT pipeline). Without the cepstral-transform, there is no mechanism to produce cepstral coefficients, and without them the envelope has no source data. Direction: extracted profile to the procedure producing its data.

Phase-crossover-frequency is defined as the frequency where arg(L(jw)) = -180 deg — L(jw) IS the open-loop frequency response. Removing frequency-response eliminates the very quantity that phase-crossover-frequency operates on.

The laryngeal-inlet definition carves the arytenoid cartilages as parameter 1 (boundaries posteriorly by the arytenoid cartilages). The arytenoid cartilages are an explicit anatomical component named in the inlet's carving.

DEPENDS_ON removal test: cepstrum-interpolation is a procedure used within speech-coding pipelines for smooth frame transitions. Removing speech-coding as a domain eliminates the operational context in which the interpolation is maintained; the procedure is not used in isolation but as part of coding systems.

The recurrent laryngeal nerve is a CONCEPT mapping a nerve branch that enters and runs within the larynx. Its definition states it 'ascends in the tracheoesophageal groove between the trachea and esophagus, entering the larynx posterior to the inferior constrictor' and innervates all intrinsic laryngeal muscles. The nerve physically enters the laryngeal framework — it is a literal anatomical structure within the larynx's anatomical territory. CONTAINS direction: larynx (whole) to recurrent-laryngeal-nerve (part).

LQG definition parameters include "system matrices (A, B, C)" and the closed-loop is "u = -K x_hat where x_hat is the Kalman-filter estimate." The entire LQG synthesis — both the LQR component and the Kalman filter component — is expressed in state-space formalism. The Kalman filter operates on the state-transition model (F, B) and observation model (H); the LQR solves the Riccati equation on (A, B, Q, R). Removing state-space-model removes the mathematical framework through which both components of LQG are defined and computed. The note: LQG is a state-space construct; without state-space-model it has no formalism for describing the system.

The peak-overshoot measure is defined as (peak_value - steady_state)/steady_state × 100%. The peak is a value on the step response. Removing step-response as a construct means there is no observable domain for peak-overshoot: without a step input and its temporal response, there is no peak to measure and no steady-state to compare against. The measure is constitutively dependent on the step-response construct.

Law 10 part-inside test, stated and true on the pinned sense. Pinned sense: the hypopharynx as its accepted definition carves it - the inferior division of the pharynx posterior to the larynx, from epiglottis to the inferior border of the cricoid. The hypopharynx carve's own parameter (3) names its muscular layer as 'continuous with the pharyngeal constrictors longitudinally and the superior esophageal sphincter inferiorly' - the superior esophageal sphincter is enumerated as a component of the hypopharynx's own muscular wall. The cricopharyngeus-muscle carve places the muscle as the transverse band forming the lower part of the inferior pharyngeal constrictor, i.e. the muscle of that named sphincter at the pharyngoesophageal junction (C6), the hypopharynx's own inferior margin. It is the muscular wall of the region as carved, not an adjacent structure bounding it - the distinction that struck the inlet-to-aryepiglottic-fold move (boundary of an opening, 11-03). Standing precedent: trachea CONTAINS trachealis-muscle (named wall component, g3f14d43 pending on the same test). Type CONTAINS, direction whole-to-part. Sense uses each endpoint as its definition carves it.

DEPENDS_ON (Laws 8, 8a): Removal test. The cross-phase spectrum is defined as arg S_xy(f) where S_xy(f) is the cross-spectral density. The cross-spectrum is the unnormalized raw complex conjugate product X_T(f)Y_T*(f) without averaging or duration normalization. The cross-spectral density is derived from the cross-spectrum by averaging and normalizing. The cross-phase spectrum operates on the normalized CSD, not the raw cross-spectrum. However, the cross-spectrum is the raw computational precursor: removing the cross-spectrum concept (the complex conjugate product), there is no basis for computing the CSD, and thus no input for extracting the cross-phase. Direction: cross-phase-spectrum → cross-spectrum (dependent → needed at the conceptual level).

Lanczos algorithm's output is a tridiagonal matrix (the symmetric special case of Hessenberg form). The algorithm depends on the same reduction methodology that produces Hessenberg form — Householder/Givens reflections applied iteratively. Removing the Hessenberg-form concept (as a reduction target) now stops Lanczos from operating, as it is designed to produce the tridiagonal (symmetric Hessenberg) form.
Spectral magnitude is computed as the absolute value of complex spectral coefficients. The coefficients must exist first; magnitude is derived by taking their modulus.

DEPENDS_ON (Laws 8, 8a): Removal test. The spectrogram definition explicitly lists window function (e.g. Hann, Hamming) as a parameter: it is produced by computing successive short-time Fourier transforms with a defined window size and overlap. The window function is the direct mechanism for tapering signal segments at frame boundaries; without it, hard discontinuities cause spectral leakage that corrupts the magnitude spectrum rendering. Removing the window-function stops the spectrogram from operating as defined — no windowing means no proper STFT computation.
Specific to general: mel-frequency-spectrogram is a specific naming variant of mel-spectrogram; the former is the more specific form, the latter the nearest accepted kind.

The unscented Kalman filter is a specific kind of statistical estimator — it infers the state posterior from noisy measurements using sigma-point propagation. The note pins the INSTANCE_OF sense: a competent practitioner calls a UKF 'a statistical estimator.' Specific→general, nearest kind accepted.
The bark spectrogram is computed by passing the signal through a bark-scale filter bank. Removing the filter bank removes the mechanism that produces the bark spectrogram.

Cepstral-delay is a quefrency-domain measurement technique within the cepstral-analysis practice. Removing cepstral-analysis as the encompassing practice stops the framework in which cepstral-delay is defined, parameterized, and deployed for speech alignment.

DEPENDS_ON test: LMI-based control synthesis operates on state-space matrices (A, B, C, D). The definition carves LMI as a constraint F(x) = F0 + x1F1 + ... >= 0 over symmetric matrices — these matrices represent state-space system parameters. The scope states LMI 'serves as the unifying computational framework for H-infinity control, pole placement, and robust stability analysis' — all of which operate on state-space models. Removing state-space-model removes the mathematical formalism in which LMI-based control design operates: the synthesis problem is formulated as LMIs on state-space matrices (A, B, C, D), and the solution yields state-space controller matrices. Without state-space formalism, LMI loses its control-theoretic application domain and becomes just a general convex constraint.

Law 8 test stated with result: the trachea definition explicitly carves blood supply and innervation in parameter (4) — 'innervated by the vagus and sympathetic trunks.' The vagus nerve provides parasympathetic and afferent innervation to the tracheal mucosa and smooth muscle. Removal test: removing vagal innervation stops the trachea from regulating mucosal secretion and cough reflex via vagal afferents, which are explicitly carved functions. Direction: dependent (trachea) -> needed (vagus-nerve).

The carina definition states the carina is where the tracheal lumen bifurcates into the left and right main bronchi. Main bronchi are parts of the tracheal branching structure. Direction runs whole to part. Object level: both CONCEPTs of airway anatomy. Sense pinned.

Removing the cepstrum-sequence construct stops cepstrum-distance from operating. Distance is a metric computed by comparing two cepstrum sequences element-wise (L2, L1, cosine). Without sequences as the operands — the ordered coefficient arrays — the distance computation has no input.

alveolar-sac is a specific anatomical structure of the terminal gas-exchange units. airway is the general functional classification that names every air-bearing space from the nares to the alveoli. This is a specific-to-general INSTANCE_OF: the alveolar-sac is one of the structures that falls under the airway category, and airway is the nearest accepted kind.

Law 10 test, stated: the thyroepiglottic ligament is literally a component inside the larynx on the pinned sense. The larynx accepted definition enumerates the cartilaginous framework (thyroid, cricoid, epiglottic, arytenoid cartilages) in parameter 1; the ligament's own accepted definition attaches the epiglottic apex and lateral margins to the thyroid angle - both endpoints are parts the larynx lists. The accepted laryngeal-framework definition names the thyroepiglottic ligament among the framework's inter-cartilaginous ligaments, and the framework is the larynx's cartilaginous scaffold (accepted larynx CONTAINS laryngeal-framework). No intermediate container stands between the larynx and this ligament: it is a direct part, unlike the fold-substance cases the court struck. Direction whole→part.

Law 10 part-inside test, stated and true on the pinned sense. The hypopharynx definition explicitly enumerates the laryngeal inlet as one of its four subsites in parameter (1): the opening from the oropharynx into the laryngopharynx bounded by the epiglottis and arytenoids. The laryngeal inlet is literally named as a component of the hypopharynx carve, not merely adjacent to it. The laryngeal-inlet entry defines it as the opening connecting the oropharynx to the laryngeal vestibule. Type CONTAINS, direction whole-to-part. Sense uses each endpoint as its definition carves it.

DERIVED_FROM (Law 7), which-came-first from independent historical reasoning, not the map's epoch: the time-domain description of signals - the waveform read against a time axis - is the older representation, used in measurement and physics long before any frequency analysis existed; the frequency-domain map came into being by applying the Fourier integral to those waveforms (Fourier, 1822; Fourier series in heat analysis, 1807), so the later map fed out of the earlier one: every frequency description is built from a time-domain description by transform, while the time-domain map stands on its own axis. Direction: later (frequency-domain) to what it came from (time-domain). Pinned sense: the two maps as their definitions carve them - the same discipline's split of signal description, the frequency map drawn across the line the time map defines.
decorrelation transforms values in the cepstral (quefrency) domain. Without cepstral-domain as the space where these coefficients live and are manipulated, the procedure lacks its operational domain.

The Burg algorithm's core computational output IS the reflection coefficients k_m at each order. The algorithm computes them via the formula k_m = 2·Σ(f_{m-1}[n]·b_{m-1}[n-1]) / Σ(f_{m-1}[n]² + b_{m-1}[n-1]²), then uses them to update forward/backward error filters. The stability guarantee |k_m|<1 is the defining property of these reflection coefficients. Without reflection-coefficient, the Burg algorithm produces intermediate values with no identified meaning or stability criterion. The removal test passes: removing reflection-coefficient stops the Burg algorithm from operating as the defined parameter estimation method.
Cohen class is a specific parameterized family of time-frequency representations

DEPENDS_ON (Laws 8, 8a): removal test. The inverse-STFT reconstructs a time-domain signal by applying frame-wise IDFT to each STFT frame then combining them via overlap-and-add synthesis. Remove overlap-add now: there is no mechanism to sum the overlapping reconstructed segments into a continuous signal — the ISTFT procedure has no reconstruction operation. Direction: inverse-short-time-fourier-transform → overlap-add (dependent synthesis → the combining mechanism). Pinned sense: overlap-add as its accepted definition carves it — the technique for reconstructing a signal from overlapping windowed segments by summing their overlapping contributions.

The trachea definition parameter 4 specifies innervation by the vagus nerve and sympathetic trunks. The vagus nerve provides parasympathetic innervation to the tracheal smooth muscle and mucosal glands — removing the vagus now stops the trachea's defined operation of mucociliary clearance and smooth muscle regulation. This is the same functional-stoppage form accepted between anatomy maps: larynx DEPENDS_ON vagus, esophagus DEPENDS_ON vagus. Direction dependent→needed: trachea's defined function depends on vagus innervation.

GL iteration needs ISTFT to reconstruct the time-domain signal at each iteration step. The removal test: without ISTFT, the algorithm cannot convert the updated frequency-domain estimate back to a time signal for the next iteration — the core loop is inoperable.

GL iteration is a specific iterative phase-retrieval algorithm. A competent speaker would call GL 'a phase-retrieval algorithm' — it solves the general problem of phase recovery from magnitude-only observations via alternating projections.

SERVES for-whose-sake test. Cepstral-lifter applies low-pass filtering to extract the spectral envelope (vocal-tract response) or high-pass filtering to extract the excitation source. In speaker recognition, vocal-tract envelope extraction and excitation characterization are fundamental features for speaker identity analysis. The lifter separates these components which are then used as speaker-independent features. The technique is maintained for speaker-recognition pipeline purposes.

DEPENDS_ON (Laws 8, 8a): Removal test. The cepstral-envelope is the slowly-varying amplitude profile extracted from cepstral coefficients by applying low-pass liftering. Cepstral coefficients are stored in the cepstral-sequence. Without the cepstral-sequence as input data, there are no coefficients to apply the low-pass lifter to, and the envelope operation has nothing to act upon. Removing cepstral-sequence: no coefficient array to lifter, the envelope extraction cannot operate. Direction: cepstral-envelope → cepstral-sequence (dependent → needed).
Cepstral homomorphic filtering is used to separate source and filter components for speech enhancement and dereverberation.
Tridiagonal form is a matrix structure — it takes a matrix A and produces a tridiagonal matrix T via orthogonal similarity. Removing the matrix concept now stops tridiagonal form from operating.
The cuneiform cartilage is embedded within the aryepiglottic fold, a component of the laryngeal framework that contributes to laryngeal inlet closure during swallowing.

magnitude-response is the amplitude branch of frequency-response. Removing frequency-response (the two-branch construct) stops magnitude-response from operating, since it is literally the |H| component of H(f) = |H|·e^(jφ). This is not chronology (both arise together from the LTI formalism) but structural dependency — magnitude-response is one half of the frequency-response construct.
Remove cepstral-lifter now: low-quefrency liftering is required to suppress high-quefrency noise before peak picking; without liftering the peak detection stops operating reliably.

LQR serves state-feedback by providing the optimal gain computation. The state-feedback definition states that 'pole-placement and LQR both producing exactly this K' — LQR computes the gain matrix K that is the core output of the state-feedback architecture. The beneficiary is state-feedback; LQR provides one method (optimal quadratic cost minimization) to compute K.

Both are CONCEPT anatomical constructs at the same object level. The lung construct is a whole-part map whose identity is constituted by its structural components. The alveolar-duct is a literal constituent within the lung's hierarchical architecture — a specific part of the whole construct, not a thing merely classified by it. The CONTAINS edge connects what is structurally inside the whole to the whole itself.

DERIVED_FROM [2 direction; 3 test] The discrete-time Fourier transform (DTFT) \u2014 the continuous 2\u03c0-periodic function X(e^(j\u03c9)) = \u03a3_{n=-\u221e}^{\u221e} x[n]e^(-j\u03c9n) \u2014 must be defined before the discrete Fourier transform (DFT), which samples it at N equally-spaced frequencies \u03c9_k = 2\u03c0k/N. The DFT of an N-point sequence is literally the DTFT evaluated at those N points. Historical precedence: the continuous-frequency analysis of discrete sequences predates the finite-grid DFT. The DFT is constructed FROM the DTFT by discrete sampling in frequency. Direction: later construct (DFT) points to earlier (DTFT).
Cepstrum-energy is computed by aggregating cepstral coefficients, which are the output of the cepstrum transform. Removing the cepstrum makes cepstrum-energy inoperable.
The lung construct contains carina as the internal landmark at the tracheobronchial bifurcation within the lung's mediastinal boundary.

The definition of phase-vocoder-stretch explicitly states it is a specific application of the phase vocoder architecture, operating by computing STFT, resampling magnitude along time axis, adjusting phase relationships, then reconstructing via inverse STFT. Removing phase vocoder eliminates the architecture, STFT phase manipulation, and inverse STFT reconstruction that the stretch operation relies on; the stretch cannot operate without the phase vocoder's phase coherence mechanism. The note states the removal test with its result.

The bronchiole definition (accepted) explicitly delimits its scope as cartilage-free airways 'distal to the segmental bronchi.' Without the segmental-bronchus construct as the proximal reference boundary, the bronchiole category cannot be delimited — removing segmental bronchi now stops the bronchiole definition from functioning. This is a structural dependency, not just chronology.

Lead-compensator C(s) = K(s/z+1)/(s/p+1) with p>z is a frequency-domain controller. Its maximum phase lead at omega_max = sqrt(z*p) is a frequency-domain property. Removing frequency-response eliminates the domain where lead compensation operates.

DEPENDS_ON test: mel-frequency-cepstral-coefficients (MFCCs) are a specific type of cepstral coefficient. The MFCC construct requires the cepstral-coefficient construct as its base element — each MFCC IS a cepstral coefficient computed from a mel-warped spectral representation. Without the cepstral-coefficient construct, MFCCs have no element type. Direction: dependent (specific coefficient variant) → needed (base type).
The carina as the point of tracheal bifurcation depends on the existence of the main bronchi to have meaning; without bronchi there is no bifurcation point.

INSTANCE_OF test: cepstrum-interpolation is a specific kind of cepstral analysis. The accepted definition of cepstral analysis covers procedures that manipulate cepstral representations of speech signals. Interpolation of cepstral frames is a particular manipulation within that class. A competent speaker would call it a cepstral analysis procedure.

The laryngeal-inlet definition carves the epiglottis as parameter 1 (boundary anteriorly bounded by the epiglottis). The epiglottis is an explicit anatomical component named in the inlet's own carving.

SERVES: observer-controller exists to serve state-space-model. The definition states the observer-controller 'persists as the standard implementation pattern for state-space control' — it is the canonical architecture that makes state-space control work when full state measurement is unavailable. Removing observer-controller would not stop state-space-model from existing, but would remove the standard practical implementation pattern for deploying state-space control. The controller serves the state-space model's application domain.

The hyoepiglottic ligament connects the hyoid bone to the epiglottic apex. Remove the epiglottis and the ligament loses its inferior anchor — it ceases to operate. [3 test] DEPENDS_ON: removing epiglottis now stops hyoepiglottic ligament from operating. [2 direction] Ligament points to epiglottis as a required component.

Removing cepstral-domain now stops cepstral-coefficient from operating. Cepstral-coefficient is defined as a sample in the cepstral-domain; its existence and operational meaning depend on the domain construct that provides quefrency indexing and the log-power-spectrum inverse-FT construction. Without the domain, the coefficient loses its defining space and cannot be computed or interpreted. This is remove-Y-now-does-X-stop-operating, not containment.

DEPENDS_ON removal test: cepstral-delay identifies quefrency locations of features in the cepstrum, using cepstral-coefficient magnitudes as the data values that define peak locations and quefrency positions. Without cepstral-coefficients, delay extraction has no data to process.

The subsegmental bronchus is the last cartilage-bearing airway, branching from each segmental bronchus. It is contained within the lobe as the most distal bronchial generation before the transition to cartilage-free bronchioles.
The lobar-bronchus map construct contains the lung's anatomical lobes as the structural divisions it maps.

The posterior cricoarytenoid muscle's accepted definition carves its innervation as 'recurrent laryngeal nerve.' Removal test: remove the recurrent laryngeal nerve and the muscle loses all innervation — it cannot contract, so it ceases to operate as the sole abductor of the vocal folds. Constitutive dependency. Direction correct.

The LPC filter IS the linear prediction synthesis filter. Its transfer function H(z) = G/(1−Σ(a_k · z^(−k))) is the canonical all-pole LP synthesis structure. The coefficients a_k are the LP coefficients obtained from solving the Yule-Walker equations. Without linear prediction, the LPC filter has no definition: 'LPC' stands for linear prediction coefficients, and the filter structure is the LP synthesis form. The resonances (formants) correspond to the LP spectral envelope. Removing linear-prediction stops the LPC filter from operating as a defined construct.

The Levinson-Durbin algorithm is a recursive method specifically for solving the Yule-Walker equations. Its input is the autocorrelation sequence that defines these equations, and its output is the prediction coefficients that solve them. Removing the Yule-Walker equations concept removes the system the algorithm is designed to solve — it has no purpose without them.

The Nichols chart enables the Nyquist stability criterion by overlaying M/N contours on the open-loop frequency response, allowing stability assessment (encirclement counting) directly from the chart. This is a teleological purpose: the chart was designed for stability analysis.

State-observers are designed under the detectability assumption: unobservable modes must be naturally stable for the observer to be useful. The observer gain L is chosen to place eigenvalues of A-LC in the left half-plane, but this can only be done for the observable modes — detectability guarantees that the remaining unobservable modes are already stable. Remove the concept of detectability and there is no criterion for whether a given system admits a stable observer design. The removal test passes: without detectability, an observer designer has no basis for deciding whether the system is suitable for observation. Direction: state-observer (the design) depends on detectability (the property ensuring observer stability).

The Levinson-Durbin algorithm takes the autocorrelation sequence r(0), r(1), ..., r(p) as its input data. Without autocorrelation values, the algorithm has no data to process — it computes nothing. The autocorrelation is not a side effect of the algorithm; it is the input the algorithm requires to operate.

[3 test] DEPENDS_ON removal test stated with result: cepstral-acceleration operates in the quefrency (cepstral) domain — it computes second-order temporal derivatives of cepstral coefficient trajectories. Removing the cepstrum means there is no quefrency-domain representation to operate on, so the procedure has no object to act on. Not sayability: the procedure transforms cepstral coefficient arrays (via regression on delta features), which is an operational dependency, not merely conceptual. Pinned sense: cepstrum as the quefrency-domain representation.
Bode plot serves engineers in determining peak-time by providing the visual interface for identifying the time of first maximum peak in transient response analysis.

Cepstral-extrapolation is designed for speech-specific purposes: buffer management in streaming ASR and trajectory extrapolation in HTS-HMM speech synthesis. These are speech-specific use cases with speech-tuned parameters that would not apply to non-speech domains.

The trachea bifurcates into the main bronchi at the carina (parameter 3 of the trachea definition). The bronchi are literal anatomical parts continuing from the tracheal airway. The trachea definition explicitly maps this connection.

Named-operand DEPENDS_ON, stated removal test with result against this filing's own carve. Procedure step (2) forms the cross-spectrum X(f) times the conjugate of Y(f), and step (3) takes the inverse FFT of that cross-spectrum to obtain the cross-cepstrum — the cross-spectrum is the direct data operand the transform reads. Remove the cross-spectrum now and step (3) has no input to invert: the cross-cepstrum stops operating, not merely being unsayable. Twin shape on the map: the accepted cepstrum already holds DEPENDS_ON -> power-spectrum and -> log-magnitude-spectrum for exactly this operand reading of its own defining step; the cross-cepstrum's defining step reads the cross-spectrum the same way. Pinned sense: cross-spectrum as the conjugate product of the two signals' spectra (the accepted entry's carve), not its density-normalized variant.

Cepstral-centroid operates directly on a cepstrum to compute its center-of-mass across quefrency. Removing the cepstrum removes the input the centroid computation operates on — there would be no quefrency-domain signal to analyze.
The total variability subspace is the core mechanism by which i-vectors encode speaker identity: i-vectors are projections into this space.

The definition frames LMI as 'a convex constraint in robust control and optimization where a symmetric matrix ... must be positive or negative semidefinite.' LMI is used as the tractable computational framework for Youla-parametrization-based H-infinity design — the Youla Q-parameter optimization is reformulated as an LMI feasibility problem. Remove Youla parametrization and the LMI construct as carved here loses its robust control synthesis context. The removal test: LMI as a general convex constraint survives, but the LMI construct as defined here (in robust control, replacing Riccati with convex formulations for H-infinity synthesis) needs Youla parametrization as the robust control framework it serves. Direction: dependent (LMI as robust control construct) to what it serves (Youla parametrization). Note pins the sense of LMI in robust control, not as general mathematics.

The root locus traces closed-loop poles that are roots of 1 + K·G(s) = 0 where G(s) is the open-loop transfer function. The transfer function provides G(s), the mathematical operand without which pole trajectories cannot be computed. Removal of transfer-function would stop root-locus from operating. DEPENDS_ON removal test passes.

The laryngeal-framework definition states its composition includes inter-cartilaginous ligaments and membranes that fix the relations between the six cartilages. The cricothyroid joint is the articulation between the thyroid inferior horn and the cricoid cartilage - two framework members. It is a constitutive relation within the scaffold. Type CONTAINS (Law 10), direction whole→part. Object level maps the constructs. Sense uses each as defined.

The larynx depends on the superior laryngeal nerve: external branch to cricothyroid muscle and internal branch providing sensory to supraglottis; removal impairs pitch control and supraglottic sensation.

CONTAINS test: pulmonary-acinus is a human-authored anatomical construct that groups distal lung tissue into one unit. Its definition explicitly enumerates alveoli as a member: 'the acinus takes in the respiratory bronchioles, alveolar ducts, alveolar sacs and alveoli.' The alveolus construct is a literal part inside the pulmonary-acinus construct. Direction: whole (pulmonary-acinus) to part (alveolus). Both are CONCEPTs; this is object-level reasoning between maps.

Cepstral-variance-normalization operates directly on cepstral coefficient vectors. Step 1 computes variance per coefficient dimension, step 2 normalizes c[i] by (c[i]-mu[i])/sigma[i]. Without cepstral-coefficient, there is no data structure to normalize — no coefficients to compute variance over, no values to standardize. The removal test is satisfied: X needs Y to operate now.

DEPENDS_ON (Laws 8, 8a), removal test with result. The cepstrum is the quefrency-domain signal from which cepstral coefficients are sampled. Remove the cepstrum and there is no c[q] to sample for the entropy computation. Direction: measure to its data source.

SERVES for-whose-sake test. Cepstral-interpolation's persistence mechanism names 'voice conversion tools for smooth transitions between speaker representations.' The technique enables robust temporal interpolation of speaker embeddings across frames, supporting speaker tracking and voice conversion. Direction from servant (interpolation) to master (speaker-recognition) runs correctly.

DEPENDS_ON (Laws 8, 8a): Removal test. Cepstral analysis operates on the magnitude spectrum by taking its logarithm then applying inverse Fourier transform. Without log-magnitude-spectrum as the input domain, the cepstral analysis has no data to transform. Removing log-magnitude-spectrum: no log-spectral input for the inverse Fourier transform step, the quefrency-domain output cannot be produced. Direction: cepstral-analysis → log-magnitude-spectrum (dependent → needed).

The Yule-Walker equations were formulated by Yule (1927) and Walker (1924) as the specific mathematical system for estimating parameters of autoregressive models. The general concept of an autoregressive model — a process expressed as a linear combination of its past values plus a random term — preceded the specific equations used to fit them. The equations derive historically from the need to make AR models computable from observed data.
Variance normalization operates in the cepstral domain, computing variance of cepstral coefficient vectors. The cepstrum is the structural prerequisite for the coefficients being normalized.

LQR operates by solving the algebraic Riccati equation A^T P + P A - P B R^{-1} B^T P + Q = 0 to obtain the gain matrix. Without the Riccati equation as a construct, LQR has no mathematical procedure to solve. The ARE is the core computational heart of LQR synthesis. The removal test passes: remove the Riccati equation and LQR cannot formulate or compute optimal gains. Direction is correct: LQR (dependent) to Riccati equation (needed for operation). This is a genuine DEPENDS_ON, not SERVES.

The Burg algorithm is a method for estimating the parameters of an autoregressive model. Its mathematical formulation minimizes the sum of forward and backward prediction error powers to produce AR coefficients. The reflection coefficients it computes (guaranteed |k|<1) parameterize an AR all-pole filter. Without the autoregressive model concept, the Burg recursion produces uninterpretable numbers: the forward/backward error filters, prediction order, and the resulting coefficients all reference AR model structure. The removal test passes: removing autoregressive-model stops the Burg algorithm from operating as a parameter estimation method.

Law 10 part-whole test: the hypopharynx accepted definition (v1) explicitly enumerates the postcricoid region as one of its four subsites in parameter (1) — 'postcricoid region (posterior to the cricoid cartilage, anterior to the esophagus).' The postcricoid-region entry I just filed carves precisely this subsite. Direction: hypopharynx (whole) to postcricoid-region (part) is correct. The note states the CONTAINS test and confirms the postcricoid region is literally named as a component of the hypopharynx carve.

The Gabor transform computes a signal's spectral content via the magnitude of the windowed Fourier transform output. The magnitude spectrum is the fundamental output — without the concept of spectral magnitude, the Gabor transform has no result to produce.

DEPENDS_ON test: CMVN normalizes cepstral coefficients by computing and removing their mean and scaling by variance. Without the cepstral-coefficient construct as the element being normalized, the technique has no referent. The normalization operation operates on individual coefficient values. Direction: dependent (normalization technique) → needed (element type).

Both are CONCEPT anatomical constructs at the same object level. The bronchus construct is a whole-part map whose identity is constituted by its structural components. The subsegmental-bronchus is a literal constituent within the bronchial hierarchy — a specific part of the whole construct, not a thing merely classified by it. The CONTAINS edge connects what is structurally inside the whole to the whole itself.

A cepstral lifter requires a liftering operation to function — the lifter defines the filter shape (rectangular, exponential, cosine-tapered) and the liftering applies that window to the cepstral coefficients in the quefrency domain. The lifter is the specification; the liftering is the operation. Without the liftering procedure, the lifter is an unapplied concept.

The observer-controller is defined as combining a state observer with a state-feedback controller (observer-controller v1: "combines a state observer with a state-feedback controller, using the observer's estimated states as inputs to the feedback law"). Removing state-feedback (the control architecture u = -Kx) means the observer-controller has no control law mechanism — it retains only an estimator, with nothing to do with the estimated state. The note: state-feedback is the second constitutive half of the observer-controller architecture; removing it stops the observer-controller from operating.

Cepstral-mean-normalization operates directly on individual cepstral coefficients — subtracting the mean and optionally scaling by variance across frames for each coefficient dimension. Without the cepstral-coefficient as the unit of normalization, there is nothing to normalize. The operation is defined over the coefficient space.

Removing phase-vocoder (the phase manipulation and STFT resynthesis pipeline) now stops Griffin-Lim from operating as phase retrieval from magnitude spectrograms; Griffin-Lim depends on the phase-vocoder's phase estimation and resynthesis machinery.

The hypopharynx definition explicitly carves the laryngeal inlet as one of its four subsites in parameter (1): 'the four subsites — postcricoid region; bilateral pyriform sinuses; the posterior pharyngeal wall; and the laryngeal inlet.' For CONCEPT entries mapping anatomy, CONTAINS passes when the definition lists Y as an explicit parameter — the entry IS a map, and the map includes the laryngeal inlet as a mapped component. All 5 items pass: type (CONTAINS), direction (whole to part), test (parameter list shows laryngeal inlet as a subsite of hypopharynx), object level (both CONCEPT maps), sense (laryngeal-inlet used as its accepted definition carves it).

Law 10 part-whole test: the pharynx accepted definition (v1) explicitly enumerates 'the pharyngeal recess of Fossa of Rosenmüller' as a clinical landmark in parameter (4). The pharyngeal-recess entry I just filed carves precisely this recess. Direction: pharynx (whole) to pharyngeal-recess (part) is correct. The note states the CONTAINS test and confirms the recess is literally named as a component of the pharynx carve.
The Arnoldi algorithm produces an upper Hessenberg matrix H as its output; the algorithm operates by building the orthonormal basis whose projected matrix is in Hessenberg form.

The cricotracheal membrane connects the inferior border of the cricoid cartilage to the first tracheal ring. The larynx definition includes the cricoid cartilage (parameter 1) and the definition of cricotracheal membrane states it connects the cricoid to the first tracheal ring. The cricoid's inferior border is part of the larynx's structural boundary, and the membrane is the fibrous continuation of that boundary. The larynx as a construct maps the organ system whose boundaries extend to include this connecting structure.

Time-constant tau characterizes the exponential approach to steady state as observed in a step response: for a first-order system, the response at t=tau is approximately 63.2% of the final value. Removing step-response eliminates the observation signal that defines the time-constant.

The vallecula definition maps it as a shallow depression bounded anteriorly by 'the posterior surface of the epiglottis.' The epiglottis definition maps the leaf-shaped structure whose 'broad lingual surface faces the root of the tongue.' The vallecula is the depression on the lingual (anterior) surface of the epiglottis — it is literally a feature of the epiglottic structure. The epiglottis contains the vallecula as its own surface anatomy, much as a bone contains a groove.

Remove cepstrum-sequence now: quantization operates on cepstral vectors collected into sequences for training codebooks. The procedure collects cepstral vectors as input; without the cepstrum-sequence representation, there is no structured data to map to codebook indices.

The bronchial-tree definition explicitly lists respiratory-bronchioles as part of its hierarchy (param 1): cartilage-free bronchioles and respiratory bronchioles. The respiratory-bronchiole is literally a rung inside the tree structure — the transitional airway generation where gas exchange begins.

The vocalis muscle inserts on the vocal process and anterior margin of the arytenoid cartilage. Removal test: removing the arytenoid cartilage eliminates the insertion point; the muscle loses its posterior anchor and cannot fine-tune vocal fold stiffness.

SERVES, Law 8d for-whose-sake test: the log-law quantizer (specifically the 64-entry A-law variant) is designed as a component of mu-law/A-law PCM encoding systems used in North American and European telephony respectively. The quantizer's step-size table exists to serve the mu-law/A-law encoding standard's non-uniform quantization needs. Remove mu-law/A-law PCM as the beneficiary and the quantizer loses its design context. Direction: servant (quantizer) → master (mu-law/A-law encoding system).

Spectral-flow requires spectrum to operate: without the spectrum construct, there is no spectral energy to track evolution. Remove spectrum → spectral-flow has no subject matter and cannot operate. Direction: dependent→needs. Object level: CONCEPT↔THING. Sense: spectral-flow as the construct measuring temporal change in spectral energy distributions.

LQR computes optimal state-feedback gains by minimizing a quadratic cost. The existence theorem states that LQR produces a stabilizing controller if and only if the system is stabilizable. Remove the concept of stabilizability and LQR loses its existence guarantee: there is no criterion telling the designer whether the resulting closed-loop system will be stable. The Riccati equation solution may still exist mathematically, but without stabilizability there is no guarantee it yields stabilizing gains. The removal test passes: stabilizability is the structural condition under which LQR works. Direction: lqr depends on stabilizability.

DEPENDS_ON test: cepstral subband decomposition operates on the cepstrum-sequence — it partitions the ordered sequence of cepstral coefficients into subbands. Without the cepstrum-sequence as the operand data structure, the partitioning procedure has no coefficients to divide. Structural necessity.

Pulmonary lobules are the smallest structural units of lung tissue — polygonal clusters of alveoli and their airways supplied by a single terminal bronchiole, visible on the pleural surface. They are literal parts of the lung's parenchymal architecture, organized around central bronchioles and separated by connective tissue septa. The lung CONTAINS these lobules as its fundamental building blocks.

DEPENDS_ON (Laws 8, 8a), removal test with result. The definition's own procedure names cepstral coefficients c[0]..c[M-1] as the direct operand: the energy is E = Σ c[i]² — a function of coefficient values. Remove the coefficients and there is no data to square-sum; the measure stops operating. Direction: measure to its data operand.

The diaphragm definition parameter (4) states 'the phrenic nerves (C3-C5) drive contraction, lowering the dome to expand the thorax on inspiration.' DEPENDS_ON removal test: removing the phrenic nerve (its sole motor supply) stops the diaphragm from contracting — it becomes paralyzed. The diaphragm's respiratory function ceases. Type DEPENDS_ON (Law 8), direction dependent→needed. Object level maps the anatomical constructs, not territory causality.

The mean operation consumes individual cepstral-coefficient values; without the concept of discrete coefficients to average, the mean is incoherent. The note pins the sense: cepstral-mean as an arithmetic aggregation over coefficient values. Remove cepstral-coefficient and there is nothing to average.

[1 type] DERIVED_FROM: which-came-first. [2 direction] bark scale as a psychoacoustic construct predates bark-spectrograms which apply it. Direction bark-spectrogram->bark-scale correct. [3 test] The bark scale (Stevens/Volkmann/Newman 1937) provides the frequency warping that defines bark-spectrograms. Without the bark scale as a psychoacoustic frequency mapping, the bark spectrogram has no construction. [4 object level] Both THING. [5 sense] Uses each as its definition carves it. All items pass.

H-infinity control synthesis is "solved via Riccati equations or linear matrix inequalities" (provisional v1). Riccati equations are the state-space formulation of the H-infinity optimization; LMIs operate on state-space matrices (A, B, C). Removing state-space-model removes the mathematical framework through which H-infinity control computes its controller. The H-infinity norm is a frequency-domain quantity, but the synthesis machinery — Riccati or LMI — is entirely state-space. Without state-space-model as a construct, H-infinity control has no computational mechanism. Note: the dependency is on the synthesis framework (state-space), not on the norm definition (frequency domain).
