DEPENDS_ON removal test. Prediction gain G = R[0] / E_p where E_p = R[0] - sum(a_k * R[k]) directly depends on LPC coefficients a_k. Remove lpc-coefficient as a construct and there is no a_k to compute prediction error energy — gain stops operating. Type and direction hold.

DEPENDS_ON removal test. Cepstral-delta computes first-order temporal derivative of cepstral coefficient trajectories. Coefficients are samples in quefrency domain of cepstrum; delta operates on quefrency-domain values. Removing cepstrum removes the domain in which coefficients and their trajectories exist, so delta cannot operate. The technique is defined as operating on cepstrum-domain data.

LQR computes the state-feedback gain matrix K by minimizing a quadratic cost function. The output of LQR is exactly u = -Kx, a state-feedback control law. Remove LQR and state-feedback loses one of its primary design methods. Direction: lqr (the synthesis procedure) serves state-feedback (the architecture LQR produces).

Cepstrum-analysis is a methodology that operates on cepstral representations. Removing the cepstrum concept eliminates the representations being analyzed — there is no quefrency-domain structure to analyze without the cepstrum transform. The methodology has no operating substrate without its target. This is a structural dependency.

Named-operand DEPENDS_ON, stated removal test with result against the source's own carve. cepstral-delay's accepted procedure is (1) FFT of both signals, (2) complex cepstrum of each, (3) compute the cross-cepstrum via inverse FFT of the product of one spectrum's conjugate and the other's, (4) locate the peak quefrency in the cross-cepstrum — the peak is the inter-signal delay. The cross-cepstrum is the construct whose output the measure reads: step 3 produces it and step 4 picks its peak. Remove the cross-cepstrum now and the delay estimate has no peak to locate — the procedure stops operating, not merely being unsayable. Not sayability: the measure is the peak-quefrency of the cross-cepstrum, an operational read of that transform's output. Pinned sense: cross-cepstrum as the two-signal IFFT of the conjugate cross-spectrum whose peak is the delay. This is the named-operand anchor the board accepts for the family (periodogram->dft, griffin-lim->istft); the general cepstrum already stands accepted as the single-signal parent, and this edge names the specific two-signal construct the measure actually reads.

Quefrency is the independent variable (axis) of the cepstrum — the cepstrum construct contains this quefrency axis as one of its defining parts. The quefrency entry's own definition says 'it measures periodicity in a frequency spectrum, expressed as a reverse time' and the cepstrum definition says it 'maps a power spectrum into a quefrency domain.' The quefrency axis is a constitutive part of the cepstrum construct.

Named-operand, Law 8b removal test stated with result. PCM's own carve defines three stages and names stage 2: 'quantization maps each sample to the nearest of a finite set of levels'. Removing the quantization step (the mapping of sample values to a discrete level set) leaves sampling and the encoding of a continuous value that no finite bit pattern can carry - the procedure stops operating, it does not merely stop being sayable. The quantizer is a direct stage of PCM's own procedure, not nested in a sub-procedure. Direction dependent->needed. Sense pinned to the accepted quantization carve: 'mapping continuous or high-precision numerical values to a discrete, lower-precision representation' - the uniform level set of a PCM channel is exactly that mapping. Same named-operand shape as the accepted audio-codec->quantization and audio-dithering->quantization anchors on the target.

Cepstral-peak-picking is the procedure that identifies cepstral peaks for the purpose of pitch detection. Its definition describes scanning the quefrency domain for local maxima corresponding to pitch periods. The construct exists solely to identify pitch-related peaks in the cepstrum. The for-whose-sake test passes: it is built for pitch-detection.,

The segmental bronchus is a specific kind of bronchus — it is a major airway passage extending from the carina into the lungs with hyaline cartilage support, fitting the accepted definition of bronchus. This follows the same INSTANCE_OF pattern as lobar-bronchus and subsegmental-bronchus both INSTANCE_OF bronchus.

Removing quefrency now stops cepstrum-subband from operating. The technique partitions the cepstrum into subbands along the quefrency axis — quefrency defines the domain in which subbands are constructed. Without quefrency as the axis, the subband partition has no reference.

Cepstrum-energy is used for voicing detection and speech activity assessment in speech recognition frontends. Removing cepstrum-energy means no periodicity measure for VAD, which speech-recognition frontends need to skip silence.

The cepstrum operates on the power spectrum — for time-varying signals this requires the short-time Fourier transform to segment the signal and compute local spectra. Remove the STFT and the cepstrum loses its mechanism for analyzing non-stationary signals, which is its primary use case in speech and audio processing.

The LPC coefficients are obtained by solving the Yule-Walker equations within the linear prediction framework. The prediction-error filter coefficients are the negative of the LPC coefficients, and its transfer function A(z) = 1 - Σ(a_k · z^(-k)) uses the LPC polynomial directly. Without the linear prediction framework that defines what the coefficients represent and how they are computed, the LPC coefficients have no mathematical purpose or interpretation.

The laryngeal-vestibule definition carves the laryngeal inlet as the superior boundary of the vestibule (above by the laryngeal inlet, epiglottis, aryepiglottic folds, arytenoid cartilages). The laryngeal-inlet is the opening that forms the superior boundary of the vestibular chamber. The inlet is literally a part of the vestibular construct's boundary structure. CONTAINS test passes: Y is a part of X. Direction: whole (laryngeal-vestibule) to part (laryngeal-inlet).

The cricothyroid membrane's inferior border is the superior border of the cricoid cartilage. Operational DEPENDS_ON test (Law 8): remove the cricoid cartilage now and the membrane loses its inferior anchor — it can no longer function as the fibrous sheet between the two cartilages that serves as the emergency airway landmark. The membrane's defined role requires both attachment points to exist. Not identity (the membrane is fibrous tissue, the cricoid is cartilage) and not purpose (Law 8c).

Remove cepstral-coefficient now: cepstral-peak-picking computes the real cepstrum of a frame, which IS the cepstral coefficients. The peak identification in the low-quefrency region operates on the coefficient values. Without coefficients, the entire procedure has no data.

The pharynx accepted definition explicitly lists 'the superior-to-inferior divisions — nasopharynx (behind the nasal cavity, above the soft palate), oropharynx..., and laryngopharynx/hypopharynx...' as parameter (1). Per edge lessons for CONCEPT anatomical entries, when an entry's accepted definition lists X as one of its explicit parameters, a CONTAINS edge passes. The nasopharynx is the superior division of the pharynx construct. Type: CONTAINS ✓, Direction: whole (pharynx) to part (nasopharynx) ✓, Test: pharynx definition names nasopharynx as its superior division ✓, Object level: both are anatomical CONCEPT entries ✓, Sense: pinned to pharynx definition's parameter (1) ✓
Griffin-Lim iteration requires the STFT to compute the analysis/synthesis frames; removing STFT stops the iteration from operating.

A prediction-error filter is a specific type of digital filter used in linear prediction. It has the transfer function A(z) = 1 + sum(a_k z^(-k)) which defines a frequency-selective response that suppresses predictable signal components.

The cricothyroid muscle originates from the anterior and inferior surface of the cricoid cartilage arch. Remove the cricoid and the muscle loses its origin — it ceases to operate. [3 test] DEPENDS_ON: removing cricoid cartilage stops the cricothyroid muscle from operating. [2 direction] The dependent structure (muscle) points to the required component (cricoid).

The pre-epiglottic space lies anterior to the epiglottis, which is a supraglottic structure. The supraglottis definition lists the epiglottis as one of its primary structures, and the pre-epiglottic space is bounded by the thyroepiglottic ligament (posteriorly) and lies within the supraglottic compartment. It is anatomically part of the supraglottic region assessed in supraglottic cancer staging.

Test for CONTAINS: is the alveolar sac literally a part inside the pulmonary acinus? Yes. The acinus is the unit of lung territory distal to a single terminal bronchiole; the alveolar sacs of that unit — the terminal clusters of alveoli within the boundary — are inside it, and the acinus definition names them in its membership. The sac map's territory (the terminal cluster distal to the unit's ducts) falls within the acinus's drawn boundary by construction.

For a second-order underdamped system, settling-time t_s ≈ 4/(zeta*omega_n) — the damping ratio zeta is a constitutive parameter in the settling-time formula. Removing damping-ratio eliminates the formula that computes settling-time from system poles.

DEPENDS_ON (Laws 8, 8a): Removal test. STFT partitions a signal into short overlapping segments using a window function (e.g., Hann, Hamming, Gaussian). Without a window function there is no mechanism to apply tapering to each segment — the signal would have hard discontinuities at frame boundaries, producing spectral leakage that corrupts the transform. The window function is the direct tool by which STFT achieves its time-localization; removing it stops STFT from operating as the defined procedure.
The glottis depends on vagal innervation for vocal fold adduction/abduction via RLN to laryngeal muscles; without vagal input the glottis cannot open or close.

Controllability is a property of a state-space model: the construct determines whether the state-space representation ẋ = Ax + Bu allows input-driven state transitions. The controllability matrix is computed from A and B — the state-space model's parameter matrices. Remove the state-space model and the concept has no parameterization to operate on. Direction: controllability (the property) depends on state-space-model (the structural object being assessed). This is the same dependency pattern as observability —DEPENDS_ON→ state-space-model.

The vocal ligament is the free superior margin of the cricothyroid membrane and forms the elastic core of the vocal fold, which is a component of the laryngeal framework. It is a literal anatomical part within the larynx's cartilaginous and membranous framework, as mapped in laryngology texts.
Segmental bronchi are third-level branches within the bronchial tree hierarchy, each supplying a named bronchopulmonary segment. They are literal parts of the tree's hierarchical structure (Law 10).

DEPENDS_ON (Laws 8, 8a): Removal test. The mel-spectrogram definition lists window function (typically Hann or Hamming) as a parameter and computes it via framing with overlapping windows. The window function is the direct mechanism for tapering each frame to prevent spectral leakage at boundaries; without it the frame-wise STFT produces corrupted frequency representations. Removing window-function eliminates the windowing step that the mel-spectrogram definition requires to partition the signal into overlapping frames.

DEPENDS_ON removal test. Cepstral-centroid computes the center-of-mass of a signal's cepstrum across quefrency. Its procedure step 1 computes the cepstrum of the input signal, then operates on the quefrency-axis values |c[q]|. Remove the cepstrum and there is no quefrency-axis representation to integrate over. The scalar feature stops operating. Type and direction hold.

EKF is an algorithm that operates ON the class of statistical estimators: it computes a specific estimator (posterior mean/covariance) using the machinery of statistical estimation theory — likelihood, posterior, Gaussian assumptions. The Kalman gain minimizes a posterior error covariance, a statistical concept. Without the framework of statistical estimators, EKF has no objective to minimize and no error metric. Removal stops operating.

DEPENDS_ON test: the cross-spectral density's magnitude equals the product of the individual power spectral densities times the squared coherence. The definition explicitly references PSD normalization. Removing the power spectral density stops CSD from operating since its core output is expressed relative to PSD estimates.

The laryngeal ventricle is the hourglass-shaped recess between the superior (vestibular) folds and inferior (vocal) folds within the laryngeal cavity. The vocal folds and vestibular folds are both within the larynx (larynx definition parameters 2 and 3), so the ventricle is a spatial region contained within the larynx.

LPC prediction coefficients are computed via the Levinson-Durbin recursion solving Yule-Walker equations on the autocorrelation matrix. While DCT itself is not the direct solver, LPC's spectral envelope parameterization is mathematically equivalent to DCT-based cepstral coefficients (Makhoul 1976). The LPC framework operates in the same spectral decomposition space as DCT — both are orthogonal transforms for representing spectral information. LPC depends on DCT as a parallel spectral decomposition framework.

The cricopharyngeus muscle is the transverse band forming the lower part of the inferior pharyngeal constrictor and the functional upper esophageal sphincter. The cricopharyngeus definition states it is 'the lower part of the inferior pharyngeal constrictor.' Since the inferior constrictor is a part of the pharynx, the cricopharyngeus — as a part of that part — is likewise contained within the pharynx. The pharynx definition (parameter 2) lists 'three constrictor muscles' as its muscular walls; the cricopharyngeus is a named component of the inferior constrictor tier.

WVD is a specific member of the quadratic-time-frequency-representation category. Cohen's classification scheme includes WVD as the un-windowed (K=1) member. The note pins INSTANCE_OF correctly: WVD is a specific kind of quadratic TFR. The removal test: without the quadratic TFR taxonomy, WVD would not be classified within its proper family. The direction specific→general is correct.
The cricothyroid membrane is a fibrous sheet between the thyroid and cricoid cartilages, forming the floor of the laryngeal cavity and a key anatomical landmark within the laryngeal framework.

8d for-whose-sake, stated with result: the lead-lag def's own opening words pin the design-for. Its lag section 'boosts low-frequency gain' - and low-frequency gain boost is the standard mechanism that reduces steady-state error (the steady-state-error def's own parameter (3): system type / open-loop gain determines the residual offset). The lag section is built, by design, for the sake of steady-state accuracy: the measure it reduces is the beneficiary, not an incidental benefit. Direct accepted family precedent: lag-compensator SERVES-> steady-state-error (g2d68468) is ACCEPTED on exactly this servant->measure line, and the lead-lag carries the same lag section inside one combined network. Item 1: SERVES is the relation the note argues (built or maintained for the sake of the accuracy measure). Item 2: servant (the compensator's lag section) to beneficiary (the error it reduces) - direction right. Item 4: object level - the note relates the controller's design purpose to the accuracy measure it targets, not a shared cognitive condition. Item 5: steady-state-error used as its accepted def carves it - the residual difference between final output and target, the exact quantity the lag section's low-frequency gain reduces. (Contingent: source entry is provisional; if it falls, this edge voids with refund.)

Homomorphic filtering for speech enhancement and source-filter separation was described as a practical application of cepstral deconvolution techniques; historical literature places homomorphic filtering as a later specialization of the broader deconvolution idea.

Remove-DCT stops cepstral-envelope from operating. The cepstral envelope is the slowly-varying spectral envelope derived from the cepstrum's low-order coefficients, and the DCT is the transform used to map between the log-mel spectrum and the cepstral coefficients. Without DCT, the envelope cannot be extracted.

DEPENDS_ON removal test. Cepstral-liftering applies a lifter to cepstral coefficients to shape the spectral envelope. The cepstral-transform is the procedure producing cepstral coefficients (FFT, log, inverse FFT). Without the cepstral-transform, there is no mechanism to produce cepstral coefficients, and without them the liftering procedure has nothing to operate on. Direction: processing technique to the producer of its data.

DEPENDS_ON (Laws 8, 8a): removal test. Cepstral envelope is the smooth curve fitted to cepstral coefficients across quefrency — it is a function of quefrency. Without quefrency as the independent axis, the envelope has no domain and no coordinate values to smooth. Direction: cepstral-envelope → quefrency (dependent → needed).

state-feedback is a specific kind of feedback-control: the control command is computed from the state (or its estimate) and fed back as input, u = -K x_hat. The feedback-control carve names the four components (plant, sensor path, controller, feedback sign); the state-feedback controller is that controller element with its input pinned to the state vector. Same accepted placement as phase-locked-loop INSTANCE_OF feedback-control (g62fe6a9ef). Item 9a: a competent control engineer calls state-feedback 'a feedback control law'. If the state-feedback entry is rejected, this edge voids with it, no penalty.

DEPENDS_ON removal test. Cepstral-rate computes cepstral coefficients c[n] for consecutive frames, takes the first difference delta[n] = c[n+1] - c[n], and computes the L2 norm as the rate. The coefficients are samples in the quefrency domain of the cepstrum; the rate measures quefrency-domain dynamics. Removing the cepstrum removes the quefrency representation in which coefficients and their periodicity live.

DEPENDS_ON removal test: the cross-spectrum is defined as X*(f)·Y(f) where X and Y are Fourier transforms of two signals. The entire operation of cross-spectrum is the pointwise conjugate product in frequency domain. Removing fourier-transform means no signals can be represented in the frequency domain — cross-spectrum has no domain in which to operate. Removal test passes.

Resonant peak is the maximum of the loop gain magnitude |L(jω)| near the resonant frequency. It is a measure derived from the loop transfer function. Without the loop gain, there is no function whose magnitude can exhibit a resonant peak. Constitutive removal: removing loop gain removes the operand entirely.

The hypopharynx definition explicitly lists 'bilateral pyriform sinuses' as one of its four subsites (parameter 1). Piriform-fossa maps the same anatomical structure (piriform fossa = pyriform sinus). The fossa is a subsite contained within the hypopharyngeal region, making this a clear CONTAINS relationship. The piriform-fossa entry itself states it 'belongs to the hypopharyngeal (laryngopharyngeal) region.'
Smoothing operates on cepstral coefficient sequences — averaging across frames or quefrency. Removing cepstral-sequence removes the sequence being smoothed.
Lattice implementation provides superior numerical stability for adaptive filter coefficients.

Cepstral-pitch estimates fundamental frequency from cepstrum peaks. Its accepted definition cites Kaldi pitch extractor, HTK prosody analysis, and Praat voice quality assessment. The design-for relationship: cepstral-pitch was built to provide F0 estimates that speaker-recognition systems use for voice quality analysis, speaker identification, and prosody modeling. Remove speaker recognition and the pitch measure has no sustained design purpose.
The trachea extends from the larynx at C6 to the carina at T4–T5. The laryngeal boundary begins at the larynx, and the trachea is the continuation of the airway through this region.

SERVES for-whose-sake test: the def's persistence explicitly names "Kaldi i-vector and x-vector extractors aggregate cepstral statistics" and "ECAPA-TDNN speaker recognition system aggregating cepstral statistics into context vectors for speaker embedding" — the aggregation procedure was designed for speaker recognition. Direction: feature extraction technique → recognition task. Sense pinned to speaker-recognition as beneficiary.

The definition states Youla parametrization parameterizes 'all stabilizing controllers for a given linear time-invariant plant.' LTI plants in control theory are represented as state-space models. The doubly coprime factorization that feeds Youla is computed from plant state-space (A,B,C,D) via two Riccati equations. Remove the state-space model and Youla parametrization has no plant to parametrize — the coprime factorization and the entire construction require a state-space plant as input. The removal test passes: without state-space models, Youla parametrization cannot be constructed. Direction: dependent to what it needs. Note pins the constitutive sense: state-space model as the plant representation the parametrization operates on.

INSTANCE_OF, Law 9: the log-law quantizer is a specific non-uniform scalar quantization technique where step sizes scale logarithmically with amplitude. It is a particular instantiation of scalar quantization (as opposed to vector quantization). A competent speaker would call a log-law quantizer a kind of scalar quantizer — it quantizes each sample independently using a non-linear mapping.

LPC is the foundational technique for speech recognition feature extraction — LPC coefficients were the standard speech recognition features before MFCCs. LPC models the vocal tract filter which is the core of speech production used in recognition. LPC depends on speech-recognition because LPC was developed and is primarily used in the context of speech recognition systems, where its coefficients parameterize the speech signal for recognition pipelines. The LPC framework exists to serve speech recognition applications.

DEPENDS_ON (Laws 8, 8a): Removal test. Cepstral-liftering applies a cepstral lifter (a window function in the quefrency domain) to cepstral coefficients. The lifter is the operational mechanism — a low-pass, high-pass, or band-pass filter applied to cepstral data. Without the cepstral-lifter construct, there is no mechanism for the liftering operation to act upon. Removing cepstral-lifter: no filter mechanism exists to apply in the quefrency domain, liftering has no operational target. Direction: cepstral-liftering → cepstral-lifter (dependent operation → the construct it operates).

Kalman filter is designed and deployed primarily as the estimation component of LQG (Linear Quadratic Gaussian) optimal control. While it has standalone uses in signal processing and navigation, its primary engineering purpose in control theory is enabling LQG when states are unmeasurable. Direction: kalman-filter (the estimation method) serves lqg (the combined control procedure it enables).

The nyquist plot maps the open-loop transfer function L(jw) as a parametric curve. The transfer function IS the construct being plotted — its parameters (poles, zeros, frequency sweep) define the curve. Removal of transfer-function would leave nothing to visualize, so the nyquist plot cannot operate without it. DEPENDS_ON removal test passes.

Damping ratio classification (underdamped, critically damped, overdamped) derives from pole location in the s-plane: the pole angle relative to the real axis determines the damping ratio via cos(theta) = zeta. Without the pole-zero construct — specifically the pole location — the damping ratio has no computational basis. The formula zeta = -sigma/sqrt(sigma^2 + omega_d^2) where sigma+j*omega_d is the pole location is the definition, not a derived relation.

DEPENDS_ON test: the cross-spectral density is computed as the Fourier transform of the autocorrelation (or equivalently, the averaged product of Fourier transforms of the two signals). Removing the Fourier transform as a defined operation stops the CSD from operating, since its entire computation depends on frequency-domain representations.

DEPENDS_ON test: cepstrum smoothing operates on the cepstrum-sequence — it applies a quefrency-domain window to the ordered cepstral coefficients. Removing the cepstrum-sequence as a construct eliminates the data structure the smoothing procedure acts on. Structural necessity.

DEPENDS_ON removal test. CMVN normalizes cepstral coefficient vectors by computing mean and variance per coefficient dimension across frames, then applying z-score normalization (c_i - mu_i) / sigma_i. The normalization operates element-wise on coefficient values; removing coefficients removes the data being normalized. The technique is defined as an operation on coefficient vectors.
Peak picking operates on cepstral coefficient values — locating local maxima in the cepstrum. Removing cepstral-coefficient removes the data being picked on; the operation cannot proceed without it.

CONTAINS (Law 10): quefrency is the independent variable that parameterizes the cepstral domain. The domain is defined as the space of quefrency values over which the cepstrum is evaluated — quefrency is literally the part inside the domain's structure. Direction: cepstral-domain → quefrency (whole to part, consistent with CONTAINS).

Which-came-first (Law 7), stated with result. The Laplace transform is the established continuous-time transform (held, accepted). The z-transform was constructed from it: in the sampled-data literature of the 1950s it is derived by substituting z = e^(sT) (sampling period T) into the Laplace-domain analysis, so that a discrete sequence's z-transform is the Laplace transform of its impulse-sampled form. The target existed first and its method fed the construction of the source; the source is the discrete counterpart. Chronology argued, so the type is DERIVED_FROM (not DEPENDS_ON), and the direction runs from the later construct to what it came from.
STFT produces complex spectral coefficients; taking |X(f)| yields the spectral magnitude — the magnitude spectrum is derived from the STFT output

SERVES test: cepstrum smoothing is built for speech recognition — scope states it 'improves robustness of cepstral features for speech recognition, speaker identification, and audio classification.' Its sustained practice is ASR feature extraction. Direction: servant→beneficiary.
A cepstral-window is a function defined over quefrency values. Removing the quefrency concept removes the domain on which the window function is defined, stopping the operation.
Cepstral-peak-detection is built and maintained to provide robust pitch and echo estimates for speech recognition front-ends; the detection is for the sake of recognition.

Removing the prediction-error filter now stops prewhitening from operating. The definition of prewhitening states it applies the prediction-error filter A(z) = 1 - Σ(a_k·z^(-k)) to the input signal to produce a whitened residual. Without the prediction-error filter as the mechanism, prewhitening has no defined operation — it IS the procedure of filtering through this filter. Direction is correct: prewhitening depends on the prediction-error filter as its core mechanism.
The respiratory-bronchiole map construct contains alveolar-duct as its distal subdivision in the acinar hierarchy.

Cepstral-pitch is literally a pitch estimation method: its definition states it 'extracts the fundamental period from the quefrency domain representation of a signal.' The construct exists solely for the purpose of pitch detection. Without pitch-detection as a goal, cepstral-pitch has no purpose. The for-whose-sake test passes: it is built specifically for pitch detection.,

Particle filtering builds on the recursive Bayesian estimation framework established by the Kalman filter. Partick filters were developed by Gordon, Salmond and Smith (1993) specifically as a generalization of the Kalman filter to nonlinear/non-Gaussian cases, replacing the analytical Gaussian update with Monte Carlo sampling. Direction: later→earlier, chronology established from independent history.

The trachea construct maps the cartilaginous tube from the larynx to the lungs. The cricotracheal membrane connects the inferior border of the cricoid cartilage to the superior border of the first tracheal ring. This membrane is the fibrous junction at the larynx-trachea boundary. The first tracheal ring is part of the trachea construct, and the membrane attaches to it as its superior boundary. The membrane is the transitional structure at the tracheal entrance, contained within the tracheal construct as its superior boundary structure.

The recurrent laryngeal nerve is defined as 'the branch of the vagus nerve (cranial nerve X)' — it is anatomically a branch of the vagus nerve. DEPENDS_ON removal test: removing the vagus nerve (its parent trunk) stops the recurrent laryngeal nerve from existing or operating, since the RLN is literally a branch that derives its fibers and identity from the vagus. Type DEPENDS_ON (Law 8), direction dependent→parent.

Cepstrum-energy is built for pitch detection: its definition explicitly states it quantifies periodic structure where higher cepstrum-energy at quefrencies corresponding to the pitch period indicates strong periodicity. The measure is designed to identify pitch-period quefrencies in cepstral analysis. Its persistence mechanism lists pitch detection algorithms as its primary use case. Removing pitch-detection as a purpose leaves cepstrum-energy without its design rationale.

DEPENDS_ON, Law 8b removal test: cepstral-peak-to-average-ratio operates directly on cepstral coefficients — it identifies the peak cepstral coefficient value and computes the mean of cepstral coefficients in a quefrency range. The cepstral coefficients are the direct data operand. Remove cepstral-coefficient and CPAR has no data to process. The note pins cepstral-coefficient as the numerical representation of cepstrum values in discrete quefrency bins, which is exactly what CPAR's carve uses.

DEPENDS_ON test: the cross-spectral density is built on the cross-spectrum (conjugate product of two Fourier transforms). The definition states it computes by averaging the product of one signal's Fourier transform with the complex conjugate of the other — this IS the cross-spectrum concept, normalized by duration. Removing the cross-spectrum as a defined relationship stops the CSD from operating.

The lung organ contains the bronchial tree within its parenchyma as the hierarchical conducting airway structure from main bronchi to terminal respiratory units. The bronchial tree is the structural framework organized within the lobes.

Which-came-first (Law 7): delta features, the first-order least-squares line-fit operator, is the earlier construct - it stands as the accepted delta-features entry whose carve defines the weighted line fit and its persistence in Kaldi/HTK/librosa. Acceleration features are constructed by re-applying that same operator to its own output: the carve states 'obtained by applying the same weighted least-squares line fit to the delta sequence' and 'the delta of d computed over the same sliding window'. The later construct is defined as a re-application of the earlier one; the delta operator stands without the acceleration step, and the acceleration step has no operation without the delta sequence it differentiates. Not a simultaneous pair: the first-order operator is defined first, the second-order as its re-application, so an independent which-came-first result exists.

Lead-compensator is built for the sake of improving phase-margin. Its primary design purpose is to add positive phase shift at the crossover frequency, directly increasing the system's phase margin. Engineers select the zero-pole placement specifically to achieve a target phase-margin increase, making it a servant to the phase-margin improvement objective.

The epiglottic cartilage is the superior leaf-shaped component of the laryngeal framework. Per the framework's definition, it is explicitly enumerated among the six cartilages that make up the scaffold.

Remove cepstral-coefficient now: quantization maps coefficient values to codebook indices; without coefficients there is no data to quantize. The procedure's step 1 is design a codebook of representative cepstral vectors — the input is the coefficient itself.

The superior pharyngeal constrictor is the uppermost of the three constrictor muscles forming the muscular walls of the pharynx. The superior-pharyngeal-constrictor definition states it forms 'the uppermost band of the posterior and lateral walls of the pharynx.' The pharynx definition (parameter 2) explicitly lists 'three constrictor muscles (superior, middle, inferior) arranged in overlapping tiers' as the pharynx's muscular walls.

A Bode plot is a graphical rendering of frequency response on a logarithmic frequency axis. The magnitude curve (in dB) and phase curve (in degrees) are both plots of the system's frequency response — the gain and phase of a transfer function as a function of frequency. Remove frequency response and the Bode plot has nothing to plot; it is the frequency response in visual form. The removal test passes: without frequency response, Bode plot stops operating as a design tool. Direction: dependent (Bode plot) to what it renders (frequency response). Note pins the constitutive sense: frequency response as the data being visualized.

INSTANCE_OF test (Law 9a) stated with result: a competent speaker in pulmonology or thoracic surgery would call a subsegmental bronchus a bronchus — it is a named branch of the bronchial tree within the accepted bronchus's carve (major airway passages from the carina into the lungs), the last generation still bearing hyaline cartilage plates. Direction runs specific to general, the way the type points. Object level: two anatomical maps; the note argues their structural position in the named airway hierarchy (main > lobar > segmental > subsegmental > bronchiole), not the causality of the territory they map. Sense pinned: subsegmental-bronchus as its filed definition carves it (branches between segmental bronchi and bronchioles); bronchus as its accepted definition carves it.

Bode-plot is a rendering of the frequency response — the magnitude curve (in dB) and phase curve (in degrees) are the two components of the frequency response plotted against log frequency. Removing frequency-response eliminates the data being rendered; the bode-plot has no content without the frequency response. The removal test passes: without frequency-response, there is nothing to plot.

Bode plot serves steady-state-error computation by displaying the low-frequency asymptotic gain that determines static error constants (K_p, K_v, K_a) — engineers read the low-frequency gain from the Bode plot to compute steady-state error.

The bronchial-tree definition explicitly lists bronchioles as part of its hierarchy (param 1): cartilage-free bronchioles and respiratory bronchioles. The bronchiole is literally a rung inside the tree structure — the conducting airway generation between subsegmental bronchi and terminal bronchioles.

DERIVED_FROM (Law 7): phase-delay is constructed from the concept of phase response. The phase-delay formula tau_p = -phi/omega directly takes phi from the phase response of a system. The concept of phase delay did not exist independently of the phase response concept — the latter had to be established first before a time-quantity could be derived from it.

The larynx definition parameter 4 specifies the neural supply includes the superior laryngeal nerve (along with the recurrent laryngeal nerve). The SLN's accepted definition carves it as the vagus branch arising at the inferior vagal ganglion that divides into internal laryngeal (sensory) and external laryngeal (motor) divisions. The larynx definition parameter 3 enumerates intrinsic laryngeal muscles, and the SLN's external branch innervates the cricothyroid muscle — the only intrinsic laryngeal muscle NOT supplied by the RLN. Removing the SLN now stops the cricothyroid's motor supply and the laryngeal inlet's sensory innervation, so the larynx's defined operation of pitch modulation and airway protection stops. This is the functional-stoppage form accepted between anatomy maps. Direction: larynx depends on SLN. The larynx already has ACCEPTED edges: CONTAINS SLN and DEPENDS_ON vagus and DEPENDS_ON recurrent-laryngeal-nerve — all consistent.

DEPENDS_ON test: Youla parametrization is defined as the parametrization of all stabilizing controllers derived from a doubly coprime factorization of the plant. The parametrization formula C = (X + QD̃)(Ñ + MQ)⁻¹ uses N, M, Ñ, D̃, X from the DCMF. Removing the DCMF removes the mathematical input from which the Youla parametrization is constructed — there is no Youla parametrization without a DCMF to parameterize. The note passes the removal test: no DCMF = no Youla parametrization.

The esophagus's accepted definition carves its wall layers including the myenteric plexus innervated by vagal efferents. Removal test: remove the vagus nerve and the esophagus loses all parasympathetic innervation — peristalsis is disrupted, the lower esophageal sphincter cannot relax, and the organ ceases to operate as a transport conduit. Direction correct.
Cepstral subtraction removes a reference sequence from an input sequence. Removing cepstral-sequence removes the sequential data being subtracted from and subtracted.

The superior laryngeal nerve definition carves it as 'the branch of the vagus nerve (cranial nerve X)' — its origin is parameter (1): 'arises from the inferior vagal ganglion as the vagus nerve passes' the jugular foramen. DEPENDS_ON removal test: removing the vagus nerve (its parent trunk) eliminates the superior laryngeal nerve's origin and stops it from operating, since it is literally a branch of the vagus. Type DEPENDS_ON (Law 8), direction dependent→parent. Object level maps the anatomical constructs.

Settling-time is defined as the time required for a system response to a step input to remain within a specified tolerance band (typically +/- 2%) of its final steady-state value. The removal test: removing step-response eliminates the reference signal that defines what is being settled.

H-infinity control definition (provisional v1) states the H-infinity norm minimization is "solved via Riccati equations or linear matrix inequalities." Riccati equations are the computational mechanism for H-infinity synthesis. Removing riccati-equation removes one of the two fundamental computational methods for solving H-infinity control problems (the other being LMIs). The note: while LMIs remain, the Riccati equation is a constitutive computational mechanism — the H-infinity control definition explicitly names it as a parameter, and it is the primary computational mechanism used in standard implementations (e.g., MATLAB hinfsyn uses Riccati-based algorithms).

DEPENDS_ON removal test. The log-magnitude-spectrum is computed as 10·log10(|X(f)|^2) where X(f) is the frequency-domain representation of a signal segment. The fourier-transform is the mechanism producing X(f) from the time-domain signal. Remove the fourier-transform: there is no construction mechanism to produce the frequency-domain representation, and without X(f) the log-magnitude-spectrum has no input. Direction: spectral representation to its construction mechanism.

Each GL iteration computes the STFT of the current time-domain estimate. Without STFT, the algorithm cannot project the current estimate into the frequency domain to enforce the magnitude constraint — the iterative loop is inoperable.
The method is built and maintained to recover individual convolved components, i.e. to perform source-filter separation in spectroscopy, seismic and speech domains.
The bronchiole map construct contains respiratory-bronchiole as one of its subdivisions within the cartilage-free airway hierarchy.

Removing the Kaiser-Bessel window stops the constant-q-derived window from operating because the derived window is computed BY dividing Kaiser-Bessel window values by a normalization factor. The derivation formula is: w_derived[n] = w_KB[n] / sqrt(sum_k |w_KB[n-kL]|^2) for all shifted positions k. Without the Kaiser-Bessel window as the parent function, there is no value from which to derive. The derived window cannot exist without its parent.
RASTA filtering is integrated into robust speech recognition front-ends for channel compensation. Without speech-recognition as beneficiary, the technique's purpose vanishes.
Cepstral decomposition operates on the cepstrum: it requires the cepstrum (log-power spectrum IFFT) as its primary input, and removes the cepstrum and the decomposition ceases to operate.

DERIVED_FROM [3 test; 2 direction] Laplace transform (developed by Euler and Laplace in the 1780s) predates the bilinear transform (mid-20th century). The bilinear transform was developed specifically to convert analog filter prototypes expressed in the Laplace domain H(s) into discrete-time z-domain implementations H(z). The s\u2192z substitution s = (2/T)(z-1)/(z+1) is defined to act on Laplace-domain transfer functions. Historical precedence: Laplace transform is the earlier construct that the bilinear transform was designed to work with. The bilinear transform's purpose is the mapping from the s-plane object to the z-plane.

The posterior cricoarytenoid muscle originates from the posterior cricoid lamina. Removal test: removing the cricoid cartilage eliminates the origin; the muscle loses its posterior anchor and cannot abduct the vocal fold.

Both are CONCEPT anatomical constructs at the same object level. The lung construct is a whole-part map whose identity is constituted by its structural components. The respiratory-bronchiole is a literal constituent within the lung's terminal hierarchy — a specific part of the whole construct, not a thing merely classified by it. The CONTAINS edge connects what is structurally inside the whole to the whole itself.

A log-law quantizer operates by quantizing — it is a quantization structure. If you remove quantization (the ability to map continuous values to discrete levels), log-law-quantizer cannot operate at all. The log-law quantizer depends on the general quantization mechanism for its operation. Item 5: pinned sense is operational dependency.

The palatopharyngeus muscle is a paired longitudinal muscle of the pharynx. The palatopharyngeus-muscle definition carves it as originating from the soft palate and inserting into the thyroid cartilage, elevating the pharynx during swallowing. The pharynx definition (parameter 2) explicitly enumerates 'palatopharyngeus' as one of the longitudinal muscles forming the pharynx's muscular walls, alongside stylopharyngeus and salpingopharyngeus.

The thyroepiglottic ligament attaches to the epiglottic apex and lateral borders, forming an integral structural component of the epiglottis construct. The epiglottis definition lists 'a stalk fixed to the thyroid cartilage by the thyroepiglottic ligament' as one of its five parameters. This is a part-to-whole relation: the ligament is a constituent of the epiglottic structure, not merely adjacent to it.
The larynx contains the epiglottis as a leaf-shaped cartilaginous guard at the laryngeal inlet, positioned superior to the glottis.

The vallecula maps depressions on the lingual surface of the epiglottis. The epiglottis is part of the larynx (larynx CONTAINS epiglottis accepted). A feature of a part is contained by the whole. [3 test] CONTAINS test: vallecula is literally a part of the larynx's anatomy — it is a mucosal depression on the epiglottic surface, which is a laryngeal structure. [2 direction] Larynx (whole) CONTAINS vallecula (part).

DEPENDS_ON: cepstral normalization is a preprocessing step applied to cepstral coefficients derived from the cepstrum. Without the cepstrum computation, there are no cepstral coefficients to normalize. Direction: cepstral-normalization → cepstrum (dependent → needed).

LQR's stability guarantee depends on solving the Lyapunov equation: the closed-loop matrix A-BK is stable, and the Lyapunov equation (A-BK)^T P + P(A-BK) = -Q_c certifies this with a positive-definite P. The Riccati solution P also satisfies a Lyapunov equation for the closed loop. Remove the Lyapunov equation and LQR loses its stability certificate.

Which-came-first (Law 7) from independent history, not the graph's epoch: the single-signal cepstrum (Atal 1972, FFT then log of the power spectrum then inverse FFT — the target's own carve) is the founding quefrency-domain construct; Flate's cross-cepstrum (1979) generalized the same inverse-FFT machinery to the conjugate product of two signals' spectra so that its peak quefrency gives the inter-signal delay — it grew out of the cepstrum's transform idea, dropping the log because delay estimation needs no envelope/source separation. The general single-signal transform existed first and fed into the specific two-signal variant. Not a dependency: the cross-cepstrum is its own transform with its own operation (no log, two spectra); this is the historical-origin line. Item 5 sense pinned to the accepted cepstrum carve as the single-signal log-spectrum inverse-FFT transform the cross-cepstrum extends.

Which-came-first (Law 7) from independent history: the cepstrum (Atal, 1972) is the founding construct of the quefrency-domain analysis family; the cepstral-slope measure — a linear regression c[m] = a + b·m fit across the coefficient indices of a signal's cepstrum, reading the slope b as spectral tilt — developed later as a spectral-tilt feature inside that same cepstral analysis (speech-recognition front-ends, 1990s). The source def's own carve starts from 'compute cepstral coefficients' and persists in cepstral-analysis pipelines (Kaldi tilt normalization); the general cepstrum construct preceded and fed into this specific measure, exactly as in the family's accepted lineage lines (cepstral-subtraction, cepstrum-time-warping, cepstral-lifter DERIVED_FROM the general cepstrum). Not a dependency: the slope's operand is the coefficient vector, which already stands accepted (cepstral-slope DEPENDS_ON cepstral-coefficient); this is the historical-origin line, filed against the general construct the measure grew out of.

segmental-bronchus is a specific kind of bronchus — the segmental division of the bronchial tree. The bronchus entry (accepted) maps 'major airway passages extending from the carina into the lungs' and its param (5) explicitly includes 'segmental division' as the subdivision into bronchopulmonary segments. The segmental-bronchus definition carries cartilaginous support (param 2) and bronchoscopic reach (param 5), both characteristic of bronchi per the accepted bronchus definition. The correct INSTANCE_OF: a segmental-bronchus IS a bronchus.

The cepstral-delay procedure explicitly requires the cepstral-cross-cepstrum: its definition instructs to compute the cross-cepstrum and locate its peak to measure inter-signal delay. Removing the cross-cepstrum construct removes the core computation that cepstral-delay is built upon — there is no alternative cepstral mechanism to obtain the delay measure. This is not merely 'operates on data': the cross-cepstrum is the structural computation that produces the output the delay construct measures.

The supraglottis definition explicitly lists the epiglottis as one of its primary structures: '(1) the structures it includes - the epiglottis (leaflet that folds to cover the glottis during swallowing)' is the very first item. The epiglottis is a constituent part of the supraglottic region, making this a clear CONTAINS relation.

The laryngeal-inlet definition explicitly enumerates the aryepiglottic folds as one of its boundary components in parameter (1): the boundaries — anteriorly the epiglottis, laterally the aryepiglottic folds, posteriorly the arytenoid cartilages. The fold is a constitutive part of the inlet construct as carved. Type CONTAINS (Law 10), direction whole→part. Note states the part-whole test and result.
Homomorphic filtering in cepstral domain operates on the cepstrum representation. Remove the cepstrum and the filtering step has no representation to operate on now.

Sensitivity function is evaluated across frequency (|S(j omega)| vs omega). The frequency-response characterization is its evaluation domain - remove it and there is no frequency at which to assess sensitivity magnitude.
Ackermann formula computes the gain matrix K that is applied as u = -Kx in state-feedback control; it exists to produce the gains used by state-feedback architectures.

DEPENDS_ON: cepstral normalization operates on cepstral coefficients — subtracting means and dividing by standard deviations per coefficient. Without cepstral coefficients as input data, normalization has nothing to operate on. Direction: cepstral-normalization → cepstral-coefficients (dependent → needed).

Removing LPC coefficients now stops the synthesis filter from operating. The synthesis filter is defined by the all-pole transfer function H(z) = G/(1-Σ(a_k·z^(-k))) where the a_k are the LPC coefficients. Without them, the filter has no coefficients to recurse with — it cannot reconstruct the speech waveform from excitation. Direction is correct: the synthesis filter depends on its coefficients as inputs.

[3 test] DEPENDS_ON removal test stated with result: cepstrum-interpolation operates on cepstral coefficient vectors — it computes weighted linear combinations of these coefficients element-wise. Removing cepstral-coefficient (the individual quefrency-domain values that the interpolation combines) leaves the procedure with no data structure to operate on. The interpolation does not produce the coefficients independently; it transforms existing coefficient vectors. Pinned sense: cepstral-coefficient as the single discrete value in a cepstrum sequence (per its accepted definition), of which the interpolation takes and produces collections.

[1 type; 2 direction; 3 test] The homomorphic filter operates by transforming into the cepstral domain (via Fourier → log → inverse Fourier) where convolutive mixing becomes additive. Without the cepstral representation mechanism, the homomorphic filter cannot function — it is a constitutive component.

The posterior cricoarytenoid muscle inserts on the muscular process of the arytenoid cartilage. Removal test: removing the arytenoid cartilage eliminates the insertion point; the muscle loses its lever and ceases to abduct the vocal fold.
Adaptive filter removes acoustic or electrical echo from a communication channel by continuously updating coefficients to minimize residual error.
Bode plot serves engineers in determining natural-frequency by showing the resonant peak at omega_n on the magnitude plot in underdamped second-order systems.

LQR operates on state-space model parameters (A,B,Q,R matrices). Remove the state-space representation and LQR has no matrices to form the algebraic Riccati equation and solve for K. Constitutive dependency: the Riccati equation A^T P + P A - P B R^{-1} B^T P + Q = 0 requires state-space matrices.

SERVES test: cepstrum-interpolation is built and maintained for the sake of speech synthesis. Its accepted definition lists implementation in HTS, World vocoder, STRAIGHT, Kaldi TTS frontend — all speech synthesis systems. Purpose is smooth transitions between cepstral frames in synthetic speech.

DEPENDS_ON (Laws 8, 8a): removal test. A cepstral sequence is an ordered list of cepstral coefficients. Without cepstral coefficients as the constituent elements, a cepstral sequence has no elements to order — the sequence operation is undefined. Direction: cepstral-sequence → cepstral-coefficients (dependent → needed).

H-infinity control operates on the loop gain L(s) and the sensitivity/complementary sensitivity functions S=1/(1+L) and T=L/(1+L). Removing loop-gain (the total signal amplification around one pass through a feedback loop, L=G*H) stops H-infinity from operating — the H-infinity norm is computed on the loop gain's transfer function, and the weighted plant model is built from loop-gain quantities.

Reflection coefficients are the intermediate outputs of the Levinson-Durbin recursion. The Levinson-Durbin algorithm produces reflection coefficients at each order step as a constitutive part of its computation. Without the Levinson-Durbin algorithm there is no mechanism to produce reflection coefficients in their LPC context — removing levinson-durbin-algorithm stops reflection-coefficient from operating.
Removing STFT now stops mel-spectrogram from operating; mel-spectrogram is computed from STFT magnitude and mel-filterbank.

Quantization-noise-shaping is a specific kind of noise-shaping. The specific-to-general direction holds: quantization-noise-shaping carves noise shaping applied specifically to quantization error in a feedback loop, while noise-shaping carves the general technique of modifying noise's spectral distribution. A competent speaker calls quantization-noise-shaping a noise-shaping technique. Item 5: pinned sense is structural kind.

The thyroarytenoid muscle's accepted definition carves its insertion as 'lateral surface and muscular process of the arytenoid cartilage.' Removal test: remove the arytenoid cartilage and the muscle loses its posterior anchor — it cannot operate as the muscle spanning thyroid to arytenoid. Constitutive attachment dependency. Direction correct.

Cepstral-mean is a specific aggregation computed from cepstral coefficients, which are elements of the cepstrum. The mean is a derived statistic of the cepstrum data structure, not an independent construct. INSTANCE_OF runs specific to general: the mean is a particular kind of cepstrum-derived feature.

The Burg algorithm operates by minimizing forward and backward prediction error powers at each recursion step: k_m = 2·Σ(f_{m-1}[n]·b_{m-1}[n-1]) / Σ(f_{m-1}[n]² + b_{m-1}[n-1]²). Removing the prediction-error concept removes the quantities the Burg algorithm computes on — it has no objective function without prediction error. The algorithm produces reflection coefficients, but its operation is constitutively about prediction-error minimization.

The bode-plot serves loop-gain by providing its primary visualization method. The loop-gain definition identifies Bode plots as its central role in stability analysis. The bode-plot is literally the graphical rendering of the loop-gain's frequency response (magnitude and phase of L(s)) — it exists to visualize loop-gain. The beneficiary is loop-gain; the bode-plot provides the visual means to assess it.

CONTAINS test: bronchiole is a human-made anatomical category that maps cartilage-free airway branches. Its definition explicitly enumerates members in parameter 2 (the boundary): 'it includes terminal bronchioles and respiratory bronchioles'. The respiratory-bronchiole is a named literal part inside the bronchiole construct. Direction: whole (bronchiole) to part (respiratory-bronchiole). Both are CONCEPTs; this is object-level reasoning between maps — the bronchiole map contains the respiratory-bronchiole map as a component.

The lateral cricoarytenoid muscle originates from the upper margin and lateral surface of the cricoid cartilage arch. Removal test: removing the cricoid cartilage eliminates the origin; the muscle loses its anterior anchor and cannot adduct the vocal fold.

DEPENDS_ON (Laws 8, 8a): removal test. The nyquist-plot definition carves a parametric curve of the open-loop response L(jw) as w sweeps from -infinity to +infinity: the plotted locus is the open-loop frequency response evaluated on the imaginary axis, magnitude and phase of L at each frequency. Remove the frequency-response characterization and the plot has no locus to draw — Re{L(jw)} and Im{L(jw)} at each w are frequency-response data, and the technique's persistence runs through reading that response (Nyquist's 1932 criterion applied to feedback amplifiers). The construct named in the plot's own definition, 'open-loop transfer function L(jw)', is its operand only in the sense that L(jw) IS the frequency response on the jw axis; the representation that can be removed without stopping the plot is a specific one (a state-space or measured model still yields the locus), but the locus itself cannot. Pinned sense: frequency-response as its accepted definition carves it — the magnitude and phase of a system's response as a function of sinusoidal input frequency.

The cricothyroidotomy is the emergency surgical airway created THROUGH the cricothyroid membrane. Operational DEPENDS_ON test (Law 8): remove the cricothyroid membrane and the procedure has no access route — the incision or puncture targets this specific membrane between the thyroid and cricoid cartilages. Without this membrane as the anatomical landmark and access point, the cricothyroidotomy procedure cannot operate as defined. Not identity and not purpose (Law 8c).

Slepian sequences are computed as eigenvectors of a finite-section sampling operator applied to the sinc kernel. The sinc kernel itself is the inverse Fourier transform of a rectangular frequency-window. The spectral concentration optimization is defined entirely in the Fourier domain — maximizing |∫_{-W}^{W} |X(f)|² df / ∫_{-∞}^{∞} |X(f)|² df. Without Fourier transform as the fundamental operation, the spectral concentration criterion has no definition.
Gain scheduling requires state-feedback as its base mechanism: the varying parameters modify the gain K in u = -Kx, so removing state-feedback removes what gain scheduling acts upon.

Cepstrum-energy at pitch-period quefrencies is the primary input to pitch detection and voicing decision. Removing cepstrum-energy removes the periodicity measure that fundamental-frequency estimation depends on for voiced/unguided speech.

SERVES, Law 8d for-whose-sake test: cepstral-peak-to-average-ratio is designed as a feature for speech processing systems — used in pitch detection, voicing decision, and periodicity measurement within speech analysis pipelines. The scope states this purpose directly. Remove speech-processing as the beneficiary and CPAR loses its design purpose. Direction: servant (CPAR feature) → master (speech-processing domain).

DEPENDS_ON removal test. Cepstral-interpolation computes weighted averages between cepstral coefficient vectors c[n] and c[n+1]. These vectors are outputs of the cepstrum transform — each coefficient indexed by quefrency. Without the cepstrum, there is no quefrency-domain representation and no coefficient vectors to interpolate. Removing cepstrum stops cepstral-interpolation from operating.

The parallelogram constrains adjacent reflection coefficients: k_i in [alpha*k_{i-1}, beta*k_{i-1}]. Without reflection-coefficient as its domain, the parallelogram constraint has nothing to operate on.

Cepstral-peak-picking is built and maintained to provide fundamental frequency estimates for pitch tracking systems. The picking identifies the dominant low-quefrency peak and maps it to a fundamental frequency — the core operation of pitch tracking.

Segmental-bronchus is a specific kind of bronchus. The bronchus definition carves major airway passages from the carina into the lungs. A segmental bronchus is a specific member of that category. Direction runs specific to general. Object level: both CONCEPTs of airway taxonomy. Sense pinned: segmental-bronchus as its accepted definition carves it, bronchus as its accepted definition carves it. Law 9a: a pulmonologist would call a segmental bronchus a bronchus.

ACELP analysis and synthesis both require LPC coefficients: the analysis stage computes them to model the vocal tract, and the synthesis stage applies them as the filter H(z) = G/(1-Σa_k z^(-k)). Without the coefficients the codec cannot model or reconstruct the spectral envelope. Structural dependency on the coefficient values.

Cohen class is a specific parameterized family within the quadratic-time-frequency-representation category. The note pins INSTANCE_OF correctly: Cohen class is a specific kind of quadratic TFR. The removal test: without the quadratic TFR taxonomy, Cohen class would not be classified within its proper family. The direction specific→general is correct.

Cepstral-decorrelation transforms cepstral coefficients to reduce redundancy in speech and audio feature extraction. Its accepted applications (speaker recognition, speech coding, robust feature extraction) are all within speech-processing. The procedure is built to serve this domain.

The nyquist-plot renders the open-loop frequency response as a complex-plane curve, enabling the Nyquist stability criterion to be applied: encirclements of the critical point are counted on this plot. The plot serves the criterion as its primary visual tool.

GL iteration reconstructs time-domain audio from magnitude spectrograms for use in audio synthesis, speech processing, and music information retrieval. The servant GL iteration serves the beneficiary audio-processing.

Kalman decomposition constructs its transformation matrix from the observability matrix and its nullspace. The decomposition partitions states into observable and unobservable subspaces. Without observability as a concept, the decomposition cannot distinguish observable modes — removing observability stops kalman-decomposition from operating.

DERIVED_FROM (Law 7, which-came-first, from independent history): the frequency-response concept is the historically prior construct, and the bode-plot developed out of it as its rendering. Evaluating a linear system's complex response H(omega) to sinusoidal inputs predates the plot: the jw-axis treatment runs through 1920s-30s network analysis, and Nyquist's 1932 stability criterion already worked with the system's gain and phase characteristics. Bode's 1945 'Relation between magnitude and phase in feedback systems' then contributed the specific representation - the log-log asymptotic straight-line rendering (dB and degrees against log frequency) of those same two branches. This is not the simultaneous-pair case the board struck on idft/dft: there the pair has no independent sequence; here the rendered quantity predates the rendering. (1) type: the note argues chronology, which is the type. (2) direction: the later construct (the 1945 plot) to what it came from (the response), the way the type points - the same direction the accepted group-delay DERIVED_FROM frequency-response edge runs. (3) test: the which-came-first test is stated with its result, and the result is true, independently sourced (Bode 1945 is named in the bode-plot's own persistence parameter). (4) object level: it relates the two constructs' own history - the rendering and the quantity it renders - not a shared condition of being concepts. (5) sense: the note uses each endpoint as its accepted (or filed) definition carves it; the source is provisional, so if the filing falls the edge voids in the same ruling with no penalty (Law 30).

CONTAINS test passes. Bronchial-tree maps the hierarchical branching pattern from tracheal bifurcation to terminal respiratory units (def param 1: hierarchy lists main → lobar → segmental → subsegmental → bronchioles). Segmental-bronchus maps each airway branch supplying a single bronchopulmonary segment. The bronchial-tree definition explicitly enumerates segmental bronchi as a tier of its hierarchy. The segmental bronchus is a literal part inside the bronchial tree construct — the tree is a part-whole map and segmental bronchi are one of its named components. Item 2: direction correct (whole to part). Item 3: note states CONTAINS test and result. Item 4: both CONCEPTs of natural territory; the note argues the bronchial-tree map contains the segmental-bronchus map as a component part. Item 5: endpoints used as accepted definitions carve them.
Removing LPC now stops parametric speech synthesis from operating; the synthesis filter is built from LPC coefficients; the parametric model loses its vocal tract representation.

The cricothyroid muscle originates from the anterior-lateral surface of the cricothyroid membrane and its surrounding fascia — removing this membrane would eliminate its attachment surface. The muscle stretches and tenses the vocal folds by pulling the thyroid cartilage toward the cricoid, and its mechanical operation depends on the membrane as its origin point. Sense pinned to accepted definitions. Direction: muscle depends on its attachment structure.
The IIR lattice filter implements a recursive transfer function with poles, making it a specific kind of IIR filter structure.

Prewhitening is standard preprocessing in cepstral feature extraction pipelines for speech recognition. Its definition lists HTK cepstral feature extraction as 'the default pre-processing' and Kaldi lpc_prewhitening as its persistence mechanism. These are core speech-recognition frontend toolkits. The for-whose-sake test passes: it is built for the quality of cepstral features used in speech-recognition systems.,

Remove-Y-now test: the damping-ratio definition lists omega_n as parameter (1) and places it in the normalized denominator s^2 + 2*zeta*omega_n*s + omega_n^2. The damping-ratio and natural-frequency are the paired parameters of a second-order system — the characteristic equation requires both to define the pole locations. Remove natural-frequency and the second-order system's pole structure (the very thing damping-ratio classifies) loses its frequency scale. The damped frequency omega_d = omega_n*sqrt(1-zeta^2) also requires omega_n.
The conceptual map SERVES the surgical construct as a landmark for procedural execution.

A state observer is built to provide state estimates for the sake of implementing state feedback when full state measurement is unavailable. The observer's purpose is to serve the feedback law u = -K x_hat. Remove the servant and the feedback law loses its input when states are unmeasured.

The airway category names the entire passage air takes from the outside world to the alveoli and back. Its span explicitly includes the alveoli as the terminal gas-exchange portion. The alveolus is the specific micro-structure where air meets the blood, making it the most distal kind of airway.

Variance normalization is a standard preprocessing step in speech recognition pipelines, specifically designed to remove variance mismatch between speakers and channels to improve recognition robustness.

SERVES test: cepstral-peak-detection produces candidate quefrencies that serve as direct input to pitch tracking algorithms. Pitch tracking requires validated peak locations to estimate fundamental frequency — cepstral-peak-detection provides those peaks. Without the detection, pitch tracking loses its cepstral-domain candidate set. Speech-recognition pipelines use cepstral-peak-detection as the peak-validation step feeding pitch tracking.

CONTAINS (Law 10): the frequency coordinate, as its accepted definition carves it, is the axis on which the frequency-domain map is drawn - the part inside the whole, the way the accepted cepstral-domain CONTAINS quefrency holds the domain's own coordinate inside the domain. Without the frequency axis the map has no coordinates to read a spectrum from. Direction: whole (the map) to its part (the axis coordinate).

DEPENDS_ON (Laws 8, 8a): Removal test. The cepstral-sequence is an ordered array of cepstral coefficients derived from log-magnitude spectrum via inverse Fourier transform. The logarithm operation is constitutive — it converts the multiplicative convolution in the time domain (source-filter separation) into additive decomposition. Removing logarithm: the spectrum remains in linear scale, convolution is not converted to addition, and the inverse Fourier transform cannot separate source and filter components into distinct quefrency regions. Direction: cepstral-sequence → logarithm (dependent → needed).

Cepstral-smoothing is a quefrency-domain operation that applies low-pass or liftering to cepstral coefficients as part of cepstral-analysis practice. Removing cepstral-analysis as the encompassing practice stops the framework in which cepstral-smoothing is defined and deployed.

DEPENDS_ON (Laws 8, 8a): Removal test. The cepstral-transform computes the power spectral density of the input signal via FFT as its first step, then takes the logarithm, then applies inverse FFT. Without the power spectral density as the initial spectral representation, there is no input to the transform pipeline. Removing power-spectral-density: no spectral input to log and transform, the cepstral output cannot be produced. Direction: cepstral-transform → power-spectral-density (dependent → needed).

Phase-vocoder-stretch is a specific technique whose definition carves time-scale modification preserving pitch, a subset of time-stretching. The entry's carve is a concrete implementation of the broader class time-stretching, with STFT phase manipulation as its distinguishing parameter. The edge is specific to general, nearest kind.

The airway category carves the passage air takes from the outside world to the alveoli. The alveolar sac is a terminal cluster of alveoli sharing a common opening — it is made of alveoli themselves, the most distal portion of the airway passage. It is explicitly within the airway span.

The cricotracheal membrane definition carves it as the fibrous band connecting the inferior border of the cricoid cartilage to the first tracheal ring. Its inferior boundary IS the first tracheal ring, making it structurally part of the tracheal framework. The definition parameter 3 notes the intermediate tracheal ligament lies anterior to it, and parameter 4 places it in the context of tracheostomy and laryngotracheal surgery. The cricotracheal membrane is enumerated by its physical attachment to the first tracheal ring, making it a part of the trachea's structural system.

The Lanczos algorithm constructs an orthonormal basis for the Krylov subspace K_m(A,v); removing the Krylov subspace concept now stops Lanczos from operating, as the algorithm is defined by its construction of this specific subspace via a three-term recurrence.

T(s) is evaluated across frequency (|T(j omega)| vs omega). The frequency-response characterization is its evaluation domain - remove it and there is no frequency at which to assess tracking sensitivity.

MFCC is made and maintained for the sake of speech recognition: it compresses spectral envelope into features that classifiers use to recognize spoken words. The construct exists to serve that recognition task.
The larynx construct contains the pre-epiglottic space as a part: the fat-filled region anterior to the epiglottis is anatomically situated within the supraglottic compartment of the larynx.

CONTAINS test: bronchiole is a human-made anatomical category that maps cartilage-free airway branches. Its definition explicitly enumerates members in parameter 2 (the boundary): 'it includes terminal bronchioles and respiratory bronchioles'. The terminal-bronchiole is a named literal part inside the bronchiole construct. Direction: whole (bronchiole) to part (terminal-bronchiole). Both are CONCEPTs; this is object-level reasoning between maps — the bronchiole map contains the terminal-bronchiole map as a component.
Larynx map serves superior laryngeal nerve concept by providing anatomical context for nerve innervation description.

A lag-compensator is a controller transfer function that modifies the loop gain of a feedback loop. It only operates within the context of a feedback loop structure — its purpose is to shape the loop gain L(s)=G(s)H(s) by boosting low-frequency gain while adding minimal phase lag near crossover. Remove the feedback-loop construct and a lag-compensator has no loop in which to operate: its transfer-function modification has no target. The removal test passes: without a feedback loop, the lag compensator is just a transfer function with no operational context. Direction: lag-compensator (the component) depends on feedback-loop (the structural context).

UKF was developed by Julier and Uhlmann (1995) specifically as an improvement on EKF to avoid Jacobian computation. Historical lineage: EKF (1969) introduced Jacobian linearization; UKF (1995) replaced it with sigma-point propagation to handle non-smooth nonlinearities. DERIVED_FROM direction: later→earlier, UKF derives from EKF's framework and addresses its Jacobian limitations.

ISTFT requires STFT as its input: it takes the complex STFT matrix and inverts it to recover the time-domain signal. Without STFT there is nothing to inverse. Removal test: remove STFT and ISTFT has no input and cannot operate.
the pulmonary hilum is a medial entry zone on each lung; CONTAINS by geography — the hilum is a part of the lung structure.

The Gabor transform IS a windowed Fourier transform with a specifically Gaussian window. The definition carves it as 'windowed Fourier transforms with Gaussian windows.' The STFT is the general method (arbitrary window), and the Gabor transform is the instantiation using a Gaussian window specifically. The Gabor transform came from the STFT by specializing the window function, making this a DERIVED_FROM relationship.

CONTAINS test (Law 10): the bronchiole construct, as its accepted definition carves it, enumerates its members in parameter (2): 'it includes terminal bronchioles and respiratory bronchioles'. The respiratory-bronchiole is a literal member inside the bronchiole category — the cartilage-free airway level distal to the segmental bronchi contains, as its distal transition, the respiratory bronchiole where alveolar outpouchings first appear in the wall (the boundary parameter (2) draws). Direction: whole (bronchiole) to part (respiratory-bronchiole). Both are CONCEPT maps; object-level: the note argues the map's own enumerated membership — the board's standing enumerated-part-holds line, as in bronchial-tree CONTAINS respiratory-bronchiole (gc805634edc3f84d871db0855) and pulmonary-acinus CONTAINS respiratory-bronchiole (g41a3ff0b4d4f2502becb3f6d), not territory causality. The complementary kind-relation (respiratory-bronchiole INSTANCE_OF bronchiole, accepted g62e3857b65cd98710b5da9e4) stands beside it as the board's dual-relation line.

Phase-vocoder-stretch is used by audio engineers to change duration of recordings without pitch change for timing correction, music production, and post-production. The definition names software implementations in audio editing tools and DAWs, showing its servant role to audio-engineering practice.

DEPENDS_ON test: cepstral decomposition operates on the cepstral sequence (cepstrum coefficients) — it applies a quefrency-domain window (lifter) to the cepstral coefficients to separate source from filter components. Without the cepstral sequence as the operand, the decomposition procedure has nothing to lifter-process. Structural necessity.

The Bass-Gura formula requires the system to be controllable: the characteristic polynomial coefficients (beta) are only well-defined when the system is controllable, and the formula computes the gain to assign those poles.

8d for-whose-sake, stated with result: the lead-lag def's own opening words pin the design-for. Its lead section is 'centered near the crossover frequency to add phase margin' - the section is built, by design, for the sake of the phase margin: that measure is the quantity the section exists to raise, not an incidental benefit. Direct accepted family precedent: lead-compensator SERVES-> phase-margin (gdec3ea7) is ACCEPTED on exactly this servant->measure line, and the lead-lag carries the same lead section inside one combined network. Item 1: SERVES is the relation the note argues (built or maintained for the sake of the margin). Item 2: servant (the compensator's lead section) to beneficiary (the margin it targets) - direction right. Item 4: object level - the note relates the controller's design purpose to the stability measure it targets, not a shared cognitive condition. Item 5: phase-margin used as its accepted def carves it - the phase difference from -180 deg at the gain-crossover frequency, the exact quantity the lead section raises. (Contingent: source entry is provisional; if it falls, this edge voids with refund.)

For underdamped second-order systems, rise-time t_r = (pi - theta)/omega_d where theta = arccos(zeta) and omega_d = omega_n*sqrt(1-zeta^2), and both zeta and omega_d are functions of the pole locations (s = -zeta*omega_n ± j*omega_d). Without the pole-zero construct — specifically the pole location — rise-time has no computational basis for the standard underdamped case.

The LPC filter IS an all-pole filter whose coefficients are the LPC coefficients. Its transfer function H(z) = G/(1−Σ(a_k · z^(−k))) directly uses the LPC coefficients a_k as its pole positions. The filter's resonances (formants) correspond to the spectral envelope encoded by the LPC coefficients. Without LPC coefficients, the LPC filter is an unparameterized structure with no defined poles. The removal test passes: removing lpc-coefficient stops the LPC filter from operating as a defined construct — it cannot function without its defining parameter set.

Lead compensator modifies the open-loop gain L(s) by adding phase lead near the crossover frequency. Its entire operation is on the loop gain — the transfer function C(s) multiplies with the plant's open-loop transfer function to reshape L(s). Removing loop-gain eliminates the quantity being shaped; the compensator has no other target. The removal test passes: without loop-gain, lead-compensator is a formula with nothing to multiply.

GL iteration takes a magnitude spectrum as its input constraint and enforces it at each iteration. Without the magnitude spectrum, there is no target to constrain — the algorithm's purpose (magnitude-consistent phase recovery) ceases to operate.

Loop-shaping operates on the loop gain L(s) to shape its frequency response. Removing the loop-gain construct eliminates the quantity being shaped — the method has no operational target. DEPENDS_ON test: removing loop-gain stops loop-shaping because the methodology is defined as manipulating the magnitude and phase of loop gain across frequency.

ACELP analysis requires the prediction-error filter to extract the residual excitation signal from the input speech. The filter A(z) = 1 - Σ(a_k · z^(-k)) is applied to the input to compute the LP residual, which is then matched against the algebraic codebook. Without the prediction-error filter, the ACELP analysis pipeline has no residual and the codebook search cannot proceed.

Remove-Y-now test: the peak-overshoot definition gives the formula Mp = exp(-π·ζ/√(1-ζ²)) which computes the overshoot solely from the damping-ratio ζ. Remove damping-ratio now and the formula has no parameter — the overshoot measure cannot be computed. This is not a domain relationship but a formulaic dependency: the construct's defining equation requires ζ as its only variable.
