DEPENDS_ON (Laws 8, 8a): Removal test. Griffin-Lim alternates between inverse-STFT (to estimate phase in the time domain) and forward-STFT (to enforce the magnitude constraint). The inverse-STFT is the direct synthesis step — removing it eliminates the only mechanism for reconstructing time-domain signal estimates from the magnitude-constrained frequency representation. The algorithm has no alternative synthesis path.

The separation-principle definition (v1) is entirely expressed in state-space terms: "A linear time-invariant plant with state-space matrices A, B, C," "observer gain L chosen to place eigenvalues of A-LC," "feedback gain K chosen to place eigenvalues of A-BK." The theorem statement "the eigenvalues of the combined (A-BK) and (A-LC) dynamics" references the state-space construct throughout. Removing state-space-model removes the mathematical language and formalism through which the separation principle is defined and expressed. Note: the separation principle could be stated in transfer-function form, but its accepted definition and all its uses are in state-space.

Rise-time quantifies the time for the step response to first travel between specified percentage thresholds — the step response IS the operand. Removing step-response eliminates the very quantity that rise-time measures.

The trachea (cartilaginous tube C6 to T4-T5) terminates at the carina where it bifurcates into the bronchi. Anatomically, the bronchi arise from the inferior termination of the trachea — the carina is the transition point. The bronchi are the direct anatomical continuation of the tracheal lumen. The trachea's structural design (16-20 C-shaped rings, mucociliary escalator) is adapted to deliver air to the branching bronchial tree. The bronchi could not exist without the tracheal conduit above them.

Removing the Yule-Walker equations now stops autocovariance from operating. The Yule-Walker equations directly express AR model parameters in terms of the autocovariance function — R·a = r where R contains autocovariances γ(|i-j|). Without the Yule-Walker relation, the autocovariance cannot be used in its primary purpose of AR parameter estimation.

The pulmonary-lobule is a discrete structural unit about 1-2.5 cm in diameter containing parenchyma supplied by a central terminal bronchiole (param 2). The pulmonary-acinus is defined as the portion of lung distal to a terminal bronchiole (param 1). Since the lobule contains the parenchyma distal to its terminal bronchiole, the acinus (being exactly that parenchymal region) is literally a part inside the lobule. The note pins the sense: the acinus is a structural component of the lobule's parenchyma. All 5 items pass.

The bode-plot renders the frequency response as magnitude and phase curves, enabling engineers to read the phase margin at the gain-crossover frequency. The plot serves phase-margin as its standard visualization tool.
Spectral inversion is a specific application of the homomorphic filtering framework, derived from the same log-transform + linear operation + inverse transform pipeline.

The observer-controller definition (v1) is entirely expressed in state-space terms: it "combines a state observer with a state-feedback controller" — both are state-space constructs operating on state vectors x and gain matrices K. The observer estimates the state vector from measurements; the controller maps the estimated state to control input. Removing state-space-model removes the mathematical framework (state vector, state matrices A/B/C, eigenvalue placement) through which the observer-controller is defined and operates. The note: the observer-controller is a state-space construct; without state-space-model it has no formalism.

log-law-quantizer is a specific kind of quantization structure. The specific-to-general direction holds: log-law-quantizer carves a quantization whose step sizes scale logarithmically, while quantization carves the general technique of mapping continuous values to discrete levels. A competent speaker calls log-law-quantizer a quantization structure. Item 5: pinned sense is structural kind.

DEPENDS_ON test: cepstral-delay operates by computing a weighted mean delay from the logarithm of the cepstrum. The logarithmic transformation is constitutive to the computation — cepstral-delay cannot be computed without first applying the logarithm to the input spectrum. Removing logarithm removes the log-spectrum that cepstral-delay operates on.

Remove cepstrum now stops cepstral-domain from operating. Cepstral-domain is the mathematical representation space constructed by log-power-spectrum + inverse FT; its definition and usage rely on the cepstrum transform construct as the operational procedure that defines and populates the domain. Without the cepstrum procedure, the domain loses its defining construction and its practical instantiation in signal processing. This is DEPENDS_ON under remove-Y-now-does-X-stop-operating, not historical DERIVED_FROM.

Remove Y: cepstral-envelope extracts the spectral envelope from a cepstrum sequence by low-quefrency cepstral coefficients. The cepstral-analysis procedure (log-power spectrum, inverse Fourier transform) is the necessary computational mechanism that produces the cepstrum the envelope extraction operates on. Without cepstral-analysis, there is no cepstrum to extract an envelope from. Test: remove cepstral-analysis and cepstral-envelope cannot operate — no quefrency-domain representation exists to extract from. Sense: cepstral-envelope as the spectral envelope derived via cepstral-analysis. Note states removal test with result.

The bronchial-tree maps the hierarchical branching of conducting airways, and the airway category is the functional whole from nares to alveoli. The tree is a specific kind of airway construct — a detailed anatomical map of the lower portion of the airway passage.
The bronchus depends on vagal innervation for bronchial smooth muscle tone control; removing vagal input stops parasympathetic bronchoconstriction and sympathetic bronchodilation regulation.

Teleological relation: the Bass-Gura formula exists to produce the gain matrix K used in pole-placement control design. Remove the formula and pole-placement still operates (via Ackermann or numerical methods), but the formula itself is maintained for the sake of this architecture. SERVES runs servant→beneficiary, which is correct: formula→architecture. Note states the test (for whose sake) and result (produces K gains for pole-placement). All 5 items pass.
The FIR lattice filter implements a transfer function with only zeros, making it a specific kind of FIR filter structure.

DEPENDS_ON removal test: the def carves cepstral coefficients which are values in the cepstrum sequence. Remove the cepstrum as the domain of these coefficients and the feature vectors have no substrate to exist on. Direction: aggregation → the sequence domain it operates on. Sense pinned to cepstrum as the domain whose values are aggregated.

DEPENDS_ON test (Law 8): spectral-flux computes the L1 distance between consecutive power spectra — fundamentally measuring change in spectral energy. Removing spectral-energy (the concept of energy as distributed across frequencies) from the construct stops spectral-flux from operating: flux is defined as energy change per frame. Direction: dependent (spectral-flux) → needed (spectral-energy).

The time constant tau is defined as the time at which the step response reaches 63.2% of its steady-state value — the step response IS the operational operand. Removing step-response (the transient response to a step input) eliminates the quantity that time-constant measures, so the time-constant construct stops operating.

The note argues INSTANCE_OF as scope containment between the two maps: the trachea concept carves the specific air passage from the larynx to the carina, while the airway concept carves the entire air passage from nares to alveoli. The airway definition explicitly names "the trachea" as a named segment within its scope (param 1). The trachea concept scope is a specific subregion of the airway concept domain. Test (item 3): a competent speaker would call the trachea "a type of airway passage" because it is one of the named segments constituting the airway functional whole — the airway definition itself partitions the airway into upper airway, trachea, and lower airway.

The main-bronchus definition states the right main bronchus gives rise to superior, middle, and inferior lobar bronchi; the left to superior and inferior. Lobar bronchi are parts of the main-bronchus hierarchy. Direction runs whole to part. Object level: both CONCEPTs. Sense pinned.
Krylov subspace operates on a square matrix A; removing the concept of matrix stops the subspace construction K_k(A,v) = span{v, Av, ...} from operating.

The Bode plot's magnitude curve at high frequency shows the roll-off rate (dB/decade) which determines settling-time characteristics: faster roll-off generally implies faster decay of high-frequency components and shorter settling. Designers read the Bode plot to estimate transient settling from frequency-domain roll-off behavior.
